name: The Ellen DeGeneres Show
description: The Ellen DeGeneres Show, often shortened to just Ellen, is an American television talk show hosted by comedian/actress Ellen DeGeneres.

videos.title: Merv Griffin/Topher Grace
videos.overview: Today Ellen welcomes TV's most legendary game show architect, Merv Griffin, for a chat about his incredible career. Later, ""That 70's Show"" star Topher Grace drops by to discuss his newest film, ""Win A Date with Tad Hamilton.""

videos.title: Kim Cattrall/Bobby J. Thompson
videos.overview: It's Ellen's Birthday! Doesn't she look great for 29? Joining Ellen for a very special birthday hour of ""The Ellen DeGeneres Show"" will be actress KIM CATTRALL from the HBO hit series ""Sex and the City"" and child actor BOBB'E J. THOMPSON from NBC's ""The Tracy Morgan Show"". Ellen is surprised throughout the hour with birthday messages and gifts from some of television, film and music's biggest stars. It's a celebration you don't wanna miss.

videos.title: Betty White/Amy Smart/Gavin DeGraw
videos.overview: Former Golden Girl BETTY WHITE chats with Ellen about her upcoming guest appearance on ABC's legal drama ""The Practice."" Also dropping by will be actress Amy Smart to chat about her new film, ""The Butterfly Effect"" (co-starring Ashton Kutcher). Later, New hit-maker GAVIN DEGRAW performs ""I Don't Wanna Be"" from his debut CD intitled ""Chariot.""

videos.title: Burt Reynolds/Nick Gannon
videos.overview: Star of Stage, Screen and TV, the Legendary BURT REYNOLDS visits the show and talks with Ellen about his upcoming guest appearance on NBC's, soon to conclude series, ""Ed."" Later TeenNick host, and Actor/singer NICK CANNON chats and performs ""Gigolo"" from his self-titled debut CD. Plus, Ellen makes her first weekly call to MEREDITH (""The Bachelorette"").

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher/Deidre Hall/Travis
videos.overview: Today Ellen welcomes Hollywood's newest sensation, ""That 70's Show"" star ASHTON KUTCHER, to chat about the end of his MTV series ""Punk'd"" and his new film ""The Butterfly Effect."" Also dropping by on this episode, will be ""Days of our Lives"" star DEIDRE HALL. And Later, hot new band TRAVIS performs ""Love Will Come Through"" from their new CD ""12 Memories.""

videos.title: Julie Bowen/Fefe Dobson
videos.overview: Star of NBC's Friday Night series ""ED"", JULIE BOWEN stops by to chat with Ellen about her career and the potential end of the series ""ED"" after only 4 seasons. Plus Later, 18 year-old singing sensation FEFE DOBSON performs ""Everything"" from her self-titled CD.

videos.title: Amy Brenneman and LeAnn Rimes
videos.overview: AMY BRENNEMAN drops by the show to chat with Ellen about her hit CBS drama, ""Judging Amy."" Ellen also welcomes KATHY NAJIMY, and they play their favorite game ""Celebrity"" with two audience members. Also on this episode, former teen sensation and current Country mega-star LEANN RIMES performs ""With This Love"", from her latest CD, ""Greatest Hits""

videos.title: Katey Segal/Chris Harrison/Brian McKnight
videos.overview: Star of ABC's hit sitcom ""8 Simple Rules for Dating My Teenage Daughter"", KATEY SAGAL stops by and chats with Ellen. ""The Bachelorette"" host CHRIS HARRISON also stops by to discuss the new season of the his series on ABC. And hitmaker BRIAN MCKNIGHT performs ""Been So Long"" from his CD ""U Turn."" Plus, Houston updates Ellen on his adventures at the Super Bowl.

videos.title: Seth Green/Tyra Banks
videos.overview: Ellen chats with actor SETH GREEN (""Austin Powers"" & ""Party Monster"") and supermodel TYRA BANKS stops by to talk about the hit reality show ""America's Next Top Model."" Ellen checks in on MEREDITH (""The Bachelorette"") to dish about who will receive a rose and who will go home broken-hearted.

videos.title: Jessica Simpson / Nick Lachey / Henry Winkler
Season 1 Halloween Show: Ellen as Dr. Phil
videos.overview: Dive into Ellen’s spooktacular Season 1 Halloween episode! Ellen as Dr. Phil and Wanda Sykes as Oprah. Special guest Joshua Malina joins the fun as a flying nun, sharing his Halloween passion and love for candy!

videos.title: Holly Hunter, Sarah McLachlan, Jeff Corwin
Robert Downey Jr., Mary J. Blige
Dwayne The Rock Johnson, Jami Gertz
videos.overview: Ellen has some food related fun with Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson, chats with Jami Gertz, and stumps her audience with the intriguing News Game.

videos.title: David Duchovny, Poppy Montgomery
videos.overview: Ellen is joined by David Duchovny and later engages in a chat and "Celebrity Head" game with Poppy Montgomery.

videos.title: Anne Hathaway, Cedric the Entertainer
videos.overview: Ellen navigates feline drama, delves into Cedric the Entertainer's early career, engages her audience in a sunglasses guessing game, and chats with Anne Hathaway, who shares how Ellen served as an inspiration during the filming of "The Princess Diaries".

videos.title: Jessica Simpson & Nick Lachey, Henry Winkler, Hugh Dancy
videos.overview: Jessica Simpson and Nick Lachey discuss "Newlyweds," Henry Winkler talks "Arrested Development" and "Happy Days," and Hugh Dancy shares about London and "Ella Enchanted.

videos.title: Elisha Cuthbert, Dennis Franz
videos.overview: Elisha Cuthbert dazzles with tales of dancing with Justin Timberlake. Dennis Franz gives an exclusive peek into the final season of "NYPD Blue" and his remarkable cop roles.

videos.title: Barry Manilow, Nia Vardolas, Baby Birds
videos.overview: Ellen tenderly relocates a nest of baby birds to safety and showcases viewers' beloved pets. Barry Manilow discusses health scares, his role as an American Idol judge, and his devoted "Fanilows." Nia Vardalos shares heartfelt memories connected to Barry Manilow's music, discusses writing "My Big Fat Greek Wedding," and acknowledges Tom Hanks and Rita Wilson's instrumental support in bringing it to the big screen.

videos.title: Janet Jackson, David Arquette, Ellen's Own Award Show
videos.overview: Ellen opens up about morning challenges before presenting "Holla Awards."  Janet Jackson graces the stage, discussing her tour and showcasing her dance skills. Later, David Arquette shares excitement about impending parenthood and reflects on his fashion choices.

videos.title: John Travolta, Goran Visnjic, Random Acts of Kindness
videos.overview: Ellen delves into the vast array of careers available and unveils the "Holla Awards" for acts of kindness, alongside the debut of the segment "What's Your Two Cents?" John Travolta shares lively tales, while Goran Visnjic makes his inaugural appearance, discussing "ER" and more.

videos.title: Tina Fey, David Bowie, Ellen's 'In Case of Emergency'
videos.overview: Ellen prepares for an earthquake, while Tina Fey reminisces about her groundbreaking role at SNL and the creation of "Mean Girls." David Bowie shares insights on family and his eclectic training endeavors.

videos.title: Isabella Rossellini, Debbie Reynolds, Bill Rancic
videos.overview: Isabella Rossellini reminisces about her mother, Ingrid Bergman, and her remarkable feat of gracing the cover of Vogue four times in one year, while Bill Rancic stops by to recount his victory in Season 1 of "The Apprentice," and the iconic Debbie Reynolds joins the show to chat about her legendary career.

videos.title: Simon Baker, Cheri Oteri
videos.overview: Ellen seeks unique talents among viewers and showcases fan letters featuring chubby cats. Simon Baker makes his debut, discussing his Australian nickname, vacation style, and potential alternate career. Cheri Oteri humorously recounts her recent trip to China, muses on cell phone culture, and shares the inspiration behind one of her popular SNL characters, based on her grandmother.

videos.title: Christopher Walken, Tim Meadows
videos.overview: Ellen swiftly skips time wasters and greets guests before Christopher Walken shares insights on impressions, dancing, and modeling. Meanwhile, viewers join Ellen for another fun round of "Hip-Hop or Not," followed by Tim Meadows discussing "Mean Girls" and his SNL career.

videos.title: Jennifer Garner, Jamie Kennedy
videos.overview: Ellen shares her sock obsession in a Season 1 monologue. Jennifer Garner debuts in 2004, promoting "13 Going on 30" and "Alias." Ellen's producer gets into mischief, and Jamie Kennedy surprises with a prank.

videos.title: Dakota Fanning, Rebecca Romijn, Feline Reunion
videos.overview: In this episode, Ellen shares an adorable viewer shoutout, welcomes Rebecca Romijn's debut with a thoughtful gift, reunites a woman with her lost cat, and reminisces with Dakota Fanning about early career moments!

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Sarah Chalke
videos.overview: Sarah Chalke from "Scrubs" stopped by to chat about her recent move to LA and "Scrubs".

videos.title: Mary Tyler Moore, Rosie Perez, Hidden Talents
videos.overview: Join Ellen as she talks about her rough night’s sleep, followed by updates on her baby birds. Then, Ellen is interacting with viewers, honoring fan talents with a special “Holla” award shout-out, and welcoming iconic guests like Mary Tyler Moore and Rosie Perez.

videos.title: Jay Leno, Lorraine Bracco
videos.overview: Experience shares history lessons with her viewers. Jay Leno’s tells hilarious anecdotes from his first appearance and Lorraine Bracco’s chat about “The Sopranos” and her Broadway debut.

videos.title: Lindsay Lohan, Kevin Sorbo, Ending of ‘Friends’
videos.overview: Ellen navigates the emotional farewell to “Friends” and challenges a memory expert. Then, follow her mall escapade and catch Lindsay Lohan’s debut along with Kevin Sorbo’s charming visit on the show.

videos.title: Hugh Jackman, Al Roker, Car Giveaway
videos.overview: Hugh Jackman debuts, sharing Broadway tales and talking about his latest film, “Van Helsing.” Al Roker discusses weight loss, workouts, and weather. Ellen amps up the excitement with a thrilling car giveaway competition for her audience.

videos.title: Josh Duhamel, Christina Ricci
videos.overview: Ellen embraces aging gracefully, with Andy Lassner’s comedic fall adding to the fun. Guests Christina Ricci and Josh Duhamel share captivating stories, while Ellen’s mall visit sparks an exciting new venture.

videos.title: David Schwimmer from ‘Friends,’ Gabrielle Union
videos.overview: Ellen shares an interesting gorilla photo story. David Schwimmer discusses the “Friends” finale and plays charades. Gabrielle Union debuts, reflecting on her groundbreaking “Friends” role and her admiration for Janet Jackson.

videos.title: Patti LaBelle, Cynthia Nixon
videos.overview: Cynthia Nixon debuts on “Ellen,” revealing her natural blonde hair and hinting at a “Sex and the City” movie. Patti LaBelle shares Glamour Awards experiences and swaps heels with Ellen.

videos.title: Usher, Patrick Stewart, Cooking with Nigella Lawson
videos.overview: “Star Trek” icon Patrick Stewart shares laughs with Ellen, chatting about martinis, action figures, and “The Borrowers.” Usher promotes his new album “Confessions” while Ellen delights him with his favorite dessert. Later, Ellen embarks on a culinary adventure alongside Nigella Lawson, exploring the art of cooking.

videos.title: Paula Abdul, Wilmer Valderrama
videos.overview: Paula Abdul shares insights on “American Idol” 2004, her upbeat vibes, and dance anecdotes. She even teaches Ellen some moves. Wilmer Valderrama joins Ellen for a fun hangout. Ellen spices up the show with a sunglasses-themed game for lucky audience members.

videos.title: David Spade, Latoya London, Vanessa Marcil
videos.overview: David Spade makes his debut on the “Ellen” show, marking the beginning of a frequent guest stint in Season 1. Ellen surprises an ecstatic fan with a heartwarming chat. Latoya London and Vanessa Marcil join Ellen to discuss the latest.

videos.title: Simon Cowell, Jorja Fox
videos.overview: Simon Cowell dishes on “American Idol” drama, winning strategies, and his unfiltered opinions. Ellen explores L.A.’s farmers market scene. Jorja Fox catches up with Ellen for a chat.

videos.title: Dolly Parton, Jon Favreau, Workout Attire
videos.overview: Dolly Parton enchants as she graces “Ellen” for the first time in 2004. Jon Favreau spices up Season 1 with tales of gambling alongside Ben Affleck and Matt Damon, along with insights into his projects.

videos.title: Glenn Close, Andy Richter
videos.overview: Ellen reflects on her evolving bond with viewers at the nine-month milestone. In 2004, Glenn Close captivates with tales from “Fatal Attraction” and her adventures in Africa. Andy Richter shares laughs, discussing his new show and family escapades in Mexico.

videos.title: Jake Gyllenhaal, Sean Hayes, 8-Year-Old Drummer
videos.overview: Sean Hayes chases his dreams as he conquers a dog agility course, courtesy of Ellen. Plus, catch a young drumming sensation and Jake Gyllenhaal’s unforgettable debut!

videos.title: Antonio Banderas, Alanis Morissette
videos.overview: Join Antonio Banderas in 2004 as he shares “Shrek” secrets, celebrates love with Ellen, and shows off his moves. Plus, a fan of the show fulfills her dream with a monster truck thrill, and Alanis Morissette chats about haircuts and pups.

videos.title: Cameron Diaz, Cotton Candy
videos.overview: Join Ellen as viewers share their thoughts, a lucky chocolate milk giver gets a “Holla Award,” and Cameron Diaz spins cotton candy on her first 2004 appearance.

videos.title: Halle Berry, Tom Selleck
videos.overview: In this episode of “Ellen,” explore Halle Berry’s journey portraying Catwoman, from her beauty accolades to the unique training. Then, Ellen welcomes Tom Selleck to share insights on his “Magnum P.I.” days and discuss the iconic “Friends” ending — mustache not included!

videos.title: Kate Hudson, Julian McMahon
videos.overview: Kate Hudson’s charming Season 1 debut, where she shares anecdotes about her son, Ryder, and a chance encounter with Ellen. Plus, witness heartwarming recognition for two kids’ kindness, followed by Julian McMahon sitting down with Ellen to catch up and discuss “Nip/Tuck.”

videos.title: Justin Timberlake, Sharon Stone, Fantasia Barrino
videos.overview: Justin Timberlake kicks off the show with high energy, engaging in a vibrant conversation with Ellen. Sharon Stone then delves into her experiences with motherhood and her memorable role in "Catwoman," while Fantasia Barrino celebrates her triumphant "American Idol" win and shares her dreams for the future.

videos.title: Kelly Clarkson, Noah Wyle (Season Premiere)
videos.overview: Ellen's back for a Second HUGE season of celebrity fun and it's that time for the fun to begin again! Kicking off Ellen's Second Premiere Week, Noah Wyle graces Ellen's stage. The 1st winner of the smash hit FOX series "American Idol" Kelly Clarkson shares hilarious tour stories and puppy mishaps.

videos.title: Reese Witherspoon, Brandy, Quick Change Magic
videos.overview: Reese Witherspoon delights Ellen with Southern charm and reveals her real name. Meanwhile, a mesmerizing quick-change duo enchants the audience. Brandy shares music and love, receiving an early wedding gift from Ellen.

videos.title: Tim McGraw, Pamela Anderson, Paul Hamm
videos.overview: Pamela Anderson’s debut on “Ellen” features discussions on citizenship, love life, and her best-selling novel. Olympic gold medalist Paul Hamm delivers a breathtaking gymnastics routine. Tim McGraw discusses his hit single “Live Like You Were Dying.”

videos.title: Matt LeBlanc
videos.overview: Ellen hits Staples with PA Houston for show prep. Matt LeBlanc discusses fatherhood and “Joey” post-“Friends.” Ellen spices up the show with a spin-off song guessing game for the audience.

videos.title: Brad Garrett, 2004 U.S. Gymnastics Team
videos.overview: Brad Garrett drops by to chat about family and the last season of “Everybody Loves Raymond.” Carly Patterson and the 2004 U.S. gymnastics team flaunt their Olympic medals on Ellen’s stage post-Athens Games.

videos.title: Josh Duhamel, ‘Jeopardy!’ Champion
videos.overview: Josh Duhamel bares it all for Ellen in his second appearance, sharing tales of his first modeling gig and his role in “Las Vegas,” while "Jeopardy!" champ Ken Jennings discusses his strategies, winnings, and being labeled a nerd in 2004.

videos.title: Paris Hilton, Jill Scott
videos.overview: Ellen kicks off the show on a treadmill, Paris Hilton debuts on "Ellen" in 2004, sharing red-carpet tips, followed by Ellen leading her audience in the beloved "Sincerely Ellen" game.

videos.title: Farrah Fawcett, Andy Richter, Kid Inventors
videos.overview: Farrah Fawcett, the iconic star of “Charlie’s Angels,” discusses her famous role, signature hair, and reality show with Ellen, even teaching her a dance. Andy Richter returns to share his humorous anecdotes about his summer in New Orleans and playing poker on “Celebrity Poker Showdown.” Plus, kid inventors showcase their innovative creations that aim to advance humanity’s future.

videos.title: Kirsten Dunst, Scott Wolf
videos.overview: Scott Wolf from “Everwood” discusses his recent wedding in his sole appearance on “Ellen.” Kristen Dunst recounts presenting an award at the MTV Movie Awards, where Ellen surprised everyone by dressing as Spider-Man alongside Tobey Maguire. She also reminisces about her early acting stint in a cereal commercial.

videos.title: Jude Law, Edie Falco
videos.overview: Jude Law debuts on “Ellen,” discussing his recent acquisition of two puppies, his upcoming films, and their shared roller-coaster adventure. Edie Falco’s first Season 2 appearance focuses on her iconic role in “The Sopranos,” her Emmy nomination, and her beloved dog Marley.

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Jennifer Coolidge, Country Cook Hazel Smith
videos.overview: Charlie Sheen visits the “Ellen” show to promote “Two and a Half Men,” and shares anecdotes about his daughters, dogs, and arachnophobia. Ellen continues her culinary education with Country Cook Hazel Smith. Jennifer Coolidge joins Ellen to discuss her career journey and her role on Matt LeBlanc’s show “Joey.”

videos.title: Jon Stewart, Elaine Stritch, Oliver Hudson
videos.overview: Jon Stewart discusses his recent Emmy wins, fatherhood, and news influence. Oliver Hudson chats about family, acting, and nicknames. Elaine Stritch celebrates her Emmy win with Ellen.

videos.title: Gwyneth Paltrow, Mark McGrath, Book Store Antics
videos.overview: Ellen explores audience interests at a bookstore for her show's second season. Gwyneth Paltrow introduces her daughter Apple, while Ellen investigates about a gift she gave. Mark McGrath joins Ellen for a chat.

videos.title: David Spade, Laura Dern
videos.overview: David Spade discusses his crush on Ellen, their hairstyles, birthdays, and concert outing with Kaley Cuoco. Laura Dern, expecting her second child, chats about her son’s bug fascination, pregnancy, and upcoming film with Mark Ruffalo on Ellen’s show.

videos.title: Naomi Watts, Angela Bassett, Cooking with Halibut
videos.overview: Naomi Watts dishes on filming “King Kong” in New Zealand, her mac and cheese recipe, thoughts on “I Heart Huckabees,” and accent mastery on Ellen’s show. Angela Bassett shares insights on portraying Tina Turner, her fitness journey, and Tina’s support on “Ellen.” Ellen teams up with a top chef to whip up mouthwatering halibut.

videos.title: Lauren Graham, Peter Boyle
videos.overview: Lauren Graham engages in a lively conversation about “Gilmore Girls” and her beloved dog while also demonstrating a movie stunt. During the episode, Ellen is delighted with her very own “Ellen” Cabbage Patch Kid, which becomes a recurring presence. Additionally, Peter Boyle fondly reflects on his Emmys mishaps and the poignant finale of “Everybody Loves Raymond.”

videos.title: Amy Brenneman, Bachelor Byron Velvick
videos.overview: Ellen delves into coffee, cats, and turning 40 with Amy Brenneman from “Judging Amy.” Byron Velvick, the new Bachelor, discusses his show experience and pro bass fishing career.

videos.title: Donald Trump, LL Cool J
videos.overview: Donald Trump discusses germaphobia and showcases his diverse product range alongside fiancée Melania. LL Cool J debuts in 2004, sharing workout insights and his hat obsession. Ellen engages audiences with a quirky game, pairing the idiosyncrasy with the correct guest.

videos.title: Lance Armstrong, The Unforgettable Charlotte ‘Kitty’ Pope
videos.overview: Meet the unforgettable Charlotte ‘Kitty’ Pope, a Season 1 sensation on "Ellen" for her adorable reaction to loud music. Lance Armstrong joins Ellen post his 6th Tour de France victory, reflecting on the race and the iconic Livestrong bracelets' impact.

videos.title: Rob Lowe, Fran Drescher
videos.overview: Ellen makes Rob Lowe’s dream come true, sending him down a big slide after chatting about his love of coffee and RV trips. Fran Drescher shares her hilarious dating stories and health journey on her birthday during her first appearance in 2004.

videos.title: John Travolta
videos.overview: Ellen sits down with John Travolta for a heartwarming and hilarious conversation. They dive into a range of topics, from John's passion for aviation to some of their most endearing personal stories. To top it all off, they engage in a fun and competitive firefighter-themed challenge to see who can gear up the fastest.

videos.title: Leah Remini
videos.overview: Leah Remini discusses her pregnancy, childbirth on VH1, and her love of labels. Ellen visits Leah's home to meet her new daughter and lend a helping hand.

videos.title: Tyra Banks, Martin Short, Rock Climber Aron Ralston
videos.overview: Martin Short stops by to promote “Jiminy Glick in Lalawood,” bringing his trademark hilarity. Mountain climber Aron Ralston shares his harrowing survival story and book. Tyra Banks teaches Ellen the art of modeling.

videos.title: Jerry O'Connell, Molly Sims
videos.overview: Jerry O’Connell returns to showcase his dance moves, discuss his modeling career, and share stories about his accidental bobblehead collection. Molly Sims makes her debut, reminiscing about meeting Ellen, judging a legs competition, and sharing her signature Hamburger Helper dish.

videos.title: Wanda Sykes, Carl Reiner
videos.overview: Wanda Sykes delivers a hilarious take on turning 40 and her reality TV obsession, while Carl Reiner shares his secret to a lasting marriage, his first TV job, and his quirky dental routine.

videos.title: Ray Romano, Kaley Cuoco
videos.overview: Ray Romano hilariously discusses his fear of dancing, the finale of "Everybody Loves Raymond," and makes a bet with Ellen. Meanwhile, Kaley Cuoco reminisces about meeting Ellen at age 10, shares a concert story with David Spade, and talks about her new rescue pets.

videos.title: Hilary Duff, Taye Diggs
videos.overview: Ellen and Taye Diggs discuss dancing styles and Taye gives Ellen some lessons. Hilary Duff visits Ellen to talk about her 17th birthday in Cabo, being homeschooled, and shows Ellen some trampoline tricks.

videos.title: Jimmy Fallon, Kyra Sedgwick
videos.overview: Jimmy Fallon discusses leaving "Saturday Night Live," promoting his new movie "Taxi" with Queen Latifah, and shares his hilarious impressions. Kyra Sedgwick talks about her indecisiveness, tabloid stories, and takes an out-of-this-world trip with Ellen during her first appearance.

videos.title: Nick Lachey, Annette Bening
videos.overview: Annette Bening shares a hilarious story about visiting her childhood home with Warren Beatty and Jack Nicholson, discusses her kids, and her face inspiring the Columbia Pictures logo. Nick Lachey talks about his anniversary, "Newlyweds," guest-starring on "Charmed," and his Cabbage Patch dolls.

videos.title: Robin Williams
videos.overview: Ellen kicks off the episode by dancing with her audience and checking in on viewers at home. Robin Williams, in his second appearance, shares memories of Christopher Reeve, discusses his unique wine blend gift for Ellen, and reveals his surprising high school superlative.

videos.title: Drew Carey, Kelly Perston
videos.overview: Kelly Preston chats with Ellen about Halloween costumes, trying out for the football team, and growing up in Hawaii, while also teaching Ellen to hula. Drew Carey reveals why he still wears his iconic glasses post-LASIK, shares funny Johnny Carson stories, and discusses his "Green Screen Show."

videos.title: Queen Latifah, Rupert Everett
videos.overview: Queen Latifah, known for her relentless work ethic, shares how she relaxes, talks about hosting “Saturday Night Live,” and engages in a “scat-off” with Ellen. Rupert Everett also joins Ellen for a catch-up in this Season 2 episode.

videos.title: Martin Sheen, Drea de Matteo
videos.overview: Martin Sheen reveals his real name, gushes about his new granddaughter Sam, and shares an incredible story about being challenged by Michael Jordan. Plus, Ellen and Martin shoot some hoops! Drea de Matteo also joins Ellen to catch up and chat about “The Sopranos.”

videos.title: Susan Sarandon, Dermot Mulroney
videos.overview: Academy Award winner Susan Sarandon talks about her partner Tim Robbins, living in New York City, and her new Revlon commercial, along with footage from her very first commercial. Dermot Mulroney also makes his debut that year, discussing the film he made with Ellen, meeting his then-wife Catherine Keener, and performing a cello duet with Ellen.

videos.title: Rod Stewart, Christina Applegate
videos.overview: Ellen chats with Christina Applegate about her singing cat, potty mouth, and Broadway plans, followed by a Dance Dance Revolution showdown. Rod Stewart also catches up with Ellen to talk about music and life.

videos.title: Serena Williams, Jason Alexander
videos.overview: The hilarious Jason Alexander discusses being Ellen’s neighbor and reveals his first job at 15, and then he shows off his roller-skating skills. Serena Williams talks about her recent wins, clothing line, and new book, and also plays badminton with Ellen.

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel, Courtney Thorne-Smith
videos.overview: In his first appearance on “Ellen”, Jimmy Kimmel discusses his health, Halloween, and his late-night show. Courtney Thorne-Smith also joins Ellen for a chat and catch-up.

videos.title: Amanda Bynes, Anthony LaPaglia
videos.overview: Anthony LaPaglia discusses his Golden Globe win, his baby girl, and betting against himself. Amanda Bynes, in her second appearance, talks about her new show “What I Like About You” and living with her parents.

videos.title: James Spader, Debbie Reynolds
videos.overview: Ellen chats with James Spader about his Emmy win and “Boston Legal,” then talks with Debbie Reynolds about her first kiss with Gene Kelly, “Halloweentown High,” and performing “Singin’ in the Rain.”

videos.title: Season 2 Halloween Show: Alyssa Milano, David Copperfield
videos.overview: Ellen becomes Scarlett O’Hara, Alyssa Milano dresses as Princess Leia to discuss her love of dressing up, her dog, charity work, and “Charmed,” while David Copperfield performs a mind-bending trick and talks about dealing with haters.

videos.title: Roseanne Barr, Orlando Jones, Firefighter Hero
videos.overview: Ellen chats with Roseanne Barr about her pirate outfit, Thanksgiving ballerina tradition, and grandkids. She also meets a heroic firefighter who rescued a dog from the L.A. River and catches up with Orlando Jones.

videos.title: Kevin James, Shannen Doherty
videos.overview: In Season 2, Kevin James hilariously discusses his recent wedding, gym experiences, and “The King of Queens,” while Shannen Doherty talks about her new show and swimming with sharks. Plus, she brings a Southern delicacy for Ellen to try.

videos.title: Deidre Hall, Sherri Shepherd
videos.overview: Ellen dives into “Days of Our Lives” with Deidre Hall, discussing her character’s latest storyline, Halloween birthday, and acting out a dramatic scene. She also chats with Sherri Shepherd about pole dancing workouts, fashion shows, and a hilarious golf cart accident.

videos.title: ‘Will & Grace’ Cast
videos.overview: Ellen hosts the “Will & Grace” cast. Eric McCormack humorously recounts his Ellen underwear mishap and court experience, joined by Megan Mullally discussing her secret marriage and band adventures. Debra Messing and Sean Hayes also share show stories and past issues.

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Rachel Bilson, David Ortiz
videos.overview: Ellen faces off in a staring contest with Samuel L. Jackson. David Ortiz discusses his World Series victory, and Rachel Bilson reveals "The O.C." secrets and her Britney Spears obsession.

videos.title: Elton John, Bowling Legend Lois Morgan
videos.overview: Ser Elton John discusses his 43rd album, tabloid stories, and Las Vegas show, while Lois Morgan, age 79, talks about her experience bowling multiple perfect 300 games.

videos.title: Jamie Foxx, Jeffrey Tambor
videos.overview: Ellen interviews Jamie Foxx about his daughter, his role in “Ray,” and Tom Cruise. Later, she chats with Jeffrey Tambor about behind-the-scenes moments from “Arrested Development” and his hilarious Emmy mishap.

videos.title: Ashley Judd, ‘Finding Nemo on Ice’
videos.overview: Ashley Judd joins Ellen to talk about quitting coffee and celebrating her third wedding anniversary, and then teaches Ellen how to square dance. The cast of “Finding Nemo on Ice” also delivers a spectacular performance.

videos.title: Kate Winslet, Chad Michael Murray
videos.overview: Ellen helps Kate Winslet fulfill her dream of flying while they discuss "Finding Neverland" and her "Saturday Night Live" appearance. Chad Michael Murray talks about his engagement, new hair, and filming "One Tree Hill."

videos.title: Teri Hatcher, Freddy Adu
videos.overview: Ellen joins a lucky winner for a gambling night in New York City. Teri Hatcher discusses the success of “Desperate Housewives,” her experiences camping with her daughter, and her love of magic. Freddy Adu sits down with Ellen to talk about his life and his passion for soccer.

videos.title: Woody Harrelson, Venus Williams
videos.overview: Woody Harrelson talks with Ellen about his hiatus, living in Hawaii, and his return to Hollywood with “After the Sunset.” Venus Williams joins Ellen to discuss sibling rivalry and her passion for interior design.

videos.title: Pierce Brosnan, Matthew Fox
videos.overview: Pierce Brosnan makes his first appearance and discusses his baby girl, portraying James Bond, and his new movie with Salma Hayek. Meanwhile, Matthew Fox visits in 2004, reenacting a scene from “Lost.”

videos.title: Alicia Keys, Allison Janney
videos.overview: Ellen and Allison Janney reminisce about their first meeting, gush over Allison’s new puppy, and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from “The West Wing.” Plus, they compete in a hilarious obstacle course race. Alicia Keys talks about her hit song with Usher and her unforgettable AMA performance. She also surprises Ellen with her kickboxing skills.

videos.title: John Goodman, Felicity Huffman
videos.overview: John Goodman humorously discusses moving to New Orleans, his commercial work, and his new show. Felicity Huffman talks about “Desperate Housewives” and real-life motherhood.

videos.title: Matt LeBlanc, Denise Richards, Trump’s Boardroom
videos.overview: Matt LeBlanc talks with Ellen about life after “Friends,” and his sitcom “Joey.” Denise Richards opens up about posing for Playboy. Ellen and Houston hilariously compete in Donald Trump’s boardroom.

videos.title: Jamie Lee Curtis, Fantasia
videos.overview: Jamie Lee Curtis celebrates her birthday with Ellen, discussing change, sharing a sweet memory of her mom, and her new movie “Christmas with the Kranks.” Fantasia also joins Ellen to talk about her latest music.

videos.title: Tim Allen, Eva Longoria
videos.overview: Tim Allen shares secrets about “Christmas with the Kranks” and his Walk of Fame star, and performs a shoe-tying stunt. Eva Longoria teaches Ellen to salsa, reminisces about Texas pageants, and discusses “Desperate Housewives.”

videos.title: Tom Hanks
videos.overview: In 2004, Tom Hanks chats with Ellen about Thanksgiving traditions and his roles in "The Polar Express." Ellen later dedicates the "Riff-Raff Room" to him and surprises military families with heartfelt messages.

videos.title: Brad Garrett, Jason Mraz, Carly Patterson
videos.overview: Everybody loves him too, actor Brad Garrett stops by. Singer/songwriter Jason Mraz performs "You and I Both" from his CD "Tonight, Not Again." Also, gold medalist Carly Patterson and The US Women's Olympic Gymnastic Team chat with Ellen.

videos.title: Jude Law, Ty Pennington
videos.overview: Jude Law chats with Ellen about being named "Sexiest Man Alive," his family life, vacations in Mexico, his role in "Closer," and heartwarming stories about his children. Ty Pennington also joins to showcase a stunning luxury makeover from "Extreme Makeover: Home Edition."

videos.title: Colin Farrell, Lenny Kravitz
videos.overview: Colin Farrell joins Ellen to clear up rumors, curse for charity, and lead a fun country line-dance lesson. Lenny Kravitz also stops by for a lively catch-up session with Ellen.

videos.title: Robert Downey Jr., Christine Lahti
videos.overview: Robert Downey Jr. joins Ellen to discuss his engagement, share insights into his music, and reveal details about his latest CD. Later, Christine Lahti sits down with Ellen for a chat.

videos.title: Angelina Jolie, Snoop Dogg
videos.overview: Angelina Jolie returns to “Ellen” to discuss her adorable son, pilot’s license, and newest back tattoo, while Snoop Dogg makes his debut after performing “Drop It Like It’s Hot,” talks working with Pharrell, and creates original phrases with Ellen.

videos.title: Day 1 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Hilary Swank, Alan Alda, Close-Up Magic
videos.overview: Hilary Swank chats with Ellen about her 30th birthday bash, her Academy Award-winning role in “Million Dollar Baby,” and her beloved pets. Ellen and company are wowed by Jason Randall’s close-up magic tricks, and Alan Alda joins Ellen to catch up and discuss his career.

videos.title: Day 2 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, William H. Macy
videos.overview: Julia Louis-Dreyfus discusses the legacy of “Seinfeld,” her infamous dance, awkward fan encounters, and love of regifting in her first appearance. William H. Macy also makes his debut, sharing his passion for woodworking, his wife Felicity, and his commercial work.

videos.title: Day 3 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Amy Poehler, Kevin Kline
videos.overview: Kevin Kline chats with Ellen about his latest movie and the surge of people named Kevin. Amy Poehler shares her nerves debuting on Weekend Update with Tina Fey, funny “SNL” memories with Ellen, and some of her best impressions.

videos.title: Day 4 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Liam Neeson, George Lopez
videos.overview: Liam Neeson discusses his love of toothpicks, his wife Natasha Richardson, and his new movie. George Lopez chats about his sitcom, recent weight loss, wife Ann, and his new Christmas movie.

videos.title: Day 5 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Natalie Portman, Garry Marshall
videos.overview: Natalie Portman opens up to Ellen about a recent plane scare, learning pole dancing for “Closer,” and graduating from Harvard. Garry Marshall shares about Hollywood memories, his new hip, a memorable nude scene, and directing “Princess Diaries 2.”

videos.title: Day 6 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Zach Braff, Parker Posey
videos.overview: Zach Braff discusses his new movie “Garden State” and drunk-dialing a critic, and then performs a magic trick. Parker Posey talks about playing a vampire and working on “Coneheads,” and also receives a unique ornament from Ellen in her 2004 debut.

videos.title: Day 7 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Jane Kaczmarek, Jesse Metcalfe
videos.overview: Jane Kaczmarek shares exclusive stories from “Malcolm in the Middle” and funny memories of her dad. Jesse Metcalfe discusses his time on “Desperate Housewives” and the thrill of buying his first house.

videos.title: Day 8 of 12 Days of Giveaways, John Cryer, Jessica Biel
videos.overview: Jon Cryer discusses “Two and a Half Men” and Halloween with his son, Jerry Gordon performs an original song for Ellen, and Jessica Biel talks about training for “Blade: Trinity” and filming horror movies during her first appearance.

videos.title: Day 9 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Stevie Wonder, Andy Dick
videos.overview: Stevie Wonder opens up about his annual Christmas charity party. Andy Dick talks about his 39th birthday and updates us on his house construction during his first appearance.

videos.title: Day 10 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Melina Kanakaredes, Mekhi Phifer
videos.overview: Melina Kanakaredes from “CSI: New York” discusses the Emmys, teaching her kids Greek traditions, and the unique aspects of filming with her children on set. Meanwhile, Mekhi Phifer from “ER” talks about his annual party, celebrity poker tournaments, and life with his 5-year-old son.

videos.title: Day 11 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Lindsay Lohan, Jeff Bridges
videos.overview: Jeff Bridges discusses how he met his wife and his latest film, “Door in the Floor.” Lindsay Lohan also joins Ellen to talk about her album “Speak,” her experience with exhaustion, and her holiday plans.

videos.title: Day 12 of 12 Days of Giveaways, Céline Dion, Justin Timberlake, Freddie Highmore
videos.overview: Céline Dion discusses her 10th wedding anniversary, family, and musical journey; 12-year-old Freddie Highmore talks about "Finding Neverland" and his musical talent; and Justin Timberlake surprises everyone by revealing his identity as the "12 Days" Mascot.

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Sara Rue
videos.overview: Ben Stiller discusses filming "Meet the Fockers," working with babies, and collaborating with Barbra Streisand. Meanwhile, Sara Rue shares her experience hosting a talk show, a funny audition mishap with Stiller, and the quirks of kissing every co-star on "Less Than Perfect."

videos.title: Dustin Hoffman, Carmen Electra
videos.overview: Dustin Hoffman discusses “Meet the Fockers” and a heroic vacation moment, while Carmen Electra shares her New Year’s resolutions and honeymoon plans. Ellen reflects on New Year’s, allergies, and the new babies on staff.

videos.title: Laura Prepon, Bradley Whitford
videos.overview: Bradley Whitford discusses his role on “The West Wing” and shares some impressive party tricks, while Nicole Petera from the San Diego Zoo showcases her incredible bird-calling skills. Laura Prepon talks about dyeing her hair, her love for poker, and her time on “That ’70s Show,” and plays a fun round of “Mad Gab.”

videos.title: Jeff Goldblum, Emma Roberts
videos.overview: Academy Award winner Jeff Goldblum reminisces with Ellen about their past encounters, his role on "Will & Grace," and his hidden talents, while a 13-year-old Emma Roberts discusses her Nickelodeon show "Unfabulous" and her famous aunt, Julia Roberts.

videos.title: Dennis Quaid, Jill Hennessy
videos.overview: Dennis Quaid shares the surprising story of how his assistant bought Ellen’s first house, discusses his son’s first cell phone, and leaves a hilarious voicemail during the show. Jill Hennessy also joins Ellen to chat about her career and latest updates.

videos.title: Nicole Kidman, Jimmy Buffett
videos.overview: The incredible Nicole Kidman made her “Ellen” debut, chatting about parenting, changing her accent, and knowing Russell Crowe and Naomi Watts since age 15. Legendary Jimmy Buffett followed, performing “Margaritaville” and discussing “Parrotheads” and his new book.

videos.title: Betty White, Don Cheadle, Kratt Brothers
videos.overview: Join Ellen as she sits down with Don Cheadle, who reveals how he almost missed out on his iconic role in “Hotel Rwanda.” Betty White opens up about birthdays and her memorable skinny-dipping scene. Plus, the Kratt Brothers explore wildlife adventures with Ellen.

videos.title: Scarlett Johansson, Carl Reiner
videos.overview: Join Ellen as she welcomes 20-year-old Scarlett Johansson, discussing her Golden Globe nomination and filming in New Orleans with John Travolta. Ellen also seeks out a roving reporter from Wisconsin for a special job. Plus, Carl Reiner shares laughs about “Ocean’s 12” and his 62-year marriage.

videos.title: Steve Harvey, Teri Polo
videos.overview: Steve Harvey shares stories of working out with Janet Jackson's trainer and celebrating Denzel Washington's 50th, while Teri Polo reveals behind-the-scenes moments from "Meet the Fockers," and Ellen preps Charlotte Pope for the Golden Globes red carpet.

videos.title: Michael Keaton, Oliver Platt
videos.overview: Ellen discusses the art of giving compliments and reads letters from viewers. Later, Michael Keaton talks about his film "White Noise" and Oliver Platt shares his excitement about his Golden Globe nomination and his multilingual upbringing.

videos.title: Ryan Seacrest, James Denton
videos.overview: Ryan Seacrest talks about his journey with "American Idol" and receives a surprise makeover. Then, James Denton discusses his role on "Desperate Housewives," fatherhood, and how he began his acting career.

videos.title: Topher Grace, Evangeline Lilly
videos.overview: Ellen's Charlotte ‘Kitty’ Pope reports from the 2005 Golden Globes, Topher Grace discusses his final season of "That 70’s Show" and hosting "SNL," while Evangeline Lilly makes her debut, talking "Lost" and surviving 8 car accidents.

videos.title: Susan Sarandon, Enrique Murciano
videos.overview: Susan Sarandon discusses the Golden Globes, her stance on plastic surgery, and her role in "The Exonerated." Later, Enrique Murciano chats with Ellen about his role on "Without a Trace."

videos.title: Barry Manilow, Maria Bello
videos.overview: Barry Manilow discusses his lucrative tour, past work on famous jingles, and his low-key lifestyle, while Maria Bello makes her debut appearance, sharing the story of getting her first tattoo with her dad in 2005.

videos.title: Minnie Driver, Treat Williams
videos.overview: Minnie Driver shares her experience filming "Phantom of the Opera" in a corset and plays a hilarious celebrity game rematch, while Treat Williams from "Everwood" chats with Ellen about his career and latest projects.

videos.title: Jimmy Smits, Joan Lunden
videos.overview: Jimmy Smits discusses his Puerto Rican upbringing, learning Spanish, and his role on "The West Wing," while Emmy award winner Joan Lunden talks about hosting a new reality show and life with two sets of twins.

videos.title: Ice Cube, Bachelorette Jen Schefft
videos.overview: Ice Cube makes a memorable first appearance with Ellen to discuss his movie "Are We There Yet?" along with his kids and music, while Jenn Schefft opens up about her experiences on "The Bachelor" and "The Bachelorette."

videos.title: Ellen’s Birthday, Paris Hilton
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates her birthday by shopping for others at the 99 cent store, and Paris Hilton joins the fun, giving Ellen a fashion makeover while chatting about “The Simple Life” and her busy acting career.

videos.title: Helen Hunt, Paul Reiser, Elisabeth Shue
videos.overview: Paul Reiser and Helen Hunt reunite on “Ellen” for a nostalgic game of “What’s My Next Line,” reliving classic “Mad About You” moments, while Elisabeth Shue stops by to discuss her latest movie.

videos.title: Kelly Clarkson, Bonnie Hunt
videos.overview: Ellen sends her team on a road trip to the 2005 Super Bowl, chats with Bonnie Hunt about rescue dogs and her Swiffer sponsorship, and welcomes Kelly Clarkson discussing her hit “Since U Been Gone” and her new home.

videos.title: Susan Lucci, Tara Reid
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates Susan Lucci receiving her star on the Walk of Fame, honors a brave 5-year-old who saved his dad’s life, and helps Tara Reid search for a boyfriend.

videos.title: Amy Brenneman, Faith Ford
videos.overview: “Judging Amy” star Amy Brenneman chats about her second pregnancy and plays a fun game with Ellen, while “Hope & Faith” star Faith Ford discusses navigating the Internet, celebrating a big birthday, and her new cookbook.

videos.title: Aisha Tyler, Garry Shandling
videos.overview: Ellen interviews Garry Shandling, the genius behind "The Larry Sanders Show." Aisha Tyler chats about balancing her roles on "24" and "CSI," the challenges of stand-up comedy, and her New Year's resolutions.

videos.title: Kiefer Sutherland, Poppy Montgomery
videos.overview: Ellen, intrigued by the supernatural, visits her local psychic. Kiefer Sutherland shares stories about his full name, famous roommates, and becoming a grandpa at 38. Later, Poppy Montgomery discusses her full name and new boyfriend.

videos.title: Cate Blanchett, Peter Gallagher
videos.overview: Cate Blanchett joins Ellen to discuss playing Katharine Hepburn in “The Aviator” and mastering accents, and then receives a special good luck charm. Later, Peter Gallagher stops by to talk about his role in “The O.C.” and shares behind-the-scenes stories from the hit series.

videos.title: Leah Remini, Ashanti
videos.overview: Leah Remini stops by to chat about “The King of Queens,” the People’s Choice Awards, and her new baby. Ellen reunites a military couple married just six days before deployment, and Ashanti teaches Ellen the long jump after discussing her role in “Coach Carter.”

videos.title: Lauren Graham, Alex Trebek
videos.overview: Ellen and Lauren Graham celebrate the 100th episode of “Gilmore Girls,” while Alex Trebek joins Ellen for the first time to discuss “Celebrity Jeopardy!” and share some of Ellen’s hilarious answer suggestions.

videos.title: Tina Turner, Martin Sheen
videos.overview: Martin Sheen discusses “The West Wing,” becoming a grandfather, and growing up in a large family, before Ellen tests his presidential knowledge. Later, the legendary Tina Turner joins Ellen for a chat.

videos.title: Thomas Haden Church, Debra Messing
videos.overview: Ellen surprises Greg Z.'s wife with an early Valentine’s Day treat, chats with Debra Messing about her 10-month-old son and "The Wedding Date," and sits down with Thomas Haden Church for a lively conversation.

videos.title: William Shatner, Rosie Perez, Avril Lavigne
videos.overview: In 2005, William Shatner makes his first appearance to discuss his Golden Globe win for "Boston Legal" and his new show "Invasion Iowa." Meanwhile, Rosie Perez joins in Season 2 to chat about dancing and her role in "Lackawanna Blues."

videos.title: Laura Linney, Allison Janney
videos.overview: Allison Janney shares her sweet engagement story and Valentine’s Day plans, while Laura Linney discusses her Oscar nomination and plays Mad Libs to prepare for her acceptance speech!

videos.title: Usher, Dennis Franz, Mo’Nique
videos.overview: Usher reflects on his 2005 Grammy performance and celebrating with Ellen, while Dennis Franz discusses the final season of “NYPD Blue.” Mo’Nique shares her comedy journey, and Ellen highlights a mom who adopted 12 kids.

videos.title: Simon Cowell, Sean Astin
videos.overview: Simon Cowell discusses his feuds and friendship with Paula Abdul on “American Idol” before playing a game with the audience. Sean Astin shares his experience as King Bacchus at Mardi Gras and talks about his film “Bigger Than the Sky.”

videos.title: Noah Wyle, Emily Procter
videos.overview: Ellen chats with “ER” star Noah Wyle about his time on the show and his proposal story, and then plays a fun game of “What’s That, Doc?” Later, she catches up with actress Emily Procter.

videos.title: Jamie Kennedy, Nicollette Sheridan
videos.overview: Nicollette Sheridan chats with Ellen about “Desperate Housewives,” her British roots, and piercing her own ear. Later, she and Jamie Kennedy mix conversation with a bit of friendly competition.

videos.title: Ray Romano, Nicole Richie
videos.overview: Ray Romano visits Ellen to discuss dancing and filming the finale of “Everybody Loves Raymond.” Later, Nicole Richie returns to chat about “The Simple Life” and her recent engagement.

videos.title: Chris Rock, Peter Boyle
videos.overview: Ellen chats with Chris Rock about hosting the Oscars and fatherhood, and then plays Oscar trivia with the audience. Later, Peter Boyle talks life after “Everybody Loves Raymond,” and Ellen gives his iconic eyebrows a trim.

videos.title: Patricia Heaton, Benjamin McKenzie
videos.overview: Patricia Heaton visits to discuss the finale of “Everybody Loves Raymond,” her battle with laryngitis, and her future plans. Later, Benjamin McKenzie from “The OC” joins her to chat about his rise to fame before taking the plunge in the dunk tank for Ellen!

videos.title: Sean Hayes, Bob Newhart
videos.overview: Ellen chats with Sean Hayes about his Chicago roots, "Will & Grace," and his high school class clown days, complete with a hilarious fake trip demonstration. Later, Bob Newhart joins to discuss his Chicago statue, 40-year marriage, and play a round of Chicago trivia!

videos.title: Brad Garrett, Cast of '90210'
videos.overview: "Everybody Loves Raymond" star Brad Garrett stops by to discuss the show's finale and his recent medical scare, while Ellen helps him with a new gig. Later, "90210" stars Luke Perry and Jennie Garth reunite, share stories of working together again, and get surprised by a special guest.

videos.title: Diane Sawyer, Jeffrey Tambor
videos.overview: Ellen sits down with Diane Sawyer to discuss her most embarrassing moment, swimming with sharks, and a funny story from her America's Junior Miss win. Later, "Arrested Development" star Jeffrey Tambor shares the joy and exhaustion of welcoming a son and grandson just days apart.

videos.title: Vince Vaughn, Missy Elliott
videos.overview: Ellen welcomes Vince Vaughn for his first appearance, where he discusses quitting smoking and has a dance-off with the audience. She also surprises a 10-year-old cancer survivor, while Missy Elliott talks about her new reality show and bold fashion choices.

videos.title: John Travolta, Faye Dunaway
videos.overview: Ellen chats with John Travolta about his journey into show business, hidden talents, and Grammy plans while also testing the audience’s dancing skills. She also sits down with Faye Dunaway to discuss her Oscars and mentoring on “The Starlet.”

videos.title: Jennifer Love Hewitt, Gerard Butler
videos.overview: Jennifer Love Hewitt reflects on turning 26 and her reluctance to grow up while promoting her new movie, "Confessions of a Sociopathic Social Climber." Meanwhile, Gerard Butler discusses his Scottish upbringing and learning to sing for his role in "Phantom of the Opera."

videos.title: Vin Diesel/3 Doors Down/Annasophia Robb
videos.overview: VIN DIESEL (""The Pacifier"") shows Ellen how to be a bouncer in New York City.  3 DOORS DOWN plays their latest hit ""Let Me Go"" from their #1 CD ""Seventeen Days."" And 11-year-old, ANNASOPHIA ROBB (""Because of Winn Dixie"") shares her fresh perspective on Hollywood.

videos.title: Dwayne Johnson, Vanessa Marcil
videos.overview: Dwayne Johnson shares stories of vacationing with his daughter in Hawaii, his new film “Be Cool,” and his favorite cheat meal, while Vanessa Marcil discusses hosting the Daytime Emmys and a grocery store fan encounter. Plus, she calls co-star James Caan.

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Constance Marie
videos.overview: Ellen talks with Bruce Willis about fatherhood, his daughters, and dating while he promotes his film “Hostage” and reflects on being her first-ever guest. Later, Constance Marie joins to chat, share laughs, and show off her dance moves.

videos.title: Penelope Cruz, Carson Daly
videos.overview: In their first appearances, Penelope Cruz discusses her new films “Don’t Move” and “Sahara,” along with her unique ways of managing nerves and a scary plane ride with Salma Hayek, while Carson Daly shares his dance struggles and transition from “TRL” to late night.

videos.title: Mel Gibson, Joan Allen
videos.overview: Mel Gibson joins Ellen to talk about raising seven kids, buying his own island, and his groundbreaking work on “The Passion of the Christ.” Later, Joan Allen sits down with Ellen, who surprises her with an unexpected gift.

videos.title: Barry Manilow, Maria Bello (Re-run)
videos.overview: Barry Manilow discusses his lucrative tour, past work on famous jingles, and his low-key lifestyle, while Maria Bello makes her debut appearance, sharing the story of getting her first tattoo with her dad in 2005.

videos.title: Kristen Bell, Michael Chiklis
videos.overview: Michael Chiklis and Kristen Bell make their first appearances on the “Ellen” show. Chiklis discusses his “Fantastic Four” transformation, a recent home renovation, and a fire, while Bell shares stories about her Polish heritage and rescuing dogs, joined by her mom and sister.

videos.title: Glenn Close, Kevin Pollak
videos.overview: Glenn Close drops in to share a hilarious embarrassing story from her early Hollywood days, while Kevin Pollak joins the show for a chat.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer, Brian Williams
videos.overview: Kelsey Grammer showcases his headstand skills while singing the “Frasier” theme song and sharing insights about his new baby and sketch comedy show. Plus, NBC Nightly News Anchor Brian Williams chats about stepping into Tom Brokaw's shoes and plays “Musical News” with Ellen.

videos.title: John Stamos, Christina Milian
videos.overview: John Stamos makes his first appearance to discuss relationships, his new show, and shares an embarrassing story about his mom, while Christina Milian stops by to teach Ellen how to "Pop That Thing" and recounts her recent trip to Japan.

videos.title: Adrien Brody, Sherri Shepherd
videos.overview: Oscar winner Adrien Brody visits for the first time to discuss his infamous kisses, life after the Academy Award, and his adorable chihuahua, while the hilarious Sherri Shepherd stops by to chat about her pregnancy and her new movie with Queen Latifah.

videos.title: Andie MacDowell, Mike O’Malley
videos.overview: Andie MacDowell talks about her children following in her footsteps and her creative role in “Beauty Shop,” while Mike O’Malley chats with Ellen about his parenting journey, fulfilling a promise to her, and his show “Yes, Dear.”

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher, Julie Bowen
videos.overview: Ellen chats with Ashton Kutcher about his “Punk’d” pranks, hosting “SNL,” co-parenting with Demi Moore, and his new film with Bernie Mac. Julie Bowen joins to discuss her new show, working with John Stamos, and saving turtles on her honeymoon in Costa Rica.

videos.title: Elijah Wood, Florence Henderson
videos.overview: Elijah Wood opens up about his long Venice commute, New Year’s resolution check-in, and his impressive 33-film career. Legendary Florence Henderson also stops by to discuss “The Brady Bunch” and her own parenting style, and she even challenges Ellen to a dance-off!

videos.title: Sandra Bullock, Chris Kattan
videos.overview: In her first appearance, the talented Sandra Bullock joins Ellen to celebrate her 300th show, discussing life in Austin, Texas, her Walk of Fame star, and her new movie "Miss Congeniality 2." Comedian Chris Kattan also makes a hilarious debut, reenacting his favorite Ellen moment.

videos.title: Bernie Mac, Reba McEntire
videos.overview: Bernie Mac brings laughs as he discusses wild rumors, his new movie with Ashton Kutcher, and a possible “Punk’D” prank, while Reba McEntire shares about turning 50, winning “Mother of the Year,” and launching her clothing line.

videos.title: Queen Latifah, Tim Daly
videos.overview: Grammy-winning actress Queen Latifah joins to discuss hosting the Emmys, her iconic hairstyles, and play a musical game with the audience. Tim Daly also stops by, sharing his dance battle with James Brown, life with sisters, and his new show “Eyes.”

videos.title: Lisa Marie Presley, Kenneth Branagh
videos.overview: Four-time Academy Award nominee Kenneth Branagh visits Ellen to chat about adjusting his accent, his school photos, and joins a fun game with the audience. Lisa Marie Presley also stops by to discuss her Vogue cover with her mother, Priscilla, and daughter, Riley, and addresses rumors of selling Graceland.

videos.title: Cynthia Nixon, John Spencer
videos.overview: Cynthia Nixon shares behind-the-scenes moments from her Emmy win, stories about her 2-year-old son, and her role as Eleanor Roosevelt, while John Spencer joins Ellen to chat about “The West Wing” and share the latest.

videos.title: Kevin Costner, Michael Clarke Duncan
videos.overview: Academy Award winner Kevin Costner visits for the first time to discuss his recent wedding, turning 50, and his new film “Upside of Anger.” Michael Clarke Duncan joins Ellen, sharing funny stories, school photos, and his favorite moves.

videos.title: Whoopi Goldberg, Regina King
videos.overview: Whoopi Goldberg chats with Ellen about her fear of flying, a wild in-flight experience, cross-country road trips, and being a proud grandma before playing the game “Whoozat?” Regina King joins to share funny “Miss Congeniality 2” stories, a perfect Sandra Bullock impression, her role in “Ray” with Jamie Foxx, and her struggles with claustrophobia.

videos.title: Brittany Murphy, Eric Idle
videos.overview: Brittany Murphy joins Ellen to chat about her driver’s license, her star-studded movie “Sin City,” and to settle their months-long “feud.” Then Eric Idle stops by to discuss turning 62, forgotten names, and performing “Spamalot” on Broadway.

videos.title: Tom Selleck, Wendie Malick
videos.overview: Tom Selleck shares a funny, awkward store encounter with Ellen before tackling the “What’s My Next Line?” challenge, testing his knowledge of iconic lines from his famous roles. Later, Wendie Malick joins Ellen for a lively chat.

videos.title: Pamela Anderson, Anthony Anderson
videos.overview: Pamela Anderson joins Ellen to discuss tabloid challenges, her role as a school lunch monitor, and plays a game with the audience. Later, Anthony Anderson and his mother stop by to share old school photos, chat about his star-studded movie, and his camel-riding adventures.

videos.title: Matthew McConaughey, Maura Tierney
videos.overview: Join Ellen for a fun-filled show as Matthew McConaughey shares life on the road in his Airstream, teaches Ellen his smooth dance moves, and delivers a grilling masterclass. Maura Tierney also stops by, spilling details about her surprising romance with her husband and sharing stories from her “ER” days.

videos.title: Ryan Seacrest, Fran Drescher
videos.overview: Ryan Seacrest chats with Ellen about the latest season of “American Idol” and his evolving style, and he even learns a magic trick! Plus, Fran Drescher joins to dish on her new show’s star-studded premiere and the time she asked out Tom Cruise.

videos.title: Anjelica Huston, Nadia Turner
videos.overview: “American Idol” alum Nadia Turner joins Ellen to chat about her journey on the show, followed by iconic actress Anjelica Huston, who shares her love for homemade jams, dance classes, and memories of her father, along with stories from directing “Riding the Bus with My Sister.”

videos.title: Jason Alexander, Amy Yasbeck
videos.overview: Jason Alexander from “Seinfeld” chats with Ellen about his new children’s book and his son’s upcoming bar mitzvah, and he even takes a dip in the Jacuzzi. Plus, Amy Yasbeck reflects on her late husband John Ritter, her new show “Life on a Stick,” and her first-ever job.

videos.title: Rob Morrow, Penny Marshall
videos.overview: Ellen welcomes a young accordion player, catches up with Penny Marshall as she hilariously re-records the show’s theme song and shares big news about her family, and chats with Rob Morrow about life and his latest projects.

videos.title: Vince Vaughn, Owen Wilson
videos.overview: Vince Vaughn and Owen Wilson join Ellen to chat about their movie “Wedding Crashers,” quitting smoking, and party-crashing adventures before taking their rivalry to the track in a thrilling go-kart race. Plus, Owen hilariously embraces his “twin” connection with Ellen!

videos.title: Ty Pennington, Dominic Monaghan
videos.overview: Ty Pennington brings the excitement of “Extreme Makeover: Home Edition” to Ellen’s stage with a surprise reveal and behind-the-scenes stories. Plus, Dominic Monaghan dishes on the finale of “Lost,” Evangeline Lilly’s driving, and his passion for pets in a must-see interview!

videos.title: Eric McCormack
videos.overview: Eric McCormack stops by to celebrate the eighth season renewal of “Will & Grace,” chat about his son, and play badminton with Ellen. Ellen also visits a post office to learn about mail processing and helps a fan live her dream of being an extra on her favorite show.

videos.title: Jay Leno, Jamie Lynn Spears
videos.overview: Jay Leno shares a hilarious story about catching his cat using spy gear, reflects on 13 years hosting “The Tonight Show,” and recalls high school mishaps. Meanwhile, Jamie Lynn Spears reveals her sister Britney’s advice, updates us on “Zoey 101,” and teaches Ellen a cheer routine.

videos.title: Betty White, Matt Dillon, Kid Inventors
videos.overview: Ellen showcases hilarious kid inventions, welcomes Matt Dillon to discuss his Swedish helicopter adventure, and has Betty White on to share laughs about babies, “The Golden Girls,” and a themed game!

videos.title: Brendan Fraser, Carmen Electra
videos.overview: Brendan Fraser charms with stories about his sons and an unexpected tumble, while Carmen Electra spices things up, teaching Ellen and her mom strip tease moves and sharing hilarious mishaps.

videos.title: Paris Hilton, Mekhi Phifer
videos.overview: Paris Hilton dishes on her horror movie, feud with Nicole Richie, and future of "The Simple Life" before joining her mom for a fun Mother’s Day game. Plus, Mekhi Phifer talks "E.R." and surprises his mom in a heartwarming moment!

videos.title: Neil Diamond, Felicity Huffman
videos.overview: Felicity Huffman joins Ellen to spill "Desperate Housewives" secrets and reflect on her groundbreaking role as a transgender woman, while Neil Diamond talks about his legendary career and why his mom claims credit for his success.

videos.title: Martin Short, Ellen Pompeo
videos.overview: Martin Short shares his hilarious Vegas gambling story and gifts Ellen a funny beach photo, while Ellen Pompeo talks about the success of "Grey's Anatomy" and how she met her husband just a month after the premiere.

videos.title: Simon Cowell, Jane Kaczmarek
videos.overview: Simon Cowell opens up about “American Idol” drama and predicts Carrie Underwood’s win, while Jane Kaczmarek shares hilarious stories, including a surprising prom night tale, in this fun-filled interview with Ellen.

videos.title: Matt LeBlanc, Doug Savant
videos.overview: Matt LeBlanc competes with Ellen in a lawn mower race, shares behind-the-scenes stories from his “Friends” spin-off, while Doug Savant surprises fans with a visit from a “Desperate Housewives” co-star during a fun conversation.

videos.title: Mariah Carey, Taye Diggs
videos.overview: Mariah Carey reveals a wardrobe malfunction that led her to borrow Ellen’s outfit, Taye Diggs spills prom secrets and teaches Ellen his dance moves, and Ellen reunites with her own prom date for a hilarious photo recreation!

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, Omar Epps
videos.overview: Jennifer Lopez cooks her favorite meal, Ropa Vieja, for Ellen with some help from a chef, while Omar Epps shares a rebellious high school story and reflects on his journey from school with Marlon Wayans to playing a doctor on "House."

videos.title: Backstreet Boys, Britney Spears & Kevin Federline
videos.overview: Britney Spears and Kevin Federline share their love story in their first joint TV interview, while the Backstreet Boys dish on their epic return, new music, and what’s next.

videos.title: Gwen Stefani, Wanda Sykes, Kirstie Alley
videos.overview: Kirstie Alley brings laughs discussing her unique name and quirky past jobs, while Wanda Sykes hilariously reveals the downsides of fame, talks “Monster-In-Law,” and even dunks an audience member!

videos.title: Ray Romano, James Denton
videos.overview: Ray Romano delivers laughs with family stories and a playful showdown with Ellen, while 5-year-old anatomy whiz Matthew Sawchuck amazes with his knowledge. Plus, James Denton stops by for a fun and candid chat!

videos.title: Carson Daly, Marcia Cross
videos.overview: Marcia Cross chats about “Desperate Housewives” and her psychology degree, then shows off some dance moves. Meanwhile, Carson Daly shares a wild injury story, discusses his late-night show, and gets the audience involved in a fun game!

videos.title: Goldie Hawn, Jimmy Smits
videos.overview: Goldie Hawn shares hilarious Vegas memories and heartfelt stories from her book, while Jimmy Smits reveals how a football injury led to Hollywood fame. Plus, don’t miss their unforgettable lightsaber duel and delightful chat with Ellen!

videos.title: Jenny McCarthy, Matthew Fox
videos.overview: Ellen dives into predictions for the “Lost” finale with Matthew Fox, surprises an inspiring advocate for at-risk youth, and chats with Jenny McCarthy about her pregnancy journey and new book.

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Jada Pinkett Smith
videos.overview: Ben Stiller and Jada Pinkett Smith share fun family stories, “Madagascar” secrets, and Jada’s Fly Girl audition. Peter Krause reflects on “Six Feet Under,” his big break, and future plans. Don’t miss the laughs, games, and fascinating insights!

videos.title: Lisa Kudrow, Linda Ellerbee
videos.overview: Lisa Kudrow shares insights from “The Comeback” and hilariously tests her memory on iconic “Friends” lines. Meanwhile, Linda Ellerbee reflects on her celebrated journalism career and fascinating encounters, including an unforgettable meeting with the inventor of nachos.

videos.title: Nelly, Helen Hunt
videos.overview: Helen Hunt chats about life in Hawaii, raising her daughter, and her role in “Empire Falls” while showing off her surfing skills. Nelly opens up about “The Longest Yard,” his St. Louis roots, and his early days working for UPS.

videos.title: Ludacris
videos.overview: Ludacris makes his debut to discuss his movie “Crash” and filming a music video in South Africa. Meanwhile, Ellen welcomes some unique guests and ends up in a hilariously messy kitchen adventure.

videos.title: Dustin Hoffman, Carmen Electra (Re-run)
videos.overview: Dustin Hoffman discusses “Meet the Fockers” and a heroic vacation moment, while Carmen Electra shares her New Year’s resolutions and honeymoon plans. Ellen reflects on New Year’s, allergies, and the new babies on staff.

videos.title: Minnie Driver, Treat Williams (Re-run)
videos.overview: Minnie Driver shares her experience filming "Phantom of the Opera" in a corset and plays a hilarious celebrity game rematch, while Treat Williams from "Everwood" chats with Ellen about his career and latest projects.

videos.title: Susan Lucci, Tara Reid (Re-run)
videos.overview: Join Ellen as she celebrates Susan Lucci receiving her star on the Walk of Fame, honors a brave 5-year-old who saved his dad’s life, and helps Tara Reid search for a boyfriend.

videos.title: Kiefer Sutherland, Poppy Montgomery (Re-run)
videos.overview: Ellen, intrigued by the supernatural, visits her local psychic. Kiefer Sutherland shares stories about his full name, famous roommates, and becoming a grandpa at 38. Later, Poppy Montgomery discusses her full name and new boyfriend.

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Jennifer Coolidge (Re-run)
videos.overview: Charlie Sheen visits the “Ellen” show to promote “Two and a Half Men,” and shares anecdotes about his daughters, dogs, and arachnophobia. Ellen continues her culinary education with Country Cook Hazel Smith. Jennifer Coolidge joins Ellen to discuss her career journey and her role on Matt LeBlanc’s show “Joey.”

videos.title: Usher, Dennis Fraz, Mo'Nique (Re-run)
videos.overview: Ellen welcomes musical sensation Usher.  The Lakers Girls are on trial in Ellen's Dance Court.  Actor Dennis Franz (NYPD Blue); Comedian Mo'Nique.

videos.title: Carrie Underwood, Russell Crowe, Constance Marie
videos.overview: Russell Crowe stops by to share “Cinderella Man” stories, unique platypus-greeting tips, and a sweet baby tale. Plus, Carrie Underwood and Constance Marie join Ellen for fun and lively conversations!

videos.title: Kevin James, Shannen Doherty (Re-run)
videos.overview: Ellen chats with actor and comedian Kevin James (King of Queens) and actress Shannen Doherty (Beverly Hills, 90210; Charmed). Plus Ellen gives birthing tips to an expectant viewer.

videos.title: Aisha Tyler, Garry Shandling (Re-run)
videos.overview: Watch Ellen’s hilarious Season 2 interview with Garry Shandling, the genius behind "The Larry Sanders Show." Aisha Tyler chats about balancing her roles on "24" and "CSI," the challenges of stand-up comedy, and her New Year's resolutions.

videos.title: Jeff Gordon, The Very Real Women of Dove
videos.overview: After winning his third Daytona 500, Jeff Gordon chats with Ellen about speeding tickets and backseat driving. Ellen also speaks with the Red Cross CEO about New Orleans relief efforts and meets women who’ve bared it all in national ads.

videos.title: Alicia Keys, Ray Romano
videos.overview: Ellen joins Ray Romano and Brad Garrett for a hilarious day on the golf course, then sits down with Alicia Keys for an outdoor chat you won’t want to miss!

videos.title: Hilary Duff, Debra Messing
videos.overview: Debra Messing joins Ellen to discuss Harry Connick Jr., life as a mom, and the chaos of live TV, all while hilariously struggling to stay professional. Hilary Duff also returns to catch up with Ellen.

videos.title: George Lopez, Cast of ‘The OC’
videos.overview: Ellen surprises a superfan with a behind-the-scenes adventure on the set of “The OC” and an unforgettable cast interview. Plus, George Lopez shares the touching story of his wife saving his life and his influential achievements.

videos.title: Kanye West, Jeff Foxworthy
videos.overview: Jeff Foxworthy chats with Ellen about his record-breaking comedy albums, their stand-up club days, and his return to a simple life in Georgia. Plus, Kanye West joins to discuss his music and incredible success.

videos.title: David Spade, Tommy Lee
videos.overview: David Spade hilariously explains why Ellen wasn’t invited to his birthday party and gets a jaw-dropping surprise. Then, 6-year-old genius Matthew Sawchuck amazes with his astronomy knowledge, and Tommy Lee discusses college life at 42 and more!

videos.title: Lauren Graham, Jeffrey Tambor
videos.overview: Lauren Graham chats with Ellen about moving, presenting at the Emmys, and the latest season of “Gilmore Girls.” Then, Jeffrey Tambor shares stories about his 9-month-old, his “Arrested Development” Emmy nomination, and perfecting his “losing face.”

videos.title: Melanie Griffith, Chris O’Donnell
videos.overview: Melanie Griffith shares stories about Antonio Banderas, tattoos, and Dakota Johnson, while Chris O'Donnell reflects on starting acting at 13 and iconic roles. Plus, Ellen’s hilarious Costco trip brings chaos and laughter to Orange County aisles!

videos.title: Gwenyth Paltrow, Leah Remini
videos.overview: Leah Remini chats about her baby’s funny words and receives a Lifetime Achievement Award, while Ellen and Gwyneth Paltrow hilariously go door-to-door promoting her movie “Proof.”

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Cynthia Nixon
videos.overview: Charlie Sheen opens up about life at 40, quitting smoking, and parenting his daughters, while Cynthia Nixon reminisces about Emmy moments, shares her love for horseback riding, and surprises Ellen with a special hosting gift.

videos.title: Felicity Huffman, Megan Mullally
videos.overview: Felicity Huffman shares her Emmy win and a party mishap, Megan Mullally discusses her Emmy injury and win, and Blythe Danner reflects on her Emmy success, Gwyneth Paltrow, and welcoming her newest grandchild, Apple.

videos.title: Donald Trump, Paul Reiser, Peter Falk
Johnny Knoxville, Carla Gugino
videos.overview: Johnny Knoxville shares stories about his wildest stunts, new movie, and life with his 9-year-old daughter, while Carla Gugino discusses filming her spooky new show, extraterrestrial encounters, and living in a tepee at age 5.

videos.title: James Denton, Rachel Weisz
videos.overview: James Denton chats about “Desperate Housewives,” guest stars, and his workout routine — plus, he takes his pants off for charity! Meanwhile, Rachel Weisz discusses her award-winning role in “The Constant Gardener” and shares behind-the-scenes stories.

videos.title: Nicollette Sheridan, Chi McBride
videos.overview: Nicollette Sheridan from "Desperate Housewives" chats about the show's success, Emmy night, and teaches Ellen a cartwheel, while Chi McBride discusses his movie and late start to acting at 30.

videos.title: Jodie Foster, Nick Cannon
videos.overview: Jodie Foster talks Halloween chaos, kids’ parties, and her first job in the Coppertone ad, with Ellen helping with costume ideas. Plus, 6-year-old dinosaur expert Joshua amazes with T-Rex facts, and Nick Cannon shares funny family stories and childhood lessons.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Alyson Hannigan
videos.overview: Alec Baldwin discusses his self-diagnosed OCD, daughter Ireland, and New Orleans relief efforts, while Alyson Hannigan reflects on her “Buffy the Vampire Slayer” fan base, her “How I Met Your Mother” role, and a memorable fan gift.

videos.title: Jennifer Garner, Michael Rapaport
videos.overview: Jennifer Garner shares her pregnancy joy and efforts with Target to aid Hurricane Katrina victims, and shines in a fun game of “Madonna, Is That You?” Meanwhile, Michael Rapaport brings laughs with his dancing skills and hilarious stories.

videos.title: Fran Drescher, Jerry O’Connell
videos.overview: Jerry O’Connell shares the excitement of his engagement to Rebecca Romijn, his ring-buying nerves, and love of dancing, while Fran Drescher discusses her dating life, matchmaking adventures, and meeting Gwyneth Paltrow and Chris Martin.

videos.title: Jennifer Love Hewitt, Jared Padalecki
videos.overview: Jennifer Love Hewitt recounts a spooky real-life ghost story and plays Ghost Pictionary with Ellen, while Jared Padalecki reveals a near-death experience, his lack of a Texas accent, and “Supernatural” behind-the-scenes tales. Plus, Ellen’s hilarious beauty school makeovers!

videos.title: Josh Duhamel, Joely Fisher
videos.overview: Josh Duhamel joins Ellen fresh off getting “PUNK’D” by Ashton Kutcher, sharing stories about North Dakota before celebrating his college graduation live! Plus, Joely Fisher chats about filming "Desperate Housewives" while balancing pregnancy and motherhood.

videos.title: Jessica Alba, Noah Wyle
videos.overview: Jessica Alba shares the wild story of making out with a monkey, swimming with sharks, and her grandma’s grand entrances! Plus, Noah Wyle reveals how his toddler gave him a DIY haircut and just how many pets he has at home.

videos.title: David Duchovny, Constance Marie
videos.overview: David Duchovny discusses his new movie, triathlons, and family, while Constance Marie shares details about her surprise birthday party and even creates a signature dance move just for Ellen.

videos.title: Cameron Diaz, Paul Walker
videos.overview: Cameron Diaz talks about her new movie "In Her Shoes," dancing, her boyfriend Justin Timberlake, casino addiction, and frequent injuries, while Paul Walker shares details about "Into the Blue," swimming with sharks, and his biggest fear.

videos.title: Matt LeBlanc, Vanessa Marcell
videos.overview: Matt LeBlanc joins Ellen to chat about his sitcom "Joey," being her neighbor, and testing his memory on iconic Friends lines. Plus, Vanessa Marcil talks "Punk’d" pranks with Josh Duhamel, parenting, and philanthropy.

videos.title: Matthew McConaughey, Wynonna Judd
videos.overview: Matthew McConaughey joins Ellen to discuss his philanthropy in New Orleans, learning Spanish with Penélope Cruz, and life in his Airstream. Plus, 12-year-old snake expert Cody Ford answers Ellen’s questions about snakes.

videos.title: Denise Richards, Sherri Shepherd
videos.overview: Denise Richards joins to discuss life with two under 2, drama with Charlie Sheen, and her new show. Plus, the always hilarious Sherri Shepherd shares the joys and challenges of motherhood as Ellen meets her adorable new baby!

videos.title: Bonnie Hunt, Naveen Andrews
videos.overview: The hilarious and talented Bonnie Hunt joins Ellen to share stories from her past as a nurse, her new movie, and her improv skills. Plus, “Lost” star Naveen Andrews stops by to discuss fan theories and Ellen’s love for the show!

videos.title: Kevin Bacon, Sara Rue
videos.overview: Kevin Bacon chats about country living, releasing his fourth album, and revisiting his old modeling photos. Plus, “Less Than Perfect” star Sara Rue shares her unique vacation traditions and her playful jealousy of Sherri Shepherd, plus receives a special gift from Ellen!

videos.title: Hilary Clinton, Kirsten Dunst
videos.overview: Ellen and Kirsten Dunst hilariously clear up their so-called “beef” before Kirsten gives Ellen a tap dance lesson. Plus, Hillary Clinton makes a surprise visit, joining Ellen for candid conversations and unforgettable moments you won’t want to miss!

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel, Amy Brenneman
videos.overview: Amy Brenneman shares her birth story and how her daughter is adjusting to their new baby boy, Jimmy Kimmel reflects on his school days and past Halloween costumes, and Jeff Corwin brings exotic animals—including a penguin, wolf, lynx, and giraffe!

videos.title: Meryl Streep, Jason Lee
videos.overview: Meryl Streep chats about her record-breaking Oscar nominations and shows off her accent skills, memory expert Jim Karol stuns with mind-blowing tricks, and Jason Lee stops by to discuss his hit show "My Name Is Earl!"

videos.title: Charlize Theron, Jeff Daniels
videos.overview: Charlize Theron clears up the pronunciation of her name, shares her fear of public speaking, and teaches Ellen Afrikaans. Jeff Daniels talks about life in Michigan and a funny mishap with his wife. Plus, Ellen gets her eyesight checked at LensCrafters!

videos.title: Dakota Fanning, Rod Stewart
videos.overview: Dakota Fanning chats with Ellen about Dreamer, life with braces, and her iconic Scarlett O’Hara costume—plus, a fun Girl Scout dance challenge! Rod Stewart shares fatherhood at 60, his engagement, and earning a star on the Walk of Fame.

videos.title: Sharon Stone, Tyler James Williams, Sherri Shepherd
videos.overview: Sharon Stone talks about her kids, dating life, and co-writing a song for Hurricane Katrina before hosting a live auction. Tyler James Williams shares his experience playing young Chris Rock. Sherri Shepherd delivers “The Shepard Report” on pop culture, including the new "James Bond."

videos.title: Barbra Steisand, Ashlee Simpson
videos.overview: Ellen takes her audience inside Barbra Streisand’s home for a rare, unforgettable interview filled with stories and laughter. Plus, Ashlee Simpson opens up about her infamous SNL lip-sync incident, sharing what really happened and how she moved forward.

videos.title: Stevie Wonder, Susan Sarandon
videos.overview: Susan Sarandon reflects on turning 59, her kids' reactions to her risqué movie scenes, and Halloween costumes. Plus, Stevie Wonder reveals the inspiration behind "Isn’t She Lovely," talks about his new album, and even takes audience requests.

videos.title: Benjamin Bratt, Elisabeth Shure
