videos.overview: Benjamin Bratt shares stories of his unique childhood on Alcatraz, hilarious drinks with Elmo, and his hand-walking skills. Plus, Elisabeth Shue talks about working with Dakota Fanning, her love for gymnastics, and a near-disastrous hand flip—along with her uniquely funny sneeze!

videos.title: Antonio Banderas, Kathryn Morris
videos.overview: Antonio Banderas joins Ellen to discuss receiving his star on the Walk of Fame, his wife Melanie Griffith, and "The Legend of Zorro." Plus, Kathryn Morris talks about her love of reality TV, "Cold Case," and even helps Ellen solve a mystery!

videos.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones, Sherri Shepherd, Dylan Walsh
videos.overview: Catherine Zeta-Jones shares family stories and gives Ellen a sword-fighting lesson. Later, Sherri Shepherd returns for a catch-up with Ellen, and Dylan Walsh from Nip/Tuck stops by.

videos.title: Season 3 Halloween Show: Jane Kaczmarek, Emily Procter
videos.overview: Ellen, known for her iconic Halloween costumes, takes you along as she shops for the perfect look in 2005. Later, "Malcolm in the Middle" star Jane Kaczmarek stops by with her kids, shares her Halloween birth story, and showcases her dad’s latest invention.

videos.title: Julie Bowen, Zach Braff
videos.overview: Zach Braff clears up a wild tabloid rumor — did he really save a man’s life in a bathroom? He also talks “Garden State,” his scene-stealing dog, and “Chicken Little”! Plus, Julie Bowen shares how she landed “Lost,” her trip to India, and “Boston Legal” memories.

videos.title: Jimmy Smits, Steve Zahn
videos.overview: Ellen helps Jimmy Smits prepare for his live debate on “The West Wing,” while Steve Zahn drops by to share stories about life in Kentucky and the hilarious mishap behind his bad driver’s license photo.

videos.overview: Ellen dives into iconic TV sets, visiting "The West Wing" for a behind-the-scenes tour and an arm-wrestling match with Alison Janney, "Two and a Half Men" for laughs with Charlie Sheen and a surprising ballet move from Angus T. Jones, "ER" to quiz Maura Tierney and Goran Višnjić while pitching her dream role, "Joey" to chat with Matt LeBlanc about reviving Joey Tribbiani, and "Gilmore Girls" to explore Stars Hollow with Lauren Graham and Alexis Bledel, reminiscing about the gazebo scene.

videos.title: John Stamos, Ricky Martin
videos.overview: The charismatic John Stamos shares a thrilling story of saving a life with Bob Saget, discusses his inspiring new organization, and surprises an audience member, before Ricky Martin joins for a lively chat.

videos.title: Neil Patrick Harris, Pamela Anderson
videos.overview: Pamela Anderson opens up about Tommy Lee, Kid Rock, and her Comedy Central roast before showing off unforgettable dance moves — while Neil Patrick Harris reminisces on "Doogie Howser," his love for magic, and attempts to juggle swords with Ellen.

videos.title: John Cusack, Jaime Pressly
videos.overview: John Cusack makes his first appearance on Ellen’s Viewers Choice show, chatting about the White Sox, his iconic role in "Say Anything," and a clip of his first acting job — while Jamie Pressly opens up about her North Carolina roots and modeling career at 14.

Staying with the 1976 theme, one of music's biggest stars, then and now, BARRY MANILOW serenades Ellen and her classmates.

videos.overview: George Lopez; Morgan Freeman. Also: Natasha Bedingfield performs.

videos.title: Liza Minnelli/Orlando Jones
videos.overview: Icon of stage and screen LIZA MINNELLI visits with Ellen and chats about the release of her DVD "Liza With a Z." Ellen also welcomes ORLANDO JONES who talks about his return to television. And, don't miss when a professional fire-eater teaches Ellen to eat fire! Plus, Ellen makes another lucky viewer's "Crazy Dream" come true.

videos.title: Brendan Fraser/Shakira/Sherri Shepherd
videos.overview: "The Ellen DeGeneres Show" continues to bring the show to viewers when it lands at Universal Orlando Resort! Ellen kicks off her adventure with a little help from BRENDAN FRASER who takes a ride on "Revenge of The Mummy."  Ellen also welcomes SHAKIRA with special guest WYCLEF JEAN who rocks the resort with their hit song "<u>Hips Don't Lie.</u>"  Plus, the unpredictable SHERRI SHEPHERD explores culinary delights throughout the Universal theme parks! And, you won't want to miss it as Ellen hops from thrill ride to thrill ride.

videos.title: John Goodman/Tim McGraw/Kevin Covais
videos.overview: Ellen continues the fun at Universal Orlando Resort with a visit from country's king, TIM MCGRAW. Thousands of fans come to see him perform a song from his hit album, "Tim McGraw Reflected: Hits Vol 2." One of television's favorite stars, JOHN GOODMAN, drops by to chat about his new film (Tales of the Rat Fink). And, recent "American Idol" cast-off KEVIN "Chicken Little" COVAIS shares behind-the-scenes secrets of "Idol" and chats about his recent role as a 16-year-old sex symbol.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer/LL Cool J
videos.overview: It's Ellen's grand finale at Universal Orlando Resort. Star of the small and big screen KELSEY GRAMMER chats about his new role as the "Beast" in the upcoming "X-Men: The Last Stand." Plus, mega-star LL COOL J performs two songs: one from his new album "Control Myself" and a classic. And, tension builds as Ellen decides whether or not to ride "The Hulk."

videos.title: Sharon Stone/DMC/Whoopi Goldberg
videos.overview: The always entertaining SHARON STONE visits with Ellen to talk about her recent guest role on Showtime's, "Huff." The hilarious WHOOPI GOLDBERG, producer and star of Nickelodeon's, "Just for Kicks," chats about her new gig on Nick. Hip hop legend DMC performs "Just Like Me" from his new CD, "Checks, Thugs & Rock and Roll." He also gives us a glimpse of his VH-1 documentary about being adopted.

videos.title: Jennifer Aniston/Scott Foley
videos.overview: Truly one of Hollywood's biggest stars, JENNIFER ANISTON drops by to chat about everything from life and love to her new film "Friends With Money." Plus, making his first appearance on the show, the former star of the The WB's "Felicity," SCOTT FOLEY drops by to talk about his return to the small screen on the hit series "The Unit."

videos.title: Anjelica Huston/Justin Chambers
videos.overview: Academy Award winner, ANJELICA HUSTON visits with Ellen revealing her thoughts on plastic surgery and chats about how her role on "Huff." Making his first appearance on the show, JUSTIN CHAMBERS drops by to talk about his move from model to actor on TV's hottest show "Grey's Anatomy ." Animal caller JILL DERINGER is back with even more unique animal calls and you won't want to miss what her dog has to say this time. Plus, Ellen plays a game of "audience humdinger" and shares her inner thoughts from when she rode "The Hulk."

videos.title: Rebecca Romijn/Stephen Collins/Les Stroud
videos.overview: REBECCA ROMIJN chats about her fiancé, (former "Sliders" star) Jerry O'Connell, her role in the upcoming movie "X-Men: The Last Stand" and her new series on the WB network "Pepper Dennis." STEPHEN COLLINS (star of the WB's "7th Heaven") visits with Ellen for the first time and talks about the upcoming conclusion of his WB series. Plus, survival expert LES STROUD tells Ellen all about the adventures from his Discovery/Science Channel series, "Survivorman." And, don't miss it when Ellen's favorite thrill ride companion CANDIE BRUNN drops by for a hair update. Ellen also checks in with Quizno's winner, Stephanie Busch to see how her training is coming along.

videos.title: David Spade/Catherine Keener/NE-YO
videos.overview: The hilarious DAVID SPADE drops by to talk about his new film "The Benchwarmers." Golden Globe nominated actress, CATHERINE KEENER makes her first appearance on the show and chats about her film, "Friends with Money." Plus, NE-YO performs his hit song "So Sick" from his debut CD, "In My Own Words." And, don't miss when the studio heats up with a "FIRE WALKER."

videos.title: Ray Romano/Jeff Corwin/Kelly Monaco
videos.overview: The always entertaining RAY ROMANO visits with Ellen and talks about his hit film "Ice Age: The Meltdown." Animal Planet's JEFF CORWIN drops by and brings along some amazing animals to show Ellen. Plus, host of this year's Daytime Emmys KELLY MONACO talks about hosting and being nominated for her role on "General Hospital."

videos.title: Charlie Sheen/Pink
videos.overview: The week closes as Golden Globe winning actor, CHARLIE SHEEN stops by to chat about bringing back his role in the upcoming "Scary Movie 4" and his new venture as a children's fashion designer. Plus, PINK performs "Stupid Girls" from her upcoming CD, "I'm Not Dead."

videos.title: Jamie Foxx/Jeff Bridges/Bucky Covington
videos.overview: Oscar® winner and one of Hollywood's biggest and most versatile stars JAMIE FOXX visits with Ellen and clears up rumors about his love life. He also entertains us with a performance of his hit song "DJ Play A Love Song" from his chart-topping album "Unpredictable." JEFF BRIDGES drops by to chat about his new gymnastics film "Stick it" and challenges Ellen to a sculpting contest. Plus, the latest "American Idol" latest cast-off, country favorite BUCKY COVINGTON, drops by to chat about his "Idol" experience and performs.

videos.title: Randy Jackson/Rhea Perlman/Toby Keith
videos.overview: From America's hottest show, "American Idol" top dog, RANDY JACKSON drops by to share his thoughts on the final seven contestants. Country superstar TOBY KEITH performs "Get Drunk and Be Somebody" from his upcoming album "White Trash with Money (Album Cover)." Plus, RHEA PEARLMAN makes her first apperance on the show and chats about her new children's book series "Otto Undercover." And, 10-year old origami artist TRISTAN ALAN shares his inspiring story of how he raised money for schools that were affected by Hurricane Katrina.

videos.title: Wanda Sykes/Poppy Montgomery
videos.overview: Ellen's giving away 50 tickets to the Daytime Emmys®! Tune in to see how you could be Ellen's guest at one of Hollywood's biggest nights. The always entertaining WANDA SYKES stops by to chat about her new film "Over the Hedge" and her return to TV. Plus, the lovely POPPY MONTGOMERY from the hit series "Without a Trace" visits with Ellen.

videos.title: Kiefer Sutherland/Maya Rudolph/Tanya Streeter
videos.overview: Rugged star of Fox's "24" KIEFER SUTHERLAND stops by to talk about his new film "The Sentinel." The hilarious MAYA RUDOLPH from "Saturday Night Live" talks about balancing work and motherhood. And, professional freediver, TANYA STREETER, shares her amazing adventures and talks about her upcoming special "FREEDIVER" on "Animal Planet."

videos.title: Rob Lowe/Kate Walsh/Teddy Geiger
videos.overview: The charming ROB LOWE visits with Ellen and chats about his latest film "Thank You For Smoking" and his return to "The West Wing." Making her first appearance on the show, KATE WALSH from the phenomenon " Grey's Anatomy." Plus, 17-year-old TEDDY GEIGER performs "For You I Will (Confidence)" from his debut CD, "Underage Thinking."

videos.title: Elton John/Kim Raver/Ace Young
videos.overview: Rock legend, SIR ELTON JOHN, gets up close and personal with Ellen. Elton reveals what decision he had to make to change his entire life. SIR ELTON also performs a song from his Broadway Musical "Lestat" and a classic. Making her first appearance on the show, KIM RAVER from the mega hit "24." Plus, the latest "American Idol" cast-off, heartthrob ACE YOUNG, talks about his Idol experience and performs. And, Ellen continues to shake things up with a monologue you have to see to believe.

videos.title: Sally Field/Kenny Rogers/Jodelle Ferland
videos.overview: Academy Award winning actress SALLY FIELD visits with Ellen for the first time. Plus, from the sexiest show on TV, "Desperate Housewives," RICARDO CHAVIRA drops by. And, country legend KENNY ROGERS performs his new hit song "I Can't Unlove You" from his critically acclaimed CD "Water & Bridges." And, 11-year-old JODELLE FERLAND, star of "Silent Hill," stops by.

videos.title: Roseanne/David Boreanaz
videos.overview: The hilarious ROSEANNE BARR stops by to talk about her new DVD "Rockin' with Roseanne" as well as her HBO comedy special. And, DAVID BOREANAZ chats about his return to TV on the hit crime drama "Bones." ED DEL GRANDE, host of "Ed the Plumber" on DIY Network, teaches Ellen a thing or two about plumbing.

videos.title: Robin Williams / Daniel Powter / Wentworth Miller
videos.overview: Robin Williams chats about his new film R.V., making his first appearance on the show, Wentworth Miller visits with Ellen from Fox's breakout series Prison Break. Daniel Powter performs the number one song in the country, Bad Day.

videos.title: Michael Douglas/Jenna Fischer
videos.overview: Making his first appearance on the show, Academy Award winning actor and superstar MICHAEL DOUGLAS stops by to chat about his expanding family and his new film "The Sentinel." Did wife Catherine Zeta-Jones get her way and convince the Hollywood Icon to have more kids? And, from the hit comedy "The Office," JENNA FISCHER visits with Ellen for the first time. Plus, Ellen's favorite engaged couple, Alecia Whitaker and Jerrod Pace, are back to talk all about their upcoming wedding in May.

videos.title: Paris Hilton/Kellie Pickler/David Frei
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates all things dog in her special "BEST IN SHOW" show. Co-hosting with Ellen is DAVID FREI of the Westminster Dog Show. Who better to celebrate with than everyone's favorite party girl PARIS HILTON, who brings her four miniature dogs including the infamous Tinkerbelle. Paris also chats about working with Nicole Richie on the upcoming season of "The Simple Life" and addresses the Pink video (Stupid Girls) that is aimed largely at her. Ellen also meets Rufus, the winner of "Best in Show 2006," and something you truly have to see to believe when Ellen gets a hug from the TALLEST DOG IN THE WORLD. Plus, the latest cast-off from "American Idol," America's sweetheart KELLIE PICKER, shows off her moves and performs one last time.

videos.title: Geena Davis/Nigel Lythgoe
videos.overview: Television's first lady GEENA DAVIS chats with Ellen about whether or not "Commander in Chief" will be returning for a second season. The creative genius behind two of Ellen's favorite shows, "American Idol" and "So You Think You Can Dance," NIGEL LYTHGOE drops by. Plus, Ellen clears out her garage when she holds her own YARD SALE -- and you won't believe the bargains these lucky shoppers find! And, Crazy Dreams Winner Britton Frisbie is back to tell all about her once-in-a-lifetime Daytime Emmy experience.

videos.title: Ryan Seacrest/Merv Griffin
videos.overview: The busiest man in Hollywood and the glue that holds together the biggest show on television, "American Idol" host RYAN SEACREST visits with Ellen. Ryan chats about the final five contestants and clears up rumors of any ongoing feuds. Legendary actor, producer and talk show host, MERV GRIFFIN, stops by to chat about his DVD "The Merv Griffin Show: 40 of the Most Interesting People of Our Time." And, Ellen meets up with three KID INVENTORS who show off their latest creations. Plus, Ellen checks in with the 84-year-old great grandmother who won the $10 million jackpot on a nickel slot machine.

videos.title: Candice Bergen/Mekhi Phifer
videos.overview: Emmy award winning actress CANDICE BERGEN drops by from "Boston Legal." Plus, the always charming MEKHI PHIFER visits with Ellen and chats about the season finale of "ER." And, Etiquette Expert Dorothea Johnson teaches Ellen how to handle herself at social and business events.

videos.title: Ellen Pompeo/Graig Ferguson
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates Cinco de Mayo, and you're invited to the party. Check out what happens when Ellen is let loose on historic Olvera Street in Los Angeles and receives a lesson in Mexican culture. Joining Ellen for this celebration is ELLEN POMPEO from the hottest series on TV, "Grey's Anatomy." And, CRAIG FERGUSON ("The Late Late Show with Graig Ferguson") talks about his best selling book, "Between the Bridge and the River."

videos.title: Luke Wilson/Shemar Moore/Paris Bennett
videos.overview: LUKE WILSON makes his first appearance on the show and stops by to chat about his upcoming roles in "Hoot" and "My Super Ex-Girlfriend" where he's lucky enough to play Uma Thurman's boyfriend. The super fabulous SHEMAR MOORE drops by from the hit series "Criminal Minds" and helps Ellen get ready for Kanye West's upcoming appearance. Plus, the latest "American Idol" cast-off, PARIS BENNETT, talks about her "Idol" experience and performs one last time. And, Ellen makes another CRAZY DREAM come true.

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson/Famke Janssen/Natasha Bedingfield
videos.overview: Ellen gives viewers a sneak peek at this summer's hottest trends in movies, music and more on her special "Summer Preview Show." Joining Ellen for the special episode are actors from this summer's biggest blockbusters. Oscar nominated actor, SAMUEL L. JACKSON, talks about his new film "Snakes On A Plane," and the lovely FAMKE JANSSEN chats about the anticipated "X-Men: The Last Stand." Plus, pop sensation NATASHA BEDINGFIELD performs her newest hit "Single" from her debut album "Unwritten." And, JON KELLEY from "Extra" gives the lowdown on this summer's must-see list. Don't miss the WORLD PREMIERE trailer of M. NIGHT SHYAMALAN'S "Lady in the Water."

videos.title: Lindsay Lohan/Chris Isaak/Ty Pennington
videos.overview: One of Hollywood's hottest actresses, LINDSAY LOHAN, visits with Ellen about her new film "Just My Luck." The always entertaining TY PENNINGTON from "Extreme Makeover: Home Edition" stops by to share Hurricane Katrina makeovers. The talented CHRIS ISAAK performs a song from his new album "Best of Chris Isaak." Plus, magician KEITH BARRY freaks Ellen's freak with his amazing tricks.

videos.title: Cast of The West Wing
videos.overview: Ellen has the exclusive farewell interview with the entire cast of "The West Wing," including MARTIN SHEEN, ALLISON JANNEY, BRADLEY WHITFORD, RICHARD SCHIFF, JIMMY SMITS, JANEL MOLONEY, KRISTIN CHENOWETH and DULE HILL. Ellen and the cast celebrate with a special season finale send-off party! The cast shares special moments and highlights from the past seven seasons.

videos.title: Tom Cruise/Jane Kaczmarek *Mother's Day*
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates Mother's Day with Hollywood superstar TOM CRUISE. Tom chats about the newest edition to his family (daughter SURI), how his fiancée Kate Holmes plans to spend her first Mother's Day and the release of his blockbuster hit "Mission: Impossible 3." Also joining Ellen is JANE KACZMAREK who talks about "Malcolm in the Middle" coming to an end after seven successful seasons.

videos.title: Kanye West/Howie Mandel *Ellen in the Park*
videos.overview: It's the biggest Ellen party in the history of the show! Ellen takes her show outdoors for her second annual SHOW IN THE PARK. Joining Ellen and over 5,000 fans is Grammy Award winner KANYE WEST, who performs the hit song from "Mission Impossible: III", "Impossible," and his #1 hit, "Touch the Sky." The hilarious HOWIE MANDEL from "Deal or No Deal" drops by. And, the percussion sensation STOMP performs. Plus, Ellen helps make a "CRAZY DREAM" come true when three nurses live out their dream of becoming TRAPEZE ARTISTS.

videos.title: Nick Lachey/Ron Howard/Chris Daughtry
videos.overview: Academy Award winning director, RON HOWARD, drops by to talk about the highly anticipated film "The Da Vinci Code." In his first daytime interview since the break up, NICK LACHEY opens up about life after Jessica. Nick also performs his new single, "What's Left of Me." Plus, it shocked Ellen and America when CHRIS DAUGHTRY was eliminated from "American Idol," now Chris talks about his future and performs an Ellen favorite.

videos.title: Julie Andrews *Ellen Comes Home*
videos.overview: Ellen returns to New Orleans to celebrate the grand opening of the New Orleans Quiznos with winner Shay Karriem, a survivor of Hurricane Katrina. Join Ellen as she helps Shay start a new beginning. Plus, JULIE ANDREWS joins Ellen to chat about her newest children's book, "The Great American Mousical."

videos.title: Diane Keaton/Paul Simon/Sherri Shepherd *500th Show*
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates her 500th episode with an exclusive interview with former Presidents BILL CLINTON and GEORGE BUSH SR. This special show includes Ellen's favorite moments from her first 499 shows. Joining Ellen for the celebration is Academy Award winning actress DIANE KEATON. Making his first appearance on the show, the legendary PAUL SIMON performs a song from his new album "<u>Surprise</u>" as well as a classic song. Plus, Ellen's favorite actress, SHERRI SHEPHERD.

videos.title: Teri Hatcher/Harold Perrineau
videos.overview: One of television's hottest stars, TERI HATCHER, visits with Ellen to talk about her new venture as a writer with the release of her first book, "Burnt Toast," and her new love interest on "Desperate Housewives." Making his first appearance on the show, HAROLD PERRINEAU, who plays the mysterious Michael Dawson on the hit series "Lost." Will Ellen get either of these two to reveal clues about what's going to happen in their season finales? And, Ellen checks in with Stephanie Busch on the grand opening of her Quiznos in Cleveland.

videos.title: Evangeline Lilly/Jamie Kennedy *Farewell to Tony*
videos.overview: Ellen celebrates the man who has made her dance for the last three seasons, DJ Tony Okungbowa. Ellen bids a fond farewell to DJ Tony and dedicates a special episode to all his contributions. Joining Ellen for the celebration is EVANGELINE LILLY of "Lost" and the hilarious JAMIE KENNEDY. Also wishing Tony luck are some of Hollywood's biggest stars, including JIMMY FALLON, NICK LACHEY, the "AMERICAN IDOL" judges and many more. Ellen has a few big surprises for Tony… and a MAJOR surprise for the entire studio audience and you!

videos.title: Nicollette Sheridan/Michael Bolton/Omar Epps
videos.overview: Ellen has the exclusive interview with NICOLLETTE SHERIDAN & MICHAEL BOLTON. The reunited couple chats about everything from their past relationship to their upcoming nuptials. Michael also performs a song off his new album "Bolton Swings Sinatra." And, from Ellen's favorite television show "House," OMAR EPPS stops by to chat about the upcoming season finale.

videos.title: Jack Black/Kristin Chenoweth
videos.overview: Ladies & Gentleman, Boy & Girls, we are proud to present "ELLEN THE MUSICAL." Joining Ellen is an ensemble cast, including the hilarious musical talents of JACK BLACK and Tony Award winner KRISTIN CHENOWETH. This entire episode is filled with singing, dancing and laughter… That's right, for the first time on daytime history, a talk show becomes a MUSICAL.

videos.title: Randy Jackson/Paul Simon/Bill Clinton
videos.overview: Ellen continues to bring awareness to New Orleans by sharing stories and moments from her recent visit to her hometown. Ellen is joined by "American Idol" judge RANDY JACKSON, music legend PAUL SIMON and former Presidents GEORGE H. W. BUSH and BILL CLINTON. Join Ellen for an emotional tribute to New Orleans.

videos.title: Hugh Jackman/Flavor Flav
videos.overview: The multi-talented HUGH JACKMAN talks up the summer blockbuster "X-Men 3: The Last Stand" and lets Ellen in on what it's like to be a movie star dad. Making his first appearance on the show, the outrageous FLAVOR FLAV chats about finding love on his VH-1 show "Flavor of Love."

videos.title: Vince Vaughn/ Taylor Hicks {Season Finale}
videos.overview: VINCE VAUGHN lands in ELLEN's guest chair and chats about his hit film, "The Break-Up," and his relationship with JENNIFER ANISTON. And, America voted and made TAYLOR HICKS your "American Idol," now the lead member of the "Soul Patrol" performs a song from his upcoming CD. Plus, one of Ellen's favorite bands, LIVE, performs their hit "Mystery."

videos.title: Justin Timberlake in Central Park {Season Premiere}
videos.overview: She's Back and better than ever, it's ELLEN'S BIGGEST PREMIERE EVER! Ellen kicks off her fourth season in New York's Central Park with music sensation JUSTIN TIMBERLAKE. Justin chats with Ellen about everything from his good friend Lance Bass to his possible engagement to actress Cameron Diaz. Plus, Justin performs the hottest song in the country, "SexyBack," and his new hit single, "My Love." Don't miss when Ellen hits the streets of NYC to see how nice New Yorkers really are! And Ellen announces a huge surprise!

videos.title: Beyonce in Central Park
videos.overview: ELLEN continues to heat up New York's Central Park when she throws a 25th birthday bash for superstar BEYONCÉ! Making her first appearance on the show, Beyoncé talks with Ellen about her boyfriend Jay-Z and how she plans to retire at 30. Plus, Beyoncé performs her hit single, "Déjà vu," and premieres her newest single, "Irreplaceable." And, Ellen has a HUGE surprise for Beyoncé to make her birthday even more special! Then, don't miss Ellen at the US Open when she takes to the court with tennis greats Andre Agassi and Andy Roddick.

videos.title: Kevin Federline
videos.overview: ELLEN reveals her new set with her first in-studio guest of the fourth season and has the 1st EXCLUSIVE talk show interview with KEVIN FEDERLINE. Ellen chats with Kevin about his wife Britney Spears, son Sean Preston and their upcoming addition to the family. Plus, Kevin performs his newest single, "Lose Control," from his upcoming CD, "Playing with Fire."

videos.title: Brad Garrett/Patrice Oneal
videos.overview: Emmy Award winning actor BRAD GARRETT joins Ellen and opens up about his recent divorce and talks about his return to television with his new sitcom "Til Death." Plus, the host of VH1's "Web Junk 20," PATRICE ONEAL, shares some of the Internet's funniest videos. And, a top 10 finalist in "So You Think You Can Dance," IVAN KOUMAEV, shows off his winning moves. Plus, Ellen gets started on her "Life List" when she takes a computer lesson.

videos.title: Andre Agassi/Kim Basinger
videos.overview: Academy Award winning actress KIM BASINGER visits with Ellen for the first time and chats about her upcoming film "The Mermaid Chair." Andre Agassi in his first talk show interview ever! He talks about his retirement, his family, and gives Ellen some tennis tips. Mike Holmes from Discovery Home Network's "Holmes on Homes" stops by to give his tips on how everyone can avoid home repair nightmares.

videos.title: Jessica Simpson/Ron Livingston/Storm Large
videos.overview: Making her first solo appearance on the show, star of Feature film, music and TV, Superstar JESSICA SIMPSON drops to talk with Ellen about her very public divorce and how she's looking for love. Plus, don't miss a one-of-a-kind performance of Jessica's hit single, "A Public Affair," featuring our very own Ellen DeGeneres. RON LIVINGSTON drops by to chat about his return to television in his new series, "Standoff." And, "Rock Star: Supernova" cast-off STORM LARGE tells Ellen all about her "Rock Star" experience and performs one last time. Plus, Ellen welcomes Jenette and Gary Nelson, who lost their daughter on 9/11, and share how they continue to bring awareness to their daughter's memory

videos.title: Hugh Laurie/Tommy Lee
videos.overview: From one of Ellen's favorite television shows, "House," HUGH LAURIE drops by to talk about the show's exciting new season. Plus, the Rock Star himself, TOMMY LEE visits with Ellen to talk about his hit show "Rock Star: Supernova" and which contestant he thinks will be the best fit for his new band, "Supernova."

videos.title: Orlando Bloom/Biance Ryan/Chi-Lan Lieu
videos.overview: Making his first appearance on the show, one of Hollywood's hottest actors, ORLANDO BLOOM drops by to talk about his new film "Haven." Plus, the soulful sounds of 11-year-old BIANCA RYAN, the winner of "America's Got Talent". Chi-Lan Lieu, host of HGTV's "I Want That! Tech Toys," is here to preview cool gadgets for fall.

videos.title: Zach Braff/Outkast
videos.overview: The multi-talented ZACH BRAFF visits with Ellen and chats about how he juggles the small and big screens with his hit sitcom "Scrubs" and his upcoming film "The Last Kiss." Plus, making their first appearance on the show, Grammy Award winning group OUTKAST performs "Morris Brown" from the soundtrack of their film "Idlewild." And, Ben Underwood, the 14-year-old boy who uses echolocation to "see sound," joins Ellen.

videos.title: The Rock/John Mayer
videos.overview: Dwayne "THE ROCK" Johnson drops by to talk about his upcoming film, "Gridiron Gang." Plus, "The Rock" teaches Ellen some new exercise moves! Grammy Award winning singer JOHN MAYER performs "Waiting On The World To Change" from his upcoming CD "Continuum."

videos.title: Julia Louis-Dreyfus/Bradley Whitford
videos.overview: JULIA LOUIS-DREYFUS drops by and chats about her Emmy win for "The New Adventures of Old Christine (CBS, Monday @ 9:30pm)" and how she injured herself with the famed statue. Julia also speaks candidly about being a child of divorce. Plus, BRADLEY WHITFORD gives Ellen a little too much detail about how he keeps the romance alive in his marriage. He also chats about his return to television in the much anticipated Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip. (NBC, Monday @ 10pm) And, the runner-up from Rockstar: Supernova Dilana swings by and discusses the conflicts she had with other Supernova competitors and gives an amazing performance of Roxanne.

videos.title: Sir Elton John/Rainn Wilson
videos.overview: Music legend Sir Elton John visits with Ellen. Elton performs "The Bridge" from his upcoming CD, "The Captain and The Kid." Plus, Rainn Wilson from the Emmy Award winning The Office (NBC, Thursday @ 8:30pm) conducts a hilarious dress rehearsal with Ellen as she teaches him how to be a good guest on a talk show. Rainn also reveals a hobby that both he and Ellen have in common. And, don't miss Ellen's favorite viral videos! Ellen finds out if Katie Couric chose to use her suggested sign–off. Plus, Ellen reveals a surprising fact about DJ Jonny. The day has arrived! The Ellen DeGeneres Show: DVD-licious hits Target stores today!

videos.title: Dixie Chicks/Diane Lane
videos.overview: Don't miss Ellen's exclusive interview with pop divas The Dixie Chicks. They are on hand to discuss the new documentary "Shut Up and Sing," which was shot during a very public and dramatic period of their career. They also perform their chart-topper, "Easy Silence." Plus, the lovely and talented Diane Lane drops by to talk about her role in the critically-acclaimed film Hollywoodland. Plus, Chi-Lan Lieu, host of HGTV's I Want That! Tech Toys, is here to preview cool gadgets for fall.

videos.title: Sandra Oh/Josh Blue
videos.overview: Emmy Award winner Sandra Oh visits with Ellen for the first time and discusses the much anticipated season premiere of Grey's Anatomy (ABC, Thursday @ 9pm). Plus, Ellen continues to introduce her viewers to "People You Should Know" when Josh Blue, winner of NBC's Summer hit Last Comic Standing, stops by and shares his amazing story. And, Ellen goes undercover in a hilarious tape piece to Universal Studios.

videos.title: Eva Longoria/Simon Baker/Cole & LD Miller
videos.overview: Sexy siren and Desperate Housewife (ABC, Sunday @ 9pm) Eva Longoria drops by to chat with Ellen about what's in store for the ladies of Wisteria Lane. Will Ellen find out if this really is Eva's last television series? Aussie actor Simon Baker stops by to give Ellen the lowdown on his new CBS series Smith. (CBS, Tuesday @ 10pm) And, Cole & LD Miller from America's Got Talent perform. Plus, Ellen helps another viewer check off a goal on their life list.

videos.title: Matthew Perry/Kenny Chesney
videos.overview: MATTHEW PERRY makes his first appearance on the show and chats about his return to TV with the hit series "Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip (NBC, Monday @ 10pm)." And, Matthew helps Ellen with her "Life List" by giving her a tennis lesson. Plus, KENNY CHESNEY drops by and chats about his love of laundry and performs his classic song, "Young," from his new album, "Live Those Songs Again: Kenny Chesney Live." Plus, Ellen gives DJ Jonny his first driving lesson

videos.title: Lauren Graham/Letoya/Emmitt Smith
videos.overview: Television's favorite mom, LAUREN GRAHAM from "Gilmore Girls (The CW, Tuesday @ 8pm)," joins Ellen and talks about the seventh season. Plus, LETOYA performs her number one hit, "Torn," from her self-titled CD, "Letoya." And, NFL star EMMITT SMITH chats with Ellen about taking his fancy footwork from the football field to the dance floor on "Dancing with the Stars (ABC, Tuesday and Wednesday @ 8pm)." Ellen continues to work on her "Life List" when she takes a Spanish class at a Burbank middle school!

videos.title: Sting/Robert Downey Jr.
videos.overview: ELLEN has the 1st exclusive talk show appearance with ROBERT DOWNEY JR. & STING! They chat about how their marriages keep them grounded and what it was like working together for the first time on the upcoming film "A Guide to Recognizing Your Saints." And, Ellen finds out what's on their "Life Lists." Plus, don't miss more of Ellen's "Wednesday's Wonderful World of Web Videos!"

videos.title: Howie Mandel/Chris Brown
videos.overview: From the number one game show on television, "Deal or No Deal" (NBC, Monday @ 8pm & Thursday @ 9pm) host HOWIE MANDEL visits with Ellen. Plus, one of Ellen's favorites, R&B sensation CHRIS BROWN performs "Gimme That" from his self-titled CD. And, don't miss Jan Silva, the 4-YEAR-OLD TENNIS PRODIGY who gives Ellen some helpful tennis tips.

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher/Ludacris
videos.overview: One of Hollywood's hottest actors, ASHTON KUTCHER, stops by and talks about his recent one-year anniversary to wife Demi Moore and his two new films, "The Guardian" and "Open Season." Plus, acclaimed rapper LUDACRIS performs "Money Maker" from his upcoming CD, "Release Therapy."

videos.title: Sheryl Crow/Christina Applegate *Breast Cancer Awareness*
videos.overview: Ellen hosts a special episode to kick off "Breast Cancer Awareness Month." Ellen, whose mother is a breast cancer survivor, is joined by musician and breast cancer survivor SHERYL CROW who shares some preventive tips with viewers.  Plus, CHRISTINA APPLEGATE, whose mother is also a breast cancer survivor, stops by. Plus, four remarkable audience members donate their hair to Pantene's "Beautiful Lengths" to make wigs for women with cancer.

videos.title: Ted Danson/Robin Thicke/Jon Heder
videos.overview: The always charming TED DANSON visits with Ellen and chats about his return to television with his new sitcom "Help Me Help You (ABC, Tuesday @ 9:30pm)." Napoleon Dynamite himself, JON HEDER, visits Ellen for the first time and chats about his new film "School For Scoundrels." One of Ellen's favorite singers, ROBIN THICKE, performs a song from his critically acclaimed album "The Evolution of Robin Thicke." Plus, professional racecar driver Katherine Legge shares her near-death experience when she survived one of the most horrific crashes in the sport's history.

videos.title: Evangeline Lilly/Jesse Metcalfe
videos.overview: The lovely EVANGELINE LILLY visits with Ellen and chats about the much anticipated season premiere of "Lost" (ABC, Wednesday @ 9pm). Plus, Ellen has a first look at Evangeline's "Kate" action figure. Heartthrob JESSE METCALFE drops by to fill Ellen in on his return to "Desperate Housewives (ABC, Sunday @ 9pm)." And, don't miss more of Ellen's "Wednesday's Wunnerful World of Web Videos!"

videos.title: John Stamos/Andy Roddick/Prince Lorenzo Borghese
videos.overview: The always charming JOHN STAMOS talks with Ellen about becoming a regular on the hit drama "ER (NBC, Thursday @ 10pm)" and touring with the Beach Boys this past summer. Plus, tennis superstar ANDY RODDICK puts his serve to a good cause when he attempts to win a prize for the audience with a percentage of the proceeds donated to the Susan G. Komen Breast Cancer Foundation. And, the new "Bachelor," Prince Lorenzo Borghese, chats with Ellen about romancing the bachelorettes in Rome for the new season of "The Bachelor (ABC, Monday @ 9pm)."

videos.title: Marcia Cross/Rod Stewart/Mike Holmes
videos.overview: MARCIA CROSS drops by and chats about expecting twins and how she hides her bump on Wisteria Lane (Desperate Housewvies (ABC, Sunday @ 9pm)). Ellen is also joined by legendary singer ROD STEWART who performs "Have You Ever Seen The Rain." Plus, MIKE HOLMES, host of Discovery Home Channel's "Holmes on Homes," is here to show viewers the right tool for the right job. And, don't miss another installment of WRITE ON, when Ellen reads your e-mails.

videos.title: Leah Remini/Barry Watson/Monica
videos.overview: It's Ellen's Columbus Day celebration, and the always entertaining LEAH REMINI drops by to help Ellen choose an outfit for her upcoming hosting duties at the Oscars. Plus, don't miss a "Dancing with the Stars (ABC, Tuesday and Wednesday @ 8pm)" extravaganza when JOEY LAWRENCE, MARIO LOPEZ, MONIQUE COLEMAN and their partners strut their stuff! Making his first appearance on the show, BARRY WATSON talks about life after "7th Heaven (The CW, Monday @ 8pm)" and his new series, "What About Brian?" R&B sensation MONICA performs "Everytime Tha Beat Drop," with a special appearance by the music video's two charming kid dancers.

videos.title: Wanda Sykes/Justin Chambers
videos.overview: It's a party you don't want to miss when Ellen makes a special surprise announcement with incredible prizes for the audience and some viewers at home… maybe even YOU! Plus, the hilarious WANDA SYKES stops by and talks about the release of her DVD, "Wanda Sykes: Sick and Tired." And, JUSTIN CHAMBERS, one of the hottest stars from one of the hottest shows, "Grey's Anatomy (ABC, Thursday @ 9pm)," talks about the show's new season.

videos.title: Tiger Woods/America Ferrera
videos.overview: The man who changed golf forever, TIGER WOODS, visits the show for the first time. Tiger discusses his last tournament win as well as his top selling video game, "Tiger Woods: PGA Tour 07." Plus, from Ellen's new favorite show, "Ugly Betty (ABC, Thursday @ 8pm)," the talented AMERICA FERRERA drops by and chats about the critically acclaimed series. And, don't miss more of Ellen's "Wednesday's Wunnerful World of Web Videos!"

videos.title: Allison Janney/Emeril Lagasse/Chingy
videos.overview: The unpredictable ALLISON JANNEY visits with Ellen, and you never know what will happen when these the two get together. New Orleans' own celebrity chef, EMERIL LAGASSE, stops by for the first time and talks about his new book, "Emeril's There's a Chef in My World!" Making his first talk show appearance ever, ERIC DANE of "Grey's Anatomy (ABC, Thursday @ 9pm)" visits with Ellen and chats about the fascination with his character know as "McSteamy" on the hit series. Hip-hop superstar CHINGY performs "Pullin' Me Back" from his new CD, "Hoodstar."

videos.title: Calista Flockhart/Def Leppard
videos.overview: The lovely CALISTA FLOCKHART makes her first appearance on the show and chats about her return to television with the hit drama "Brothers & Sisters (ABC, Sunday @ 10pm)." TY PENNINGTON shares heartwarming stories from his hit show, "Extreme Makeover: Home Edition (ABC, Sunday @ 8pm)." DEF LEPPARD, perform their classic "Pour Some Sugar On Me." And, don't miss another installment of WRITE ON, when Ellen reads your e-mails.

Heidi Klum / John Krasinski
videos.overview: Today's guests are Heidi Klum (Project Runway) and John Krasinski (The Office).

videos.title: Hugh Jackman / Sarah McLachlan
videos.overview: Find out if Ellen did her "Life List" Spanish homework when Spanish teacher Monica Pena returns to give Ellen another hysterical lesson. Plus, he sings! He dances! And now he's a magician - HUGH JACKMAN visits with Ellen and talks about his much anticipated film "The Prestige." CHI McBRIDE drops by to talk about his exciting new hit show, "The Nine (ABC, Wednesday @ 10pm)." Get ready for some holiday spirit when songstress SARAH McLACHLAN performs "River" from her first holiday CD, "Wintersong." Plus, Ellen lets you sound off when she reads your e-mails in another edition of "WRITE ON."

videos.title: Kirsten Dunst/Judge Joe Brown
videos.overview: JUDGE JOE BROWN stops by to lay down the law!  Judge Ellen & Judge Joe Brown go head-to-head, but whose verdict will stand? The lovely KIRSTEN DUNST visits and Ellen asks the question everyone wants answered... who is Kirsten dating? Kirsten also teaches Ellen to walk like a proper lady as she did in her film, "Marie Antoinette."  You've been waiting a week and now it's finally here; don't miss the WORLD PREMIERE of ELLEN'S new American Express commercial! Ellen also introduces you to one of her commercial's co-stars. And, the latest tiara wearing cast-off from "The Bachelor: Rome," ERICA ROSE, also known as "The Socialite" drops by.

videos.title: Tina Fey/Katharine Heigl/Corrinne Bailey Rae
videos.overview: Comedian TINA FEY, creator of the new comedy "30 Rock (NBC, Wednesday @ 8pm)," gets a firsthand lesson on how to be a host from the queen of talk shows herself, ELLEN. Will Tina make the cut as Ellen's stand-in? "Grey's Anatomy (ABC, Thursday @ 9pm)" star KATHERINE HEIGL talks about her romantic engagement to her musician boyfriend. And, can Ellen get to the truth about the rumors of on-set drama on "Grey's"? CORINNE BAILEY RAE performs "Put Your Records On" from her self-titled debut CD (in stories June 20, 2006). Kyle Paxman, known as the "JILTED BRIDE," who discovered her fiancé was being unfaithful six weeks before her wedding, shares her inspiring story of how she turned heartbreak into an amazing accomplishment.

videos.title: Annette Benning/JoJo
videos.overview: The WINNNER of "PROJEC RUNWAY," Jeffrey Sebelia, joins Ellen and answers the rumors of his cheating in the competition and brings a sketch of a dress for Ellen to wear to the Oscars. It's Wednesday, which means it's time for "Ellen's Wednesday's Wunnerful World of Web Videos!" Golden Globe winner ANNETTE BENING visits with Ellen and talks about "Oscar Buzz" for her critically acclaimed film "Running With Scissors." Annette also chats about how she juggles her family of five with her career. And, pop sensation JOJO performs her huge #1 hit, "Too Little Too Late," from her upcoming CD, "The High Road (in stores, Oct 17, 06)."

videos.title: Amanda Peet/Rick Smith Jr.
videos.overview: The always charming AMANDA PEET visits with Ellen and talks all about her first pregnancy, her recent nuptials and her hit series, "Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip(NBC, Monday @ 10)." Ellen tutors DJ Jonny for his upcoming driver's test. But how are jumping jacks and push-ups involved? Plus, a Halloween kids fashion show. And, you won't believe your eyes when VEGGIE CARD CUTTER, Rick Smith Jr., takes the floor. Rick can cut vegetables by throwing playing cards and holds the world record for throwing a card 216 ft 4 inches!

videos.title: Jon Cryer/Aaron Neville/Sharon Karriem
videos.overview: Ellen checks in on her hometown, New Orleans. Joining her is New Orleans native AARON NEVILLE, who discusses his personal struggle with the effects of Hurricane Katrina and performs "Stand By Me" from his new CD, "Bring It On Home...The Soul Classics." Plus, Ellen has a HUGE surprise for her audience and some lucky home viewers! Becky Zaheri, founder of the "Katrina Krewe," updates Ellen on their progress, and we check in on SHARON KARRIEM, who received a Quiznos from Ellen after the hurricane destroyed her business. JON CRYER stops by to chat about his hit show, "Two and a Half Men (CBS, Monday @ 9pm)." And, Ellen meets Guyland Leday, a 9-year-old accordion prodigy, who will perform with Terrance Simien & the Zydeco Experience

videos.title: Tyra Banks, Barry Manilow
videos.overview: The multi-talented host TYRA BANKS ("Tyra Bank Show" & "American's Next Top Model (The CW, Wednesday @ 8pm)") stops by to chat with Ellen about her multiple career successes. Plus, find out how Tyra pulled off one of the biggest pranks on Ellen's very set! Hey Fanilows! Get ready to sing along when the one and only BARRY MANILOW performs "<u>Can't Take My Eyes Off of You</u>" from his hit CD "<u>The Greatest Songs of the Sixties</u>." Then, Ellen helps you get in the Halloween spirit when she checks in on the "Pumpkin House" in West Virginia decked out in over 3,000 pumpkins! And, Ellen lets you sound off when she reads your e-mails in another hilarious edition of "WRITE ON."  Plus, someone's got an evil twin we've never seen before.  Who could it be?

videos.title: Courtney Cox
videos.overview: It's been a crazy season full of scandals and surprises on "The Bachelor," and Ellen has been riveted with the rest of America. This week, Jake finally made his decision between Vienna and Tenley -- was it the right one? Today the woman without the ring is visiting Ellen to spill everything -- about everyone! Then, COURTENEY COX is sure to have some fun and crazy stories -- she just returned from Jennifer Aniston's huge birthday party in Cabo San Lucas! Courteney has had a lot to celebrate recently, with her first Golden Globe nomination for her hit show "Cougar Town." She and husband David Arquette met while filming "Scream" -- and will soon get a chance to relive it when they start filming the fourth one this summer! Ellen will make sure to get an update on their beautiful daughter, Coco. It's also time for another round of Know or Go. While people are falling down, you never know if a celebrity might pop up with a big surprise for the audience!

videos.title: Simon Baker
videos.overview: Jake from "The Bachelor" has given the final rose, and today the couple is here to share all the behind-the-scenes details with Ellen! It's been one of the most scandal-filled and surprising seasons ever, and they have a lot of questions to answer! Ellen will find out all the drama, and she's making sure they answer the tough questions! While here, Jake might want to get some tips from the very sexy SIMON BAKER. He's been married for over 11 years! It must be the romance -- he said he loves an open fire with a sunset. Who wouldn't love a man like that? Being labeled the sexiest man on TV doesn't hurt either! Plus, last summer over 2 million people downloaded the #1 hit song, "Whatcha Say." It was JASON DERULO's first single, which made it clear that he was headed to the top! Now he's releasing his debut CD and is stopping by to perform his latest hit, "In My Head." And, Ellen has another group of audience members who will show off their unbelievable hidden talents today.

Lady Gaga (MTV Video Music Awards)
videos.overview:
Ellen kicks-off Season 8 with the biggest premiere ever -- direct from the MTV Video Music Awards! The incredible LADY GAGA, nominated for more VMAs than any other artist in history, is headed straight from the VMAs to Ellen's season premiere!

That's not it! JUSTIN TIMBERLAKE, KATY PERRY, and JUSTIN BIEBER are all stopping by... plus, you never know who else may drop in!

videos.title: Lauren Graham
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's first day back in the studio for a brand new season, and there's no one better to help get things started than her friend and star of "Parenthood," the hilarious LAUREN GRAHAM.

Ellen had plenty of time to get some GTL (gym, tan and laundry) this summer, so she's all set when the THE CAST OF "JERSEY SHORE" drops by.

He's starting Season 8 with a bang, joining Ellen at the VMAs -- USHER is in studio today to perform his hit, "DJ Got Us Fallin' in Love Again."

Plus, the hottest dancers from the latest season of "SO YOU THINK YOU CAN DANCE" are showing off their amazing moves.

videos.title: Jane Lynch
videos.overview:
She just won an Emmy, now JANE LYNCH is visiting Ellen for the very first time to share all the excitement of the new season of "Glee."

Last week, Ellen brought some cameras and crashed the U.S. Open in New York, and today she'll show you everything that happened.

One of Ellen's favorite "American Idol" alums, DAUGHTRY, will perform their huge hit, "September" from their album, "Leave This Town."

NEV SCHULMAN, ARI SCHULMAN and HENRY JOOST are here to tell Ellen about making her favorite new documentary, the suspenseful "Catfish."

videos.title: Ben Affleck
videos.overview:
Ellen has been looking for great talent, and she discovered another incredibly talented teen musician in 16-year-old TOM ANDREWS. She flew him all the way from England to L.A. just to perform for you!

It's been four years since he's stopped by; today the multi-talented BEN AFFLECK returns to Ellen! He directed, co-wrote and stars in the new movie "The Town." But can he juggle while being interviewed by Ellen?

You've heard the biggest hit of the summer, "Cooler Than Me," all over the radio. Now MIKE POSNER will perform it for Ellen!

videos.title: Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen
videos.overview:
MARY-KATE & ASHLEY OLSEN have their very own fashion line, and today they'll bring the season's hottest styles to Ellen!

Last week, Ellen dropped in on New York Fashion Week, and today she's showing what happened when she hit the runway.

On Wednesday night, the newest winner of "America's Got Talent" will be crowned. Ellen has the champagne ready to go when she welcomes them to the show!

videos.title: Courteney Cox, Alex O'Loughlin, Jesse Tyler Ferguson, OK Go
videos.overview:
While hiking in Utah, a man named ZAK ANDEREGG saw an abandoned puppy 350 feet down a hole -- and risked his life to save it! He and his wife MICHELLE are here with the dog, Riley, to share the beautiful story with Ellen.

COURTENEY COX knows how to stay young -- or at least keep the men around her young! She's starting a brand new season of "Cougar Town," where she's reuniting with "Friends" co-star Jennifer Aniston!

"Hawaii Five-O" is back and better than ever with a brand new reboot. The sexy ALEX O'LOUGHLIN will tell Ellen all about it.

OK GO is known for their inventive music videos, and today Ellen has the world premiere of their latest.

videos.title: Hugh Laurie
videos.overview:
He's hilarious and he's finally back to chat with Ellen -- HUGH LAURIE has the scoop on the brand new season of "House"!

Ellen is always searching for the most talented kids, and she found one in 6-year-old TANNER EDWARDS. He's an unbelievable hip-hop dancer and is coming here to perform for everyone.

He's in one of Ellen's favorite shows, "Modern Family." Today, the Emmy-nominated JESSE TYLER FERGUSON is here to tell her what's in store this season.

MICHAEL FRANTI & SPEARHEAD are releasing a brand new album, "The Sound of Sunshine," and will perform the title track for everyone.

videos.title: Brooke Shields
videos.overview:
It's been six long years since BROOKE SHIELDS was on the show, but today she's finally back and ready to have some fun!

Ellen recently hit the runway at the Richie Rich fashion show during New York Fashion Week. She brought along some cameras, and today you'll get to see everything that happened behind the scenes.

The multi-talented actress and singer Selena Gomez is here with her band, SELENA GOMEZ & THE SCENE. They'll perform their new song, "Round and Round" from their upcoming album, "A Year without Rain."

videos.title: Ed Helms
videos.overview:
The last time he was here, ED HELMS showed off his hidden talent: the ability to spin any object on his fingers! He's back -- and he just might have another talent to show off!

KELLY OSBOURNE is always up for something new. She's now the new co-host of "Fashion Police" on E! -- and is chatting with Ellen today.

LE REVE at the Wynn in Las Vegas is well-known its jaw-dropping acrobatics. The cast is here today to perform one of their unbelievable routines.

videos.title: Jimmy Smits
videos.overview:
Ellen loved the salsa lessons from JIMMY SMITS last year, so she's invited him back for another round on the dance floor!

Ellen loves MAROON 5, and their album, "Hands All Over," is getting a lot of attention. They're here to perform their hit song, "Misery."

videos.title: LL Cool J
videos.overview:
Ellen is always on the lookout for the most talented kids. Today she'll introduce you to 7-year-old rapper LIL P-NUT, who will astound the audience with his skills.

Last time here, LL COOL J beat Ellen in a round of Guesstures. She's got LL back today and might just challenge him to a rematch, but not before hearing about the new season of "NCIS: Los Angeles."

It's been a difficult few months for MAURA TIERNEY, now she's healthy and ready to go with her brand new show, "The Whole Truth," and Ellen can't wait to see her!

videos.title: John Stamos
videos.overview:
He's on one of the hottest shows on TV! Ellen's former WB neighbor, JOHN STAMOS, will return to his old home to share some inside details about "Glee."

Yesterday, the newest "Bachelor" was announced, and today he's making an exclusive talk show appearance -- only Ellen will have the inside scoop on the upcoming season!

When the new band VAMPIRE WEEKEND released their album, it went straight to #1. Now they're coming straight to the show to perform for Ellen.

videos.title: Patrick Dempsey
videos.overview:
The very sexy PATRICK DEMPSEY is back today to share all the details of the new season of "Grey's Anatomy" -- hopefully wearing the thong Ellen gave him last time!

The movie "The Social Network" hasn't been released yet, and it's already getting Oscar buzz! One of the stars, RASHIDA JONES, is here to tell Ellen all about it.

They won a Grammy for Best New Artist, and the Academy of Country Music Award for Top New Group -- now the ZAC BROWN BAND is here to perform "As She's Walking Away" from their album "You Get What You Give."

videos.title: Anthony Hopkins (Ellen Hits Broadway)
videos.overview:
While in New York, Ellen dropped in on a production of "Promises, Promises" with her friends Kristin Chenoweth and Sean Hayes. She brought along some cameras, and you'll get to see everything that happened!

It seems like every time TAYE DIGGS is here, he gets sexier! He'll stop by today to tell Ellen all about this season of "Private Practice," and she's expecting some photos of his son!

Since his debut in 2001, PETE YORN has consistently been an amazing musician. He just released his new, self-titled album and is stopping by to perform.

videos.title: Jennifer Grey (Breast Cancer Awareness Show)
videos.overview:
October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and Ellen is dedicated to finding a cure. The show is going pink today, and Ellen will share how she's helping the cause -- and how you can join in!

It was an emotional start to "Dancing with the Stars" for JENNIFER GREY. She and her dance partner, DEREK HOUGH, are stopping by to chat with Ellen.

Ellen is welcoming back her personal chef, ROBERTO MARTIN, who will teach everyone another delicious and healthy meal.

Ellen is always on the lookout for the greatest inventions, and she thinks she found them! Today she has four more KID INVENTORS who will show off their incredible creations.

videos.title: Ellen Pompeo
videos.overview:
What could possibly be better than an incredibly talented kid? Three talented kids! Nine-year-olds Gavin Pecson & Kris Mangonon, and 8-year-old Kida Burns are amazing hip-hop dancers who formed the crew THE ART OF TECHNIQUE and they're bringing their moves here.

"Grey's Anatomy" is back for another season, and that means ELLEN POMPEO is back with Ellen today! She has the latest on her hit show, and is sure to have some adorable stories from her daughter's first birthday!

KENNY CHESNEY is one of the biggest country music stars ever -- and he's not stopping! He just released his new album, "Hemingway's Whiskey" and will drop by to perform and chat with Ellen.

videos.title: Jenny McCarthy
videos.overview:
Last week, GREYSON CHANCE gave his biggest performance ever at Canada's We Day. Ellen will connect with him today to hear all about the exciting experience.

Whenever JENNY McCARTHY stops by, it's always a fun time! Whether Ellen is dropping her in a dunk tank or scaring her with a giant panda, Jenny is up for anything. She'll have a lot to talk about when she shares her new book with Ellen; "Love, Lust, and Faking It: The Naked Truth About Sex, Lies, and True Romance."

You may not know the name ARMIE HAMMER now, but you will! He's in the new movie "Social Network," and is getting a lot of attention -- there's even talk of an Oscar! He's introducing himself to Ellen today.

RASCAL FLATTS has been together for 10 years, and they're still going strong. Today they're here to perform one of their greatest hits before they chat with Ellen.

Your jaws will drop when Ellen welcomes quick-change artists SOS & VICTORIA.

videos.title: Felicity Huffman
videos.overview:
Last week, ANDERSON COOPER focused on an issue that's very important to Ellen: bullying. Today she's talking with him live from New York about what's happening -- and how you can help put an end to it.

Ellen has been searching for the worst of the worst photos that you paid for -- and she found them! Today Ellen's got another hilarious batch of BAD PAID-FOR PHOTOS that you have to see to believe!

Whenever FELICITY HUFFMAN stops by, Ellen is ready to challenge her to a game. Today they're trying a brand new one -- you never know what's going to happen!

Not only does Ellen love GRACE POTTER & THE NOCTURNALS, Rolling Stone called them the Best New Act of 2010! They're here today to perform one of their hit songs.

videos.title: Howie Mandel
videos.overview:
Ellen is always making sure HOWIE MANDEL feels comfortable, even it means sealing him in an inflatable ball! The hilarious guy is about to hit the road on tour, and is making Ellen his first stop!

For years, KEN JEONG has been a licensed medical doctor. Now he's one of the most talked about comedians, and starring on "Community!" He's here to tell Ellen how it all happened.

MIKE TOMPKINS has become an internet sensation with his web videos -- where he not only sings, but creates all the music -- with just his mouth! Ellen welcomes him here today to recreate one of the popular videos!

videos.title: Michael C. Hall
videos.overview:
One of Ellen's all-time favorite shows is "Dexter" -- and today Dexter himself, MICHAEL C. HALL, is finally here for the very first time and Ellen's getting the scoop on the exciting new season.

Last year, TONY DANZA took on one of the hardest jobs in America -- he became a high school English teacher! His new show, "Teach: Tony Danza" follows his experience, and he'll tell Ellen what it was like.

Ellen saw a video of C.J. HOLLAND & DAKOTA BRADLEY singing, and had to get them here! They'll be performing a beautiful song for her today.

videos.title: Mike "The Situation" Sorrentino & Karina Smirnoff
videos.overview:
MIKE "THE SITUATION" SORRENTINO has a new ritual: gym, tan, laundry... and dance! He's partnered with KARINA SMIRNOFF on "Dancing with the Stars" and will show Ellen what he's got.

Ellen's friend DAVID SPADE just can't stay away! It's his 12th time here, and he's always hilarious. Today will be no exception!

Legendary producer Danger Mouse, and the lead singer of The Shins, James Mercer, have teamed to create the critically acclaimed duo, BROKEN BELLS. They'll perform their hit song today for Ellen, "The High Road."

videos.title: Bruce Willis
videos.overview:
It's been six long years since BRUCE WILLIS has been here, but today he's back! He's still as big an action star as ever and is taking a minute to chat with Ellen about everything that he's been up to.

Ellen's WB neighbor and fellow ping-pong enthusiast KALEY CUOCO is back to work after her recent horseback riding injury. Ellen will make sure Kaley is comfortable when she stops by today.

JOSHUA RADIN sang for Ellen and Portia at their wedding, and today Ellen is excited to see him again as he premieres a song from his brand new album, "The Rock and The Tide."

videos.title: Minnie Driver
videos.overview:
She can act, she can sing, and she's helping to fight breast cancer. The always delightful MINNIE DRIVER is back today. Her son, Henry, is 2 years old, and Minnie is sure to have some stories!

It was a scary year for BRET MICHAELS, but he's back to health and back to work. Today he's sitting with Ellen and will share what he's learned from the experience.

You may wonder why DOMINIC LACASSE is better known as "FLAG MAN," but after he shows off his talents today, it will be clear!

PEREZ HILTON is well known for his gossip blog -- and for saying what he thinks. He's been thinking a lot recently... and today he's here with an important announcement.

videos.title: Simon Baker
videos.overview:
The very sexy SIMON BAKER will feel right at home when he visits Ellen today -- he filmed some of his hit show, "The Mentalist," on Ellen's set! He's sure to bring a lovely thank-you gift for her.

As if the show couldn't get any sexier, CHRISTINA HENDRICKS is stopping by to talk about her breakout role on "Mad Men." Ellen wants to hear what it's like working alongside Jon Hamm!

BRUNO MARS has the #1 hit in the country, and he's here to perform it for Ellen. You don't want to miss him sing, "Just the Way You Are."

videos.title: Eva Longoria Parker
videos.overview:
The gorgeous EVA LONGORIA PARKER is visiting Ellen today. Last time, she won a basketball challenge. Can she best Felicity Huffman's score in Funglish?

Every time KEVIN NEALON stops by, no one can stop laughing! The incredibly funny guy is returning today to tell Ellen the latest on his show, "Weeds."

If you don't know about FLORENCE + THE MACHINE, you should! They were on this year's MTV Video Music Awards and will be opening for U2 next year, and they're here to perform for Ellen today!

videos.title: Russell Brand
videos.overview:
RUSSELL BRAND is stopping by for the first time -- and he couldn't be busier. He'll soon be married to Katy Perry, in a wedding that will last six days! He just wrote a new book, "My Booky Wook 2: This Time It's Personal."

"The Social Network" has been the top movie for several weeks and today the film's star, JESSE EISENBERG, is here to chat with Ellen about all the excitement.

One of the breakout dancers on this season of "Dancing with the Stars" is KYLE MASSEY. He and his partner, LACEY SCHWIMMER, are stopping by to tell Ellen all about it.

Actress SHEILA KELLEY discovered a new way to work out -- by stripping! She's stopping by to share her fitness secrets with Ellen.

videos.title: Chris O'Donnell
videos.overview:
Last time here, CHRIS O'DONNELL showed off one of his hidden talents -- karaoke! When he's back today, Ellen's finding out what else he can do!

ASHLEY TISDALE has grown up from "High School Musical" -- now she's on the popular new show, "Hellcats," where she plays the captain of a cheer squad. She'll stop by and might have a routine to teach Ellen!

videos.title: Jeff Foxworthy
videos.overview:
When he visited Ellen before, the hilarious JEFF FOXWORTHY was full of stories about his children. It seems he learned a lot from them -- he just released a brand new children's book and has all the details for Ellen.

Ellen saw an amazing 12-year-old singer named SHEALEIGH VOITL on YouTube, and had to get her here! She'll be performing a song you don't want to miss!

Everyone knows that Ellen loves playing games, and today she's introducing a brand new one! Today's audience won't be sorry they played!

videos.title: Clint Eastwood
videos.overview:
CLINT EASTWOOD doesn't often appear on talk shows, but he wouldn't miss a visit with Ellen! Her WB neighbor is stopping by to tell her about his new movie, "Hereafter" -- and to remind her to stay off his lawn!

When KELLIE PICKLER stops by, Ellen never knows what to expect -- other than Kellie will have her laughing the entire time!

Through the magic of television, Ellen gets to visit all 50 states, but not everyone gets to make it to California. Today she's surprising one lucky home viewer with a trip to one of the most gorgeous spots in the Golden State.

videos.title: Wanda Sykes
videos.overview:
If you're still deciding what to wear for Halloween, Ellen's got you covered. She's got great kid costume ideas you'll love!

Whenever WANDA SYKES has an opinion, one thing is certain: it'll be hysterical! Ellen's friend is about to start a new stand-up tour, but will first stop by the show!

Four years ago, a pregnant BRYCE DALLAS HOWARD joined Ellen for her Mother's Day Show -- now she's back and will be sure to have stories about her boy.

videos.title: Hilary Duff
videos.overview:
If you're still deciding what to wear for Halloween, Ellen's got you covered with great kid costume ideas you'll love!

HILARY DUFF proved she's both a talented actress and an amazing singer, now she's adding author to the list! She's just written a new book and will have all the details for Ellen.

Then, she's moved out of the hills and onto the dance floor -- AUDRINA PATRIDGE is here with TONY DOVOLANI to talk about "Dancing with the Stars" -- and they'll perform a number for everyone.

Earlier this year, Ellen introduced you to the new band, ONE ESKIMO. She loves them so much, she brought them back to perform another song.

videos.title: Greyson Chance
videos.overview:
All summer long, GREYSON CHANCE has been hard at work on his debut album. It's almost ready, and today he's stopping by for the world premiere of his brand new single, "Waiting Outside the Lines." He's performing it live for Ellen -- and you don't want to miss out!

For the past year, DIANE SAWYER has been delivering the news with poise and dignity on "ABC World News." Now she's ready to put her feet up and have a laugh with Ellen!

BETHENNY FRANKEL made herself known as a "Real Housewife of New York City" -- now she's helping people stay thin by eating right. Today she's sharing a recipe from her book, "The Skinnygirl Dish: Easy Recipes for Your Naturally Thin Life."

videos.title: David Beckham
videos.overview:
The sexiest man in the world is back in L.A.! DAVID BECKHAM recovered from a frightening injury and is once again playing with the L.A. Galaxy soccer team, but he wouldn't think of playing without first stopping by to visit Ellen!

SARA BAREILLES is back with a brand new #1 album, "Kaleidoscope Heart." She's here to perform her hit single, "King of Anything."

Ellen is always up for a game -- today she's got another fun Hasbro game that everyone will love!

videos.title: First Lady Michelle Obama
videos.overview:
It's a big day! FIRST LADY MICHELLE OBAMA and SECOND LADY DR. JILL BIDEN will be here! The presidential wives are encouraging everyone to support military families and will share why it's so important. Also, during the campaign, Ellen started a fun dance battle between the President and First Lady -- now we'll see what moves they've got today!

The Grammy-wining country music duo SUGARLAND is returning to perform their hit single "Stuck on You," from their brand new album.

videos.title: Vanessa Williams (Halloween Show)
videos.overview:
Look out behind you! It's Ellen's spooky Halloween Show! You don't want to miss what she'll be this year -- she's going as something that everyone is talking about!

Ellen is starting off with a treat for everyone -- VANESSA WILLIAMS is dropping by! She's the newest housewife on Wisteria Lane -- and the claws are out!

For the first time, the hilarious SETH ROGEN is here! He just got engaged to his girlfriend this fall -- and Ellen is going to find out all about their marriage plans! She'll also find out about his brand new action movie, "The Green Hornet."

The "Jersey Shore" house has a brand new member this season: DEENA NICOLE CORTESE. The self-described "blast in a glass and party in a body" is stopping by to tell Ellen what it was like to join the New Jersey crew.

When BRUNO MARS was here recently, he gave such a great performance that Ellen had to have him back! Today he's here to perform a special version of his hit, "Just the Way You Are."

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez
videos.overview:
She can sing, act and dance -- now JENNIFER LOPEZ is gaining yet another skill: judging! The brand new season of "American Idol" premieres tomorrow, and Jennifer is stopping by to tell Ellen what we can expect -- not just from the contestants, but from the new judges, too!

Last year, People magazine labeled MATT BOMER the Sexiest Rising Star -- now it's safe to say he's simply a sexy star! His show, "White Collar," returns tonight and it's better than ever!

videos.title: Natalie Portman
videos.overview:
It's been an exciting few months for NATALIE PORTMAN! Not only is she the subject of Oscar buzz for her incredible performance in "Black Swan," she's also starring in the new comedy, "No Strings Attached," and she's just announced that she's pregnant! Ellen will get all the baby details today!

MADISON McKINLEY created quite a stir on "The Bachelor" this week, and today she's stopping by to tell Ellen what happened -- and why she insists on wearing vampire fangs!

videos.title: Amy Poehler
videos.overview:
It's always a fun time when the hilarious and charming AMY POEHLER stops by! She's already got her hands full with her young son, Archie, her husband, Will Arnett, and now her show "Parks & Recreation" is back and better than ever! Though she always finds time to visit Ellen!

There always seems to be drama on "The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills," but housewife LISA VANDERPUMP manages to stay above it. Mostly. Today she's stopping by to tell Ellen what really happens.

Last week, Ellen showed a YouTube video of a guy performing an incredible illusion. She wanted to meet him and today she gets her wish. Illusionist ERIC ROSS is here to show off some of his unbelievable tricks.

videos.title: Jeff Bridges
videos.overview:
Just weeks after JEFF BRIDGES visited Ellen last year, he won an Academy Award. Who knows what'll be in store for him after he stops by today?! He's here to tell Ellen about his latest movie, "True Grit," and hopefully will bring more of those hilarious Bad Album Covers he collects!

Since their debut album in 2008, THE SCRIPT has become one of the hottest new bands. The Irish group has since opened for Paul McCartney and U2, and their hit song "Breakeven" is all over the radio. Their second album, "Science & Faith" is out this week -- and they're stopping by to perform a song for Ellen.

videos.title: Minnie Driver
videos.overview:
You never know what MINNIE DRIVER will bring when she visits Ellen -- one time she brought a goat! The Academy Award-nominated actress is back again today to talk about her brand new movie. Last year, her adorable boy Henry had just learned animal noises -- and Ellen is sure to find out what he's discovered since.

Ellen can't get enough of the Bad Paid-For Photos her audience is sending in, and today she's invited another group of brave people to share theirs on the show -- live!

videos.title: Drew Brees
videos.overview:
Now that Ellen is a big football fan, there's no one better to get her ready for the Super Bowl than her friend, New Orleans Saints quarterback and last year's Super Bowl Most Valuable Player, DREW BREES.

Valentine's Day is coming soon, so the beautiful and sweet JENNIFER LOVE HEWITT is getting in the spirit with her TV movie, "The Lost Valentine." She's sure to have some stories about working alongside Betty White!

The hilarious JOEL McHALE is stopping by today for the very first time. Not only is he starring in the hilarious show "Community" and continuing to host "The Soup," he's made some time to visit Ellen.

videos.title: Ellen's Surprise Birthday Party!
videos.overview: Break out the party hats and piñatas -- it's Ellen's birthday today! We're celebrating by turning today's show into one giant surprise party! Some of the biggest celebrities are stopping by to celebrate -- and Ellen has absolutely no idea who they'll be! She does know that one of her favorite bands, ONE ESKIMO, will perform whatever song she chooses. And of course, it's not Ellen's birthday without lots of gifts -- not for her, but for the entire audience!

videos.title: Anthony Hopkins
videos.overview:
It's an award-winning day at Ellen -- the incredibly talented ANTHONY HOPKINS is here. The legendary actor has an Academy Award, an Emmy and a Golden Globe! He's now in the new movie "The Rite," and will tell Ellen all about the spooky film.

MELISSA LEO might not have an Oscar, but everyone thinks she just might win one! There's all sorts of Oscar buzz about her role in "The Fighter," and Ellen is talking to her about it today!

videos.title: Shemar Moore
videos.overview:
There's no better way to end the week than with a visit from SHEMAR MOORE! The sexy guy is stopping by during Ellen's birthday week to wish her the best -- and she wishes he'll take his shirt off again!

Shemar isn't the only sexy guy to drop by -- the up and coming ALEX PETTYFER is visiting Ellen. He's on his way to becoming the next big star. USA Today called his new movie, "I Am Number Four," the #1 movie to watch this year!

One of Ellen's favorite musicians, AMOS LEE, is here to perform his song, "Windows Are Rolled Down," from his brand new album, "Mission Bell."

videos.title: Jesse Tyler Ferguson
videos.overview:
The hilarious JESSE TYLER FERGUSON is returning to Ellen today. His hit show, "Modern Family," is more popular than ever! Last time here, Jesse told Ellen how his mother didn't understand technology -- and mom just might get him back by sending Ellen some embarrassing photos!

Now that Ellen is a big football fan, she wants to learn everything about it! Since the gorgeous MARISA MILLER is an NFL spokesperson, she's the perfect one to teach Ellen. Plus, Marisa is on the cover of Shape magazine for the 8th time, so they can swap beauty tips!

In October, THE BAND PERRY released their debut album -- and now they're nominated for a Grammy! The three siblings are stopping by to perform their hit song, "If I Die Young."

The Super Bowl is just days away -- and Ellen is sending some of her lucky fans to the big game. Today they're hearing the exciting news for the first time -- direct from Ellen -- and hitting the road right away!

videos.title: Julianna Margulies
videos.overview:
The SAG Awards were this weekend, and JULIANNA MARGULIES won once again for her incredible role in "The Good Wife." She holds the record for the most wins -- now she's got eight! And that's not the only achievement in her family; her adorable boy just turned 3, and his proud mother is stopping by today.

The hilarious KEVIN NEALON knows how to class it up for Ellen -- last time here, he wore a tuxedo! It's hard to imagine how he'll top himself when he stops by today, but he's always up for the challenge.

videos.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
videos.overview:
In the past few months, Ellen has been following all the drama on "The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills." Today, she's getting down to the details when TAYLOR ARMSTRONG, CAMILLE GRAMMER, ADRIENNE MALOOF, KYLE RICHARDS and LISA VANDERPUMP all stop by. If there's one thing Ellen has learned, it's that when all the housewives are here -- anything goes!

Everyone is talking about DARREN CRISS! He's the hottest new cast member on "Glee," and today he's stopping by to visit Ellen for the first time. He became a celebrity overnight -- and he has the stories to go with it!

Ellen tracked down the world's fastest violinist, OLIVER LEWIS, all the way over in Ireland and wanted to fly him here for you to see. He broke the Guinness World Record by performing "Flight of the Bumblebee" in 1 minute and 3 seconds, but that's not good enough for him! He'll attempt to break his own record right here with Ellen!

videos.title: Jennifer Aniston
videos.overview:
She's one of the biggest stars in the whole world, and she was Ellen's first guest ever! It's always an event when the one and only JENNIFER ANISTON stops by!

For Ellen, there's nothing better than surprising her fans! Today, one lucky person is getting a huge, life-changing surprise -- and it's just the start of a whole month of giveaways!

videos.title: Super Bowl Show
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's annual Super Bowl Show! This week she sent two of football's biggest fans on a road trip to Dallas, and she's checking in live today -- one of them might win tickets to the big game!

There's no one better to join Ellen for the football party than AMY ADAMS! The big game is this weekend, but she's got a big night coming up: Amy just got her third Academy Award nomination in six years!

When CHANNING TATUM was last here, he did push-ups for charity! The sweet -- and sexy -- guy is dropping by once again today. Ellen is ready for a full workout this time around!

Ellen just can't get enough of the hilarious BETHENNY FRANKEL. She always brings great tips and recipes to stay thin without losing out on delicious food -- and today she's tackling the big event of the weekend: the Super Bowl party!

videos.title: 1,300th Show!
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's 1,300th show -- and it's going to be a big one! She's marking the milestone with a show full of her favorite moments from the past eight years; from the biggest celebrities to her favorite kids, to all the hilarious games -- and much more!

There's no one better to join Ellen on the anniversary show than her favorite guest and good friend, ALLISON JANNEY. Since the first season, Ellen and Allison have competed in all sorts of challenges -- and today Allison will make yet another attempt to unseat Ellen as champion.

Plus, today Ellen is going to do something for a loyal viewer that she's never done before!

videos.title: Matthew Perry
videos.overview:
Last week, Ellen sent two football superfans on a road trip to the Super Bowl -- and they got more than they expected! After braving one of the worst blizzards in history and taking a detour to Burbank, Jodanna and Brittany finally made it to Dallas -- and were in for some incredible surprises. Today they're showing Ellen everything that happened.

When the hilarious MATTHEW PERRY was last here, he told Ellen he had only 666 twitter followers. Thanks to Ellen, now he has hundreds of thousands! That's not all -- now he's got a brand new show, "Mr. Sunshine," and is stopping by today to visit Ellen.

The Grammys are this weekend, and one of the tunes nominated for Song of the Year is by RAY LAMONTAGNE AND THE PARIAH DOGS, and they'll be here to sing "Beg Steal or Borrow."

videos.title: Justin Bieber
videos.overview:
Ellen's got the fever -- Bieber Fever! One of the biggest stars of our time, the one and only JUSTIN BIEBER is here today! Not only is he up for two Grammy Awards on Sunday, his brand new movie, "Justin Bieber: Never Say Never," is out on Friday! He'd better be coming with a gift in hand... for Ellen's birthday he promised her a lock of his hair!

Justin isn't the only Grammy-nominated guest stopping by! Five-time nominee JAMES BLUNT is here to perform his hit song, "Stay the Night."

videos.title: Clay Matthews
videos.overview:
Ellen picked the Green Bay Packers to win the Super Bowl -- and they did! Now the team's linebacker, the incredible CLAY MATTHEWS, is stopping by to tell Ellen all about winning the big game.

One of Ellen's favorite musicians is now a Grammy nominee! The amazing ADAM LAMBERT is stopping by to perform his newly nominated song, "Whataya Want from Me."

The hilarious MATT LeBLANC is back on TV in a character only he can play: Matt LeBlanc! He's playing himself in the new show, "Episodes" and is making sure to stop by for a visit with Ellen.
