Ellen is always on the lookout for amazing dancers -- and she thinks she's found one of the best! She's flying him all the way from Hong Kong to perform just for you!

videos.title: Ricky Martin
videos.overview:
The Grammys are this weekend an Ellen knows how to get the party started -- by welcoming one of the most popular musicians in the world, the Grammy-winning RICKY MARTIN! He'll treat everyone to a performance of a song from his brand new album, "Musica+Alma+Sexo," and he might even surprise the audience with one of his biggest classic hits!

One of the biggest stars around is stopping by -- SAMUEL L. JACKSON! His movies have made more than any other actor's, but nothing goes to his head -- except his many cool hats! He's always up for a fun time with Ellen.

Valentine's Day is coming fast, and if you don't have the perfect card picked out -- you're in luck! Ellen is sending her writer, Amy, to the card aisle to help people find the perfect way to say "I Love You!"

videos.title: Lady Antebellum
videos.overview:
Today's a day all about love -- and it's harder to find a band that Ellen loves more than LADY ANTEBELLUM! They made their television debut with Ellen and have had huge success ever since. Just this year, they're nominated for a whopping six Grammys! They'll chat with Ellen and perform their hit, "Hello World."

COLIN FIRTH knows all about love at first sight -- it happened when he met his wife! He'll share the heartwarming story of how they met. He'll also tell Ellen what it's like to be nominated for an Academy Award for the second year in a row!

When BEN McKENZIE was last here, he told Ellen about a scene he did in "Southland" -- without pants! Maybe he'll consider doing a pantsless interview today! The sexy guy is stopping by, and he'll make sure to give Ellen an update on his adorable rescue dog, Oscar.

Ellen will be testing how strong love is between her newlywed fans when she plays a special version of Newlywed Know or Go! The stakes are high for these newlyweds -- if they don't know enough about each other, they GO!

videos.title: Randy Jackson
videos.overview:
The "dawg" is coming to Ellen! RANDY JACKSON misses Ellen so much, he couldn't miss a chance to visit! He'll stop by and share all the behind-the-scenes details on this season of "American Idol"!

Lots of people know just how wonderful dancing can be -- especially CHERYL BURKE. Not only is she a two-time champion on "Dancing with the Stars," she credits dancing with changing her life. She'll tell Ellen all about it when she stops by to talk about her new book.

A college student named NICHOLAS CORRALES became an unwitting YouTube star when he went to dunk a basketball during an acrobatic halftime performance -- and ended up dunking himself! He's diving right in to the show today to visit Ellen!

videos.title: Liam Neeson
videos.overview:
After six years, the wonderful LIAM NEESON is making his grand return to the show! The incredible actor has racked up quite a list of honors. Not only has he earned an Academy Award nomination, he's also been named an Officer in the Order of the British Empire by Queen Elizabeth II!

It seems like everything JENNIFER HUDSON does -- she does well. First she won over everyone on "American Idol," then she wowed everybody with her incredible Oscar-winning performance in "Dreamgirls." She's stopping by to chat with Ellen and to sing her single "Where You At," from her new album, "I Remember Me."

The current season of "The Bachelor" has already been a controversial one -- and the drama isn't over! This week, another woman didn't get a rose -- and she's dropping by to tell Ellen her side of the story.

videos.title: Howie Mandel
videos.overview:
Ellen can't stop laughing whenever HOWIE MANDEL stops by! The outrageous guy knows how to have fun -- even if it means walking around the stage in a giant, hermetically sealed inflatable ball! The unpredictable guy is here to tell Ellen about the new season of "America's Got Talent."

Howie isn't the only outrageous guest on the show -- the absolutely hilarious KYM DOUGLAS is dropping by. She always comes with a bunch of beauty tips that she isn't afraid to demonstrate -- even if it means stepping into a bathtub full of wine! Today she and Ellen are testing out some "As Seen on TV" products.

Last week, Ellen sent Jeannie on the road with a truck full of Chevy Cruzes, and today she's making a stop -- and surprising one lucky viewer with one of the brand new cars! It's a Big Truckin' Deal -- and you never know where it's going next!

videos.title: Cory Monteith
videos.overview:
CORY MONTEITH went from working as a store greeter to being one of the most popular guys in Hollywood! His show, "Glee," is bigger than ever -- and the cast is already planning to hit the road for another tour this summer!

Ellen is well known as a proud CoverGirl, but today she's meeting a different type of cover girl -- the "Sports Illustrated" Swimsuit Issue cover model! The cover is announced on the 14th, and the lucky model is stopping by today -- probably to get some tips from Ellen!

videos.title: Mike 'The Situation' Sorrentino
videos.overview:
Game Week is back, and you have more chances to win from home! It's Day 1 of Didja Ever Game Week, and the prizes are the biggest yet! Every time someone wins on the show, a home viewer wins too! It all leads up to the Grand Prize: an international Carnival Cruise worth $35,000!

Ellen's got a situation -- MIKE "THE SITUATION" SORRENTINO -- and he's taking a break from Gym, Tan and Laundry, to bring his famous abs to the show. MTV just announced that his show, "Jersey Shore," is headed to Italy next season, but first he's here to tell Ellen the latest on the current season.

Ellen loves the Gym Class Heroes, and now the lead singer -- TRAVIE McCOY -- is hitting it big as a solo artist. He's stopping by to perform his latest hit, "We'll Be All Right."

videos.title: Aaron Rodgers
videos.overview:
Ellen picked the Green Bay Packers to win the Super Bowl this year -- and thanks to MVP AARON RODGERS, they did! During a press conference, he even mentioned he had a crush on Ellen.

CHRISTINA APPLEGATE will be watching her back when she stops by -- she was the first celebrity Ellen scared on the show! Christina's always ready for a fun time when she's here!

What happens when you team country music superstar JASON ALDEAN and pop superstar KELLY CLARKSON? You get the incredible song, "Don't You Wanna Stay" -- and they're both here to perform it for Ellen.

Plus, it's Day Two of Didja Ever Game Week -- and it's getting bigger! Ellen's audience members are competing for the ultimate prize of a Carnival Cruise -- and if that weren't enough pressure, they're also playing for a home viewer! Don't miss your chance to win from home!

videos.title: Kellie Pickler
videos.overview:
Whether KELLIE PICKLER is kissing Clint Eastwood, getting scared by Ellen, or just telling a hilarious story, she and Ellen always have a blast when she's here. Last time, she couldn't stop gushing about her fiancÃ© -- now they're married, and Kellie is here for her first interview since the wedding to share exclusive photos from the big day!

Ellen's friend GREYSON CHANCE keeps getting bigger and bigger! He's about to release his debut album and he's on tour with Miranda Cosgrove, plus his hit song is everywhere! Now he's coming back to where it all began to perform "Waiting Outside the Lines" for Ellen.

Didja Ever Game Week continues, and the competition is getting intense! With a huge prize at stake, today's contestants will do anything to win! Plus, you still have a chance to win from home, so don't miss out on the Grand Prize of a Carnival Cruise!

videos.title: Pam Anderson
videos.overview:
This past Sunday, sexy TREVOR BAYNE broke records by becoming the youngest winner of the Daytona 500 -- at just 20 years old! It was his first time in the race -- and now he's about to mark another first when he stops by to tell Ellen all about the exciting win!

Ellen is in for a wild interview -- PAM ANDERSON is here! Pam's never afraid to strip down to a bikini or flip over a couch when she stops by. She's as outrageous as ever and there's no telling what she'll be up to today, but it's certain to be memorable.

When ADELE was here in December, she blew everyone away with an unbelievable performance. Her upcoming album, "21," is the #1 most pre-ordered album on iTunes, and she's coming back once again to give another incredible performance.

It's Day 4 of Didja Ever Game Week, and with a huge prize on the line, today's contestants are in it to win it! You have a chance to win, too -- so be sure to enter!

videos.title: Game Week Finale
videos.overview:
It's the big moment everyone has been waiting for all week long: the finale of Didja Ever Game Week! The winners from each day are going head-to-head for the ultimate prize -- an international Carnival Cruise for six! Plus, don't miss out on your chance to win from home!

A lot has changed for NEIL PATRICK HARRIS since he was last here -- he's now a proud papa! He's got two adorable baby boys and couldn't be happier. Good things come in pairs for Neil -- he also won two Emmys in September!

videos.title: Hugh Laurie
videos.overview:
Not only is the hilarious HUGH LAURIE a great actor -- he's also a singer! He's about to release a brand new blues album that he recorded in Ellen's hometown of New Orleans! When Hugh drops by, he'll also share the latest about "House."

DJ PAULY D is headed to Italy! The fourth season of his hit show, "Jersey Shore," is taking the cast across the Atlantic, and he's getting ready for the big trip... but not before stopping by to visiting Ellen!

Last week, the lucky winner of Didja Ever Game Week won an international Carnival Cruise, and Ellen isn't quite done giving away huge gifts! She's surprising a lucky viewer with a fabulous international Carnival Cruise!

videos.title: Heidi Klum
videos.overview:
If there's one person who likes to have fun, it's HEIDI KLUM! Whether she's throwing food around the set, staging photoshoots with Ellen, or even taking off her dress in the middle of an interview, it's always an outrageous time! Heidi won't hold back when she visits her friend Ellen today!

Last summer, TAIO CRUZ released his single, "Dynamite" -- and it became a smash hit! He's here to give a performance you don't want to miss!

Last week, Ellen sent Jeannie on the road with a trailer loaded with Chevy Cruzes, and today she's making a surprise stop to drop one off for a deserving viewer -- who has no idea what to expect!

videos.title: Matt Damon
videos.overview:
After eight seasons, the biggest superstar is finally stopping by for the very first time -- the sexy MATT DAMON! Not only has the Oscar-winning actor been in some of the best films ever, he's an incredible humanitarian. He's also quite the funny guy -- and he's ready to have some fun!

One of Ellen's favorite guests, Science Guy STEVE SPANGLER is back -- and he's bringing more of his amazing science experiments. Ellen never knows what to expect, so whether he's making a thousand ping-pong balls explode across the stage or lighting bubbles on fire, it'll be a surprise for everyone!

videos.title: Wanda Sykes
videos.overview: Ellen's close friend and funny-girl Wanda Sykes who's on her new stand-up tour. Topher Grace was last on the show 6 years ago and now he's promoting a new movie "Take Me Home Tonight" (2011) - he wrote, produced and starred in it. Two eliminated members of American Idol - Jacee Badeaux and Colton Dixon.

videos.title: Jerry O'Connell
videos.overview: Jerry O'Connell talks about The Defenders and life with his wife, Rebecca Romijn and two girls.

videos.title: Paris Hilton
videos.overview: Paris Hilton returns after a year with a new show planned and a new boyfriend. She also just recently turned the big 30. NEW GAME: Cut The Cord.

videos.title: Ellen Pompeo
videos.overview: Ellen Pompeo on Grey's Anatomy celebrates Mardi Gras with Ellen. Mike Tyson talks about his newest show Taking on Tyson.

videos.title: Valerie Bertinelli
videos.overview: Valerie Bertinelli continues her hot streak with Hot in Cleveland opposite legend Betty White. Miranda Cosgrove talks about her recent happenings, including singing and touring. Guess who's opening for her on the tour: Greyson Chance.

videos.title: Tyra Banks
videos.overview: Tyra Banks is planning to expand her online enterprise. Jerrod Niemann performs off his new album "Judge Jerrod and the Hung Jury" (performs song "Lover, Lover").

videos.title: Ryan Phillippe
videos.overview: When the sexy RYAN PHILLIPPE visited Ellen last year, he promised he'd teach her a little Tae Kwon Do! He's back today, and she's ready to go! Ellen also wants an update on his kids, since he is quite the proud papa! When BLAIR UNDERWOOD was researching his role on "L.A. Law," he became friends with the President of the Harvard Law Review -- Barack Obama! Now they're both presidents -- even if Blair is only a president on the hit show "The Event."

videos.title: Jimmy Fallon
videos.overview: If Ellen wants to see the hilarious JIMMY FALLON, she normally has to stay up late -- but not when he visits today! Jimmy just marked two years as host of "Late Night," and he's dropping by to celebrate. He'll also get a chance to show off some of his hysterical impressions. "Glee" is hotter than ever -- thanks to this season's newest (and sexiest) cast member, CHORD OVERSTREET. He's rumored to have dated Taylor Swift, Demi Lovato and Mila Kunis. Ellen is going to get to the bottom of it all! KENDRA WILKINSON has gone from the Playboy Mansion to the dance floor! The former "Girls Next Door" star will appear on the new season of "Dancing with the Stars" -- and today she's stopping by to get a few tips from Ellen!

videos.title: Clive Owen
videos.overview: The sexy CLIVE OWEN has a love story most only dream of -- he met his wife when they were playing the title roles in "Romeo and Juliet!" The Academy Award-winning actor is back to visit Ellen today! There's no predicting what the outrageous RAINN WILSON will do when he drops by. The hilarious star of "The Office" is here to talk about his new movie, "Super." It's been four long years since he last visited with Ellen, and she's going to find out why! The incredibly talented SELENA GOMEZ isn't just a great actress, she's an incredible singer! She's ready to release her third album later this year, and today she'll perform the new hit single, "Who Says"!

videos.title: Vanessa Hudgens
videos.overview: VANESSA HUDGENS is the Queen of Disney! After making it big in the "High School Musical" movies, she's starring in the new film, "Beastly." She shared an on-screen romance with the very hot Alex Pettyfer -- and Ellen wants to know all the details! For over 30 years, BRYAN ADAMS has been been rocking out -- and earned a whopping 15 Grammy nominations in the process! He's here for the first time to perform one of his hits from his new album, "Bare Bones."

videos.title: David Schwimmer
videos.overview: It's been seven long years since the hilarious DAVID SCHWIMMER has been here, but today he's finally back! Everyone knows him from his popular role as Ross on "Friends," but he's just as talented behind the camera too -- he's directing a brand new movie! When MICHAEL GRIMM won "America's Got Talent" last year, not only did he visit Ellen and give an unbelievable performance, he proposed to his girlfriend on the show! Now he's ready to release his debut CD -- and it's all going to help his grandparents rebuild after Katrina!

videos.title: Matthew McConaughey
videos.overview: MATTHEW MCCONAUGHEY is one of Ellen's most important guests -- he helped her celebrate her 1,000th show! Matthew now has an adorable baby daughter and Ellen can't wait to hear all about her -- and how his son Levi is as big brother! DURAN DURAN was one of the most successful bands of the '80s -- and they're still going strong! They've sold over 100 million albums and have won multiple Grammys. Today they're back to perform one of their new songs along with a classic hit! Ellen has been looking for a new sport to follow since football ended -- and it may be NASCAR! She'll find out when three-time Daytona 500 winner JEFF GORDON stops by. Jeff is trying his hand at Hollywood -- he's in the upcoming Pixar movie, "Cars 2." When Ellen wanted to start eating healthier and living better, she found a lot of guidance from KATHY FRESTON. Kathy is here today to share her simple and easy tips for a healthier lifestyle. She'll even go to a viewer's home to demonstrate how anyone can make the switch!

videos.title: Keith Urban
videos.overview:
One of Ellen's favorite country music superstars is swinging by to chat with Ellen -- KEITH URBAN! He and his wife, Nicole Kidman, just had an adorable baby girl and Ellen can't wait to congratulate him. The sexy guy is always ready to sing for Ellen, and today he'll give an incredible performance of his hit song, "Without You."

Things couldn't be going better for KALEY CUOCO. Not only is her hit show "The Big Bang Theory" more popular than ever, she's about to star in the hilarious new movie, "Hop." As busy as she is, nothing can keep her away from the ping-pong table -- and Ellen is ready for a challenge!

Ellen always loves having her friend, the hilarious BETHENNY FRANKEL here to share some of her great tips for staying healthy while still having fun. Today Bethenny is back -- and you won't want to miss what she has planned!

videos.title: Greg Kinnear
videos.overview:
GREG KINNEAR is never afraid to tackle a new project -- his latest is causing quite a controversy! He's starring in the miniseries "The Kennedys," which one network refused to air! He'll clear up the story when he stops by today.

NIGEL LYTHGOE is back as Executive Producer of "American Idol" -- and he's made some changes! Today he's stopping by to share them with Ellen, and to let everyone know what to expect for the rest of the season!

At just 13, SAOIRSE RONAN was nominated for an Academy Award! The Best Supporting Actress nominee is here today to meet Ellen -- and will tell her all about the exciting night, as well as her movie, "Hanna."

It's always a party when the legendary rock band HEART is here -- they helped kick off Ellen's 50th Birthday Show! Now they're back with a live DVD of their classic hits and will perform one today!

videos.title: Jennifer Hudson and Savannah Robinson
videos.overview:
Last month, Ellen introduced an incredibly talented 12-year-old singer, SAVANNAH ROBINSON, whose version of Jennifer Hudson's "And I Am Telling You" blew everyone away! It also blew away JENNIFER HUDSON -- and today she's joining Savannah in a duet of her iconic song!

CHRISTIAN SLATER is headed back to television with his brand new show, "Breaking In" -- but not before visiting Ellen! He once told Ellen he loves doing his own stunts -- so he'd better be prepared today!

LA TOYA JACKSON is dropping by, and Ellen is getting the latest on the behind-the-scenes drama on "Celebrity Apprentice!" Fellow contestant NeNe Leakes had a lot of opinions on the cast when she was here last week -- and Ellen is going to find out what La Toya thinks of it all!

videos.title: Helen Hunt
videos.overview:
There are few actresses more talented than HELEN HUNT! She is only the second actress to win a Golden Globe, an Emmy and an Academy Award -- and she's back to chat with Ellen today.

Not only can JAMES MARSDEN sing, dance and act -- he's also one of the sexiest guys around. He even used to model for Versace! He's bringing his good looks and great dance moves to Ellen!

Magician RICH FERGUSON is stopping by to show some of his unbelievable tricks to Ellen -- and they'll leave everyone astounded!

videos.title: Katie Holmes
videos.overview:
One half of one of the most famous Hollywood couples is stopping by -- KATIE HOLMES! She's now playing one of the most famous wives, Jackie Kennedy, in the controversial new mini-series, "The Kennedys" -- and she's here to tell Ellen all about it.

People can't get enough of KIM & KOURTNEY KARDASHIAN! The two are the queens of reality television and can hardly go anywhere without being swarmed by paparazzi. That's not stopping them from going to New York for their new show, "Kim & Kourtney Take New York" -- but today they're visiting Ellen first!

Whenever ONEREPUBLIC is here, they always give one of the best performances. Today they're back to sing their latest hit, "Good Life," from their album, "Waking Up."

videos.title: Orlando - LL Cool J
videos.overview:
Ellen is back at Universal Orlando Resort -- and she's bringing you along for all the fun! Whether she's riding the exciting roller coasters or checking out everything the CityWalk has to offer, it's the perfect spring break for everyone -- including you!

Ellen's not going to Orlando alone -- she's bringing the best guests along with her, including the sexy LL COOL J. It won't be his first time -- five years ago he had a blast riding The Hulk with Ellen, and they're ready to do it again!

DURAN DURAN was recently on the show and they were so amazing, Ellen invited them to perform in Orlando -- this time at an outdoor concert! Thousands of people will fill the CityWalk to see the legendary band perform one of their classic hits.

Ellen recently had "DANCE ASSASSIN" ROBERT HOFFMAN scare her unsuspecting staff members with his hilarious hidden dance moves. This time she's letting him loose in the Universal Orlando Resort -- and you never know who he'll scare next!

videos.title: Orlando - Eric Stonestreet
videos.overview:
It's another day of fun at Universal Orlando Resort, and Ellen has the best guests to keep the party going!

Kicking off the fun is none other than the hilarious ERIC STONESTREET. The Emmy-winning actor has been hard at work on the hugely popular "Modern Family" and can use a break -- but will he brave the Dueling Dragons?

A couple of months ago, Ellen met the cutest 7-year-old dinosaur expert, RILEY CHANDLER. She loved him so much, she gave him a trip to Universal Orlando Resort to experience the exciting Jurassic Park attraction! The adorable guy will have a full report for Ellen!

It wouldn't be a great trip to Orlando without another superstar performance on the CityWalk -- so KELLY CLARKSON will have the place hopping! Kelly has had some of the biggest pop songs in the last 10 years and will sing a favorite today.

videos.title: Carrie Underwood
videos.overview:
You know CARRIE UNDERWOOD as the winner of "American Idol" and as a country music superstar -- now you'll soon know her as an actress! She's acting for the very first time in the new movie "Soul Surfer" alongside Helen Hunt and Dennis Quaid! 

Fifteen years ago, NEVE CAMPBELL became a household name when she starred in one of the most popular horror movie trilogies ever. Now the highly-anticipated sequel, "Scream 4," is just a week away! Neve is stopping by to tell Ellen how it feels to return to her roots.

Eight years ago, Ellen welcomed country singer JOSH KELLEY as he made his television debut performance on the show. Today he's back to perform his new hit song, "Georgia Clay." Talent runs in the family -- his brother is Charles Kelley from Lady Antebellum!

videos.title: Kim Cattrall
videos.overview:
The hilarious KIM CATTRALL made a name for herself as Samantha, the no-holds-barred and sometimes controversial character on "Sex and the City." She's not shying away from the scandalous roles -- now she's playing a former porn star in "Meet Monica Velour," and is dropping by today! 

The sexy TIMOTHY OLYPHANT has a lot to celebrate... his show, "Justified," was just renewed for another season! Ellen will have the champagne ready when he visits today. 

RALPH MACCHIO has traded in his black belt for dancing shoes! The original "Karate Kid" actor joined this season of "Dancing with the Stars" and he's stopping by with dance partner KARINA SMIRNOFF to chat with Ellen -- and perform a routine just for her!

videos.title: Dwayne Johnson
videos.overview:
Every time DWAYNE JOHNSON stops by, Ellen finds another one of his fears -- whether it's tarantulas, roller coasters, or aliens sneaking up behind him! She'll see if there's anything else when he tells her about his new move, "Fast Five" -- which he filmed in gorgeous Rio de Janeiro! 

You know MATTHEW MORRISON as the caring teacher on the smash hit "Glee," but you'll soon know him as an incredible solo artist! He's headed on tour for his debut album and will stop by to perform a song for Ellen. 

There are few things more beautiful than a polar bear in its natural habitat -- and filmmaker JOHN DOWNER knows that first-hand! He created the new Discovery film, "Polar Bear: Spy on Ice" and will share some of the never-before-seen footage!

videos.title: Khloe Kardashian Odom & Lamar Odom
videos.overview:
People can't stop talking about KHLOE KARDASHIAN ODOM and her husband LAMAR! They are so popular, they're getting a brand new show, aptly titled, "Khloe & Lamar." They're stopping by for an exclusive interview with Ellen, and she's going to get all the details on what to expect! 

Ellen loves scary movies, and so does HAYDEN PANETTIERE! Hayden is starring in the highly anticipated "Scream 4," and she'll be here to tell Ellen all about it. Ellen has been known to scare her guests -- so Hayden might want to watch her step!

videos.title: Anne Hathaway
videos.overview:
One of the sweetest stars in Hollywood, ANNE HATHAWAY, is here to visit Ellen! She's beautiful and talented, and it's always fun when she drops by. Anne is starring in the animated film "Rio," and will soon take on the role of Catwoman -- and will share how she's preparing for part.

On this season of "Celebrity Apprentice," GARY BUSEY has no problem rocking the boat! Today the quirky actor will share some of the backstage drama that didn't make it on the show!

Producer JERRY WEINTRAUB has worked with legendary musicians including Elvis Presley and Frank Sinatra, and produced some of the most popular movies like "Karate Kid" and the "Oceans Eleven" trilogy -- and he's always ready with a story! Now you can hear it all in the new HBO documentary about Jerry, "His Way" -- but first he's coming here!

In the past few years, ROBYN has gone from a virtually unknown singer to an international pop star. She's here for the very first time to perform her hit song, "Dancing on My Own."

videos.title: Kate Walsh
videos.overview:
Last week, America was shocked when PIA TOSCANO was voted off "American Idol" -- including Ellen! Pia is an incredibly talented singer and Ellen wanted to get her on the show. Today Pia will talk about her controversial elimination, and sing for everyone!

KATE WALSH knows how to keep busy! Not only is she starring in the hit show, "Private Practice," she also created her very own fragrance, Boyfriend, completely on her own! She's making some time to visit, and will tell Ellen what she's been up to.

The hilarious PAUL REISER was nominated for an Emmy an incredible ten times for his hit show, "Mad About You." Now, after more than a decade, he's finally returning to television with a brand new show -- and that means he's returning to visit Ellen!

A few months ago, Ellen met speed-rapper GEORGE WATSKY when he impressed everyone with his skills. She loved him so much, he's back today to perform another one of his original raps.

videos.title: Jamie Foxx
videos.overview:
There's not much JAMIE FOXX can't do! He's got an Oscar, a Grammy and a Golden Globe -- and he's not stopping yet. After just releasing another hit album, he's now lending his voice to the star-studded animated movie, "Rio," and will get the energy going when he's here today.

Ellen can't get enough of sexy ISAIAH MUSTAFA! Not only has he starred in the famous Old Spice ads, he was also Ellen's red carpet correspondent for the MTV VMAs! That job must have impressed a lot of people -- he's now starring in a brand new Tyler Perry movie!

JESSIE J has written some of the most popular pop songs in the last few years -- and now she's making a name for herself with a highly-anticipated new album, "Who You Are." She's making her daytime television debut with Ellen and will perform her hit song, "Price Tag."

videos.title: Tyler Perry
videos.overview:
TYLER PERRY is one of the most successful people in Hollywood -- and he does it all! Tyler writes, directs, produces and acts, but there's still one thing he hasn't done: visit Ellen! Today he's changing that when he's here for the very first time. 

Ellen loves animals, and so does WAYNE PACELLE. As President and CEO of the Humane Society, Wayne has done so much to help inspire compassion toward animals -- and today he's telling Ellen about his brand new book. 

The competition is tough on this season of "Dancing with the Stars" -- and CHELSEA KANE knows it! She and dance partner MARK BALLAS will have the latest for Ellen, and will be sure to show off an impressive dance!

videos.title: Tina Fey
videos.overview:
She's beautiful, she's brilliant, she's hilarious -- and now TINA FEY is a top author! Tina is looking back on her life and sharing it all in her brand new book, "Bossypants," and will tell some of the best -- and funniest -- lessons she's learned. Plus, she just announced she's expecting her second child! 

Last summer, MIKE POSNER went from average college student to famous music star with his hit song, "Cooler Than Me." Now he's here to perform his latest single, "Bow Chicka Wow Wow."

videos.title: Robert Pattinson
videos.overview:
One of the hottest stars around is here today -- ROBERT PATTINSON! When the sexy guy stopped by last year, he had just cut off his curly locks for his new movie, "Water for Elephants." There's no telling what hairstyle he'll have today, but he's guaranteed to look great! 

Ellen isn't the only one watching the Royal Wedding! "So You Think You Can Dance" host CAT DEELEY found five wedding fanatics, and she's taking them on the trip of a lifetime to London for all the festivities! She'll share the details when she drops by, and will hopefully have an extra invitation for Ellen!

videos.title: Reese Witherspoon
videos.overview:
REESE WITHERSPOON is one of the sweetest, most beautiful and talented actresses in Hollywood -- and today she's visiting Ellen. She is always a gracious guest and brings along a treat. Last time she and Ellen enjoyed tea, and she's sure to have another surprise today! 

The sexy PAUL WALKER is ready for another round of the "Fast and Furious" movies -- and this time he got to film it in Rio de Janeiro! He's stopping by to share some of the details on "Fast Five"! 

Ellen recently heard 15-year-old JACKSON GUTHY rehearsing a song -- and immediately knew he had to perform on the show! He's releasing his debut single "L-O-V-I-N-G" this summer, but he's singing it for Ellen today!

videos.title: Gwenyth Paltrow
videos.overview:
There isn't anything GWYNETH PALTROW can't do! The Oscar-winning actress recently impressed everyone with her country singing skills, then wowed everybody with her phenomenal role on "Glee," and now she's releasing a cookbook! She's telling Ellen what inspired it all today! 

When DARREN CRISS & THE WARBLERS sang "Teenage Dream" on "Glee," it instantly became the best-selling song from the show! They are so popular, they're releasing their own album, but first they're all stopping by to perform the acoustic hit that made them stars!

videos.title: Mario Lopez
videos.overview:
MARIO LOPEZ takes care of himself, and he has the sexy body to prove it! But now he's not just taking care of himself -- he's got an adorable baby daughter and wants to make sure she stays healthy. He can help you do the same with his new cookbook, "Extra Lean Family," and he's stopping by to tell Ellen all about it.

CHRIS JERICHO has dominated the wrestling ring, and now he's dominating the dance floor! He's getting some of the top scores on "Dancing with the Stars" and is here today with dance partner CHERYL BURKE.

videos.title: Christina Aguilera
videos.overview:
For over a decade, CHRISTINA AGUILERA has been one of the top pop music superstars -- and now she's ready to help the next big star make it to the top! Christina is a coach on the brand new show, "The Voice," and will tell Ellen what to expect when it premieres tonight!

There are few people who love reality TV more than Ellen does -- but MARY McCORMACK is one of them! She's always looking for the newest and most outrageous show to share, and she'll tell Ellen what she's found today -- along with what to expect on the brand new season of her show, "In Plain Sight."

Since winning season 7 of "American Idol," DAVID COOK has been going non-stop! He's about to release his third album this summer, and will be here to perform his fantastic new single, "The Last Goodbye."

videos.title: Kristen Chenoweth
videos.overview:
This summer, Ellen made her Broadway debut in "Promises, Promises" with the hilarious KRISTIN CHENOWETH. Now Kristin is back on TV in her hysterical role on "Glee," but she's making a stop today to visit her friend and former co-star!

It's an exciting time for NICK CANNON! Any moment, he and Mariah Carey are about to be proud parents of twin babies! And if he weren't busy enough, he's doing a comedy special on Showtime next month, and is getting ready for a brand new season of "America's Got Talent." He'll have a lot on his plate, but he always makes time to chat with Ellen.

ALISON KRAUSS & UNION STATION have been performing for over 20 years -- and in that time, Alison has won a whopping 27 Grammys! They just released a brand new album, "Paper Airplanes," and will be here to perform one of their new singles.

videos.title: Lady GaGa
videos.overview:
LADY GAGA is the hottest and most talented pop star around -- and she's appearing exclusively with Ellen! She just released yet another #1 mega-hit, "Judas," and will give an incredible performance you won't see anywhere else! Then she'll sit down with Ellen to reveal what we can expect next!

Then, another huge superstar will be here... JUSTIN TIMBERLAKE! No matter what he does, he's always amazing. Not only is Justin one of the top musicians, he's an incredibly talented actor, and he only just turned 30! He's not visiting Ellen alone -- the Golden Globe-nominated MILA KUNIS is joining him! They both starred in Oscar-nominated films last year, and now they're having fun in the new comedy "Friends with Benefits" -- and Ellen is getting all the details on some of their sexier scenes!

videos.title: Orlando Bloom
videos.overview:
It's been four long years since ORLANDO BLOOM was here, but the wait is finally over! The sexy actor has been in some of the biggest movies ever, including "The Lord of the Rings" and "Pirates of the Caribbean" trilogies. Now he's in the independent film "Sympathy for Delicious," and will tell Ellen what else he's been up to since his last visit. 

JOSH GROBAN is always up for a fun time! When Ellen needed some help recreating Oscar-nominated films, he was the first to cover himself in blue body paint for "Avatar." He's also one of the most talented singers of all time, and will melt everyone's heart with a performance of his song, "Galileo."

videos.title: Steve Carell
videos.overview:
After seven hilarious years on "The Office," STEVE CARELL finally said goodbye -- and now he's coming to visit Ellen! He's one of the funniest and kindest guys around, and is still the only person to ever scare Ellen! She'll find out today what he's planning for his free time.

It's been an adventurous year for ALISON SWEENEY! This year, her hit show, "The Biggest Loser" went to New Zealand -- and she even went bungee jumping! The show keeps her busy, but her two adorable tots keep her even busier, and she'll have the latest on her cute kids.

videos.title: Steve Martin
videos.overview:
STEVE MARTIN is one of the top comedians of all time, and has starred in some of the funniest movies -- he's also an incredibly talented musician! He's bringing his band, Steve Martin and the Steep Canyon Rangers, to perform a song from their new album, but first he's sitting down to chat with Ellen. 

This season of "Celebrity Apprentice" has been one of the craziest yet -- and STAR JONES has been a very controversial contestant! NeNe Leakes and La Toya Jackson both made it clear what they think of Star... now Star will tell Ellen her side of the story!

videos.title: John Krasinski
videos.overview:
Last week on "The Office," JOHN KRASINSKI said goodbye to his friend and co-star, Steve Carell. Today John will tell Ellen all about life after Steve -- and Ellen will try to find out who the new boss will be! That's not all that's new with John... it's been less than a year since he married Emily Blunt, and Ellen will hear all about it from the newlywed.

A lot of audience members have braved Know or Go, but only a few have stayed long enough to make their mark! Today Ellen brings back three of the best for the ultimate Know or Go All-Stars Round! 

Last week, Ellen went to her home away from home -- Las Vegas! She brought along some cameras when she visited the luxurious Venetian and Palazzo Hotels, and will show you everything that happened when she decided to crash a bachelorette party!

videos.title: Kirstie Alley & Maksim Chmerkovskiy
videos.overview:
This season of "Dancing with the Stars" has been full of ups and down for KIRSTIE ALLEY! She's gone from impressing the judges with her outstanding moves, to literally falling down! Today she and her partner, MAKSIM CHMERKOVSKIY, are here to tell Ellen how they feel about the rest of the competition -- before they hit the dance floor! 

He's already a Grammy-winning rock star, and now he might be the newest Apprentice! MEAT LOAF is holding his own on "Celebrity Apprentice," and when he stops by today he'll tell Ellen about all of the drama -- including his recent fight with Gary Busey!

videos.title: Mother's Day Show
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's annual Mother's Day Show, and she once again invited soon-to-be mothers to fill the audience! Ellen has huge surprises in store for all of them, including some of the best gifts she could find -- and you can win them from home! 

It's not just the audience that's pregnant -- KATE HUDSON is expecting another child! The Academy Award-nominated actress is ready to focus on being a mother... right after telling Ellen about her new movie, "Something Borrowed." 

The competition is getting fierce on "Dancing with the Stars," but ROMEO & CHELSIE HIGHTOWER are ready to fight to the end! They're stopping by to treat everyone to a dance, but will first chat with Ellen!

videos.title: David Spade
videos.overview:
He's back, and he'll have everyone laughing! The hilarious DAVID SPADE is visiting Ellen -- and it's his 13th time here. He's anything but unlucky -- his show "Rules of Engagement" is doing better than ever! 

BETHENNY FRANKEL is never afraid to try something new or go for what she wants -- and she's learned a lot in the process! When Bethenny drops by today, she'll answer some audience questions, and you'll want to hear the answers! She'll also bring a tip or two on the best ways to enjoy the summer!

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez
videos.overview:
JENNIFER LOPEZ can do it all! Not only is she an amazing dancer, singer, and actor -- she's also a remarkable judge on "American Idol." If that's not enough, she just released a brand new album, "LOVE?" When she was here last year, there was the stair incident. Who knows what will happen this time?!

With over 120 million album sales, it's no surprise "Rolling Stone" declared STEVIE NICKS the reigning Queen of Rock and Roll! She's not stopping anytime soon -- Stevie just released a brand new album, "In Your Dreams," and she's stopping by to perform a new song for Ellen! 

You may not yet know ROSIE HUNTINGTON-WHITELEY's name, but you will! The Victoria's Secret model is heading to the big screen with none other than Shia LeBeouf, but not before making her talk show debut with Ellen!

videos.title: Taylor Swift
videos.overview:
TAYLOR SWIFT is back! The country music superstar is always so sweet and so much fun when she swings by to visit Ellen -- and today she'll give the world premiere performance of her song "The Story of Us." 

No one will be able to take their eyes off the screen when sexy JON HAMM stops by! He's not just good looking, he's got a great sense of humor, and he's putting it to use in the new comedy, "Bridesmaids."

The last time NENE LEAKES was here, she had a lot of strong words for her "Celebrity Apprentice" co-star, Star Jones, who was happy to return the favor last week! Now NeNe is back to update Ellen on everything that's happened since -- and what we can expect in the finale!

videos.title: Shania Twain
videos.overview:
SHANIA TWAIN is a giant force in country music, and the only female musician to have three different albums certified diamond! She's had some of the most incredible (and heartbreaking) experiences imaginable... and is sharing them all in her new autobiography. There's one thing she hasn't done -- visit Ellen! She'll finally do it today! 

Summer is almost here, and only one person has the best tips to stay beautiful -- KYM DOUGLAS! She's bringing more of her natural beauty tips, and she's sure to be as outrageous as usual!

videos.title: Colin Farrell
videos.overview:
Ellen has the breath mints ready -- COLIN FARRELL is coming back! The sexy guy never forgets to bring a kiss for Ellen. He's a good friend and even helped celebrate her birthday this year -- and the audience will celebrate when he steps on stage! 

Rapper LIL JON is one of the standout contestants on this season of "Celebrity Apprentice" -- and it's getting tougher than ever! He's stopping by to share what it's like dealing with all the huge personalities.

Last year, CHRISTINA PERRI became a sensation when she released her song, "Jar of Hearts" -- without a record label! Now she's becoming a big star and will make her debut performance to perform her new song, "Arms."

videos.title: Shia LeBeouf
videos.overview:
Throughout the years, Ellen has surprised many of her viewers with unbelievable gifts, but today she's got the biggest gift yet! One lucky family is getting a huge surprise that's unlike anything Ellen has ever done! 

He's the hottest young actor in Hollywood, and he's returning to Ellen! SHIA LABEOUF is in one of the biggest blockbusters of the summer, "Transformers: Dark of the Moon," and he'll have all the details on the trilogy that turned him into an action star! 

MARLEE MATLIN isn't letting the controversies of "Celebrity Apprentice" slow her down -- she's one of the strongest contestants yet! Ellen will get the latest on the competition and find out what Marlee really thinks of her co-stars!

videos.title: Bradley Cooper
videos.overview:
Everyone is talking about sexy BRADLEY COOPER! He's become one of the most popular movie stars -- and he's about to appear in the highly-anticipated "The Hangover, Part II." Last time here, he was afraid to challenge Ellen to a game of poker -- hopefully, he's brushed up on his skills! 

It's been 30 long years since DONNY & MARIE OSMOND released an album, but the wait is over! The brother and sister duo are performing together again and just released "Donny and Marie," and they're stopping by to perform one of their new songs!

videos.title: Patrick Dempsey
videos.overview:
Everyone fell in love with PATRICK DEMPSEY's sweet character on "Grey's Anatomy," but now we finally get to see the bad boy side of him in the upcoming "Transformers: Dark of the Moon." He's got all the details today!

A few months ago, Ellen was so impressed with the absolutely amazing TOM ANDREWS, she signed him to her eleveneleven record label, and he's been hard at work ever since. Today he's back from England with the premiere of his brand new single! You won't want to miss it!

videos.title: Josh Duhamel
videos.overview: It's always a fun time whenever JOSH DUHAMEL is here! Whether he's tearing off his clothes or being scared by a giant panda, he's always up for a good time. He's dropping by to tell Ellen about his upcoming movie, "Transformers: Dark of the Moon" -- and he's looking sexier than ever!

videos.title: Jessica Alba
videos.overview:
Two years ago, a pregnant JESSICA ALBA joined Ellen for the Mother's Day Show -- and Ellen correctly predicted a girl! Now Jessica is expecting her second child, so she's back to find out if it's a boy or girl! She'll also tell Ellen the latest about her adorable daughter, Honor.

 

Before the hysterical KEN JEONG's breakout role in "The Hangover," he was a dentist for 35 years! Now he's more popular than ever -- and starring in two of this summer's biggest movies! He'll be bringing his hilarious dance moves when he stops by today!

videos.title: Ed Helms
videos.overview:
Fresh from the opening of his much-anticipated sequel, ED HELMS will be here to tell Ellen all about his crazy adventure while filming "The Hangover 2."

 

Ellen found him on YouTube, and now singing sensation GREYSON CHANCE comes home to the show that made him a star -- to perform his brand new single.

 

And you've never seen her like this before! Ellen is off to Las Vegas to become a dealer at the Playboy Club at the Palms Casino. No matter what cards are dealt, this Monday everyone's winning big.

videos.title: Tom Hanks
videos.overview:
It's the Summer Preview Show! And Ellen is getting ready for summer with some amazing guests!

 

The fantastic TOM HANKS will be here to tell us about his big summer film, "Larry Crowne," which, aside from starring in, he also wrote and directed!

 

50 CENT will make his first "Ellen" appearance with NICOLE SHERZINGER to perform their new duet "Right There" -- from Nicole's upcoming solo album. 

Also, one lucky audience member will win the trip of a lifetime... to the premiere of one of the biggest movies of the summer, "Harry Potter and The Deathly Hallows: Part 2"!

videos.title: John Rich
videos.overview:
Ellen is looking back at the most hilarious and memorable moments of the season so far!

 

All this season, Ellen has been giving away Chevys, and today she's remembering all of the surprising and tearful moments along the way. Who knows -- there might be one more car left to give away!

 

JOHN RICH will be here to tell Ellen all about the incredible live "Celebrity Apprentice" finale!

videos.title: Dolly Parton
videos.overview:
The charming and vivacious DOLLY PARTON will be here to tell Ellen about her new album, "Better Day" and to perform the world premiere of the first single, "Together You and I."

 

After his huge success in "The Hangover," MIKE TYSON is returning in the soon to be summer blockbuster, "The Hangover 2," and he's swinging by to tell Ellen all about it.

 

An adorable couple, MATT STILL and his fiancée GINNY JOINER, will be here to tell Ellen about the incredible way he proposed, and the hilarious and moving video that made it all happen.

videos.title: Meredith Vieira
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's Memorial Day show! Ellen is pulling out all the stops with an incredible performance from "So You Think You Can Dance"!

MEREDITH VIEIRA is here in her final days as host of the "Today" show. She'll tell Ellen all about why she decided to make the career change.

And TAYLOR SWIFT gives an unforgettable performance of her hit song "Mean," from her new album, "Speak Now."

videos.title: Rob Lowe
videos.overview:
ROB LOWE, one of Ellen's favorite people, stopped by to tell Ellen about life on "Parks and Recreation," and about his new book, "Stories I Only Tell My Friends: An Autobiography."

British comedy phenomenon JACK WHITEHALL makes his hilarious US talk show debut and shows us what all the buzz is about!

Entertainment Weekly and People magazine are calling it one of the hottest breakout songs of the year -- ASHLYNE HUFF performs her single, "White Flag."

videos.title: Howie Mandel
videos.overview:
He's the new Judge on "America's Got Talent" -- the hilarious HOWIE MANDEL is here to tell Ellen about how the big auditions are going.

MELISSA McCARTHY is leaving them rolling in the aisles in her new film, "Bridesmaids," which is sweeping the country. Ellen might find out more about her role in the sequel.

For the first time ever, one of Ellen's favorite bands, THE STROKES, will be here to perform "Gratsifaction" from their latest album, "Angles."

And TERESA GIUDICE drops by to tell Ellen what's going down on her show, "The Real Housewives of New Jersey."

videos.title: Season 9 Premire - Ashton Kutcher
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's giant premiere show spectacular! To kick off Season 9, Ellen is giving away the surprise of a lifetime to an amazing woman who is dedicated to helping people in need. You won't believe what happens!

 

He's the new star of the hit show "Two and a Half Men." Ellen has the exclusive daytime interview with ASHTON KUTCHER! He'll be telling Ellen what it was like stepping into the show during such an electric time. He's also bringing the only sneak peek from "Two and a Half Men" that you'll see before the season premiere!

videos.title: David Arquette, Sidewinder, Taylor Swift
videos.overview:
After an emotional year, DAVID ARQUETTE will be here to tell Ellen about how his life has changed, his new role on "Dancing with the Stars," and how being on the show is helping him stay sober. 

They've risked their lives to perform for the troops in some of the most dangerous places on earth, and they're here today! One of the Air Force bands from the Missouri Air National Guard, SIDEWINDER, had a huge hit on YouTube this summer and now they're making their television debut on our show. The group, comprised of servicemen and women, will perform Adele's hit, "Rolling in the Deep."

 

Ellen surprised TAYLOR SWIFT at her concert in L.A. over the summer, and now Ellen is going to show an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at her Speak Now Tour. Taylor is here to discuss her steamy relationship rumors and to perform her and Ellen's song, "The Story of Us."

videos.title: Jon Cryer, Chaz Bono
videos.overview:
After a summer of controversy over the new season of "Two and a Half Men," JON CRYER is here to tell Ellen about the return of his hit show, and how he's been adjusting to his new castmate, Ashton Kutcher!

 

Also, the new lineup of "Dancing with the Stars" is making headlines, and CHAZ BONO is here to discuss the show's effect on his health, and what it's like to be the first transgender contestant.

videos.title: Eve Longoria, Greyson Chance
videos.overview:
It's the final season of "Desperate Housewives," and EVA LONGORIA is here to tell Ellen what we can expect from their final episodes. According to Eva's Twitter, it may have something to do with her pole dancing!

 

He was discovered right here on the show and inspired Ellen to create her own record label! Now GREYSON CHANCE's debut album, "Hold On 'Til the Night" has garnered amazing reviews and was in the top 15 digital albums, and he's only 14! He's here to perform exclusively on our show. This incredible young artist is sure to give a performance you won't want to miss!

videos.title: David Beckham, Lady Antebellum, Maya Rudolph
videos.overview:
International superstar DAVID BECKHAM returns to the show to make the audience melt and to tell Ellen about his new fragrance, DB Homme. Last time he was here, he wore an earpiece and played a hilarious hidden camera prank on a massage therapist. Who knows what kind of trouble he'll get into this time?!

 

LADY ANTEBELLUM is a longtime friend of Ellen's, so it's no surprise they're back to give an exclusive performance from their upcoming CD, "Own the Night."

 

Also, the hilarious MAYA RUDOLPH is here, and a special appearance by JANE LYNCH that you don't want to miss!

videos.title: Ellen's Live Emmy Show
videos.overview: It's the Emmys! It's one of Hollywood's most important nights, and Ellen is celebrating with a live show! Ellen will be getting the scoop on the biggest stars and greatest victories of the night -- and it's live, so anything can happen! This is the first time in six years the show has gone live, so tune in to see if you can spot any mistakes! She'll be joined by her dear friend and fellow New Orleanian, HARRY CONNICK, JR., who just won an Emmy last weekend! There's no better Emmy party on TV than Ellen's.

videos.title: Demi Lovato, Kathy Bates, Christina Applegate
videos.overview:
She's faced it all; bullies, rehab and public criticism about her weight. DEMI LOVATO is here to address her critics head-on. This candid and personal interview will reveal a side of her we've never seen before. You can't miss it.

 

Then, straight from her appearance at the Emmys, KATHY BATES will be sitting down with Ellen for the first time.

 

And, she's the star of NBC's exciting new comedy, "Up All Night," CHRISTINA APPLEGATE will be here to tell Ellen about the show, her fiancae, and her adorable 7-month-old daughter, Sadie Grace! It's all happening this Tuesday!

videos.title: Joseph Gordon-Levitt & Seth Rogen, Bryce Dallas Howard & Anna Kendrick, Maroon 5
videos.overview:
The entire cast of the film "50/50" is here for an exclusive interview! Ellen will be sitting down with the stars, JOSEPH GORDON-LEVITT and SETH ROGEN, to talk about this heartbreaking and hilarious film about a young person's struggle with cancer, based on the real-life story of Seth's close friend.

 

They'll be joined by the film's other stars, the incredible BRYCE DALLAS HOWARD and ANNA KENDRICK, who will talk about this amazing project and their personal projects... like the fact that Bryce is pregnant!

 

Then, MAROON 5 will perform their new hit, "Moves Like Jagger," which is tearing up the charts. You can't miss Wednesday!

videos.title: Brad Pitt, Chris Pratt, Kelly Clarkson
videos.overview:
For the first time ever, the unbearably handsome BRAD PITT is in our studio! And you won't see him anywhere else. The megastar is sitting down exclusively with Ellen to talk about his life with Angelina, their children, and the Oscar Buzz around his new film, "Moneyball." He'll be joined by his "Moneyball" Costar, CHRIS PRATT.

 

Then, we've been waiting for two long years, and the moment is finally here! KELLY CLARKSON is about to release her highly anticipated new album, "Stronger," and she'll be here to chat with Ellen and perform her new single, "Mr. Know It All"!

 

This Thursday, Ellen is changing the game.

videos.title: Jamie Foxx, Elisabetta Canalis & Val Chmerkovsky, Dr. Drew
videos.overview:
He's a movie star, a talented musician, and now he's a producer! Mr. Charisma himself, JAMIE FOXX will be here wooing Ellen and telling her about his new documentary, "Thunder Soul." 

ELISABETTA CANALIS and VAL CHMERKOVSKIY from the new season of "Dancing with the Stars" will show off their dance moves and fill Ellen in on this headline-stealing new season. 

Then, he deals with our brightest stars in their darkest hours, DR. DREW is bringing his addiction and rehabilitation expertise to the mainstream in a new show called "Lifechangers," and he's here to tell us all about it. This Friday, Ellen is the place to be.

videos.title: Wanda Sykes, Joe Jonas, Julianne Hough & Kenny Wormald
videos.overview:
One of Ellen's friends -- and one of funniest people around, WANDA SYKES, is revealing a personal health battle with Ellen for the very first time. 

Plus, as one of the Jonas Brothers, he's sold over 8 million albums worldwide. Now JOE JONAS is striking out on his own with an upcoming solo debut CD, and he's here to perform his new single, "Just in Time." 

JULIANNE HOUGH and KENNY WORMALD are steaming up the screen in the remake of the classic movie "Footloose," and today they're taking a break from tearing up the dance floor to chat with Ellen. This will be Kenny's first appearance on a talk show!

videos.title: Jennifer Garner, Cody Simpson, Kevin Dillon
videos.overview: JENNIFER GARNER can do it all! She's a movie star, a humanitarian, and now she's expecting her third baby with her husband, Ben Affleck! This wonder mom will be sitting down with Ellen to explain exactly how she does it all.  You wanted him, and now he's here! The buzz around CODY SIMPSON is getting louder by the minute. He's signed with Justin Bieber's manager and was on tour with Greyson Chance. This amazing Australian 14-year-old will tell Ellen about the whirlwind adventure he's been on, and perform his new song, "On My Mind."  After 8 amazing seasons, HBO's "Entourage" has come to an end. KEVIN DILLON will be here to tell Ellen how it felt walking away from the show for the last time and how he's making the transition to his new show, "How to Be a Gentleman." It's all happening this Tuesday on Ellen!

videos.title: Simon Cowell, Paula Abdul, Nicole Scherzinger, L.A. Reid, Steve Jones, Luke Bryan
videos.overview:
In a TV exclusive, the entire cast of the giant new show "X Factor" is here! SIMON COWELL is reuniting with the woman who loves to hate him, PAULA ABDUL, for the American version of his mega hit show! They'll be joined by Pussycat Dolls superstar NICOLE SCHERZINGER and music mogul L.A. REID, who complete the panel of all-star judges. We'll also meet the cute new host, STEVE JONES... and the only place you'll see them all together is right here with Ellen!

Then, country music star LUKE BRYAN is here to perform his huge hit, "Country Girl," from his #1 album, "Tailgates & Tanlines." Ellen's X factor is off the charts this Wednesday!

videos.title: Heidi Klum, Nancy Pelosi, LeAnn Rimes
videos.overview:
When it comes to HEIDI KLUM, you're either in or you're out, and this Thursday, she's in! One of the world's most recognizable supermodels is sitting down with Ellen to talk about her life, her children, and her super-talented husband, Seal!

 

After 18 years and 14,000 service members discharged, the military's "Don't Ask, Don't Tell" policy has finally ended. Democratic leader, Congresswoman, and the first female Speaker of the House, NANCY PELOSI, is here to talk about this historic moment and the integral role she played in striking it down.

 

LEANN RIMES has had her share of controversy this year. Today she's sitting down with Ellen to clear the air once and for all. And with her new CD, "Lady and Gentlemen" about to hit stores, she'll be performing her big hit, "Give."

videos.title: David Spade, Bethenny Frankel
videos.overview:
The adorably sarcastic DAVID SPADE is also swinging by to catch up with Ellen. He's always one of Ellen's most memorable guests, especially when she scares the socks off of him!

 

She's a housewife, a mogul, a fashionista and one of Ellen's favorite people, BETHENNY FRANKEL returns to "Ellen" with the big news from her life. This straight-talking skinny girl always has something to say that's both brilliant and hilarious!

 

Then, a giant surprise for a lucky viewer from GROUPON makes this a Friday on "Ellen" that you'll be talking about all weekend long!

videos.title: Breast Cancer Awareness Month
videos.overview:
Monday marks the start of Breast Cancer Awareness month, and no show is more committed to the cause than "Ellen." We'll get a sneak peek at all of the surprises we can expect to see all month long, and ways that we can all get involved to help find a cure.

 

Soccer superstar HOPE SOLO and her "Dancing with the Stars" partner, MAKSIM CHMERKOVSKIY, will be here to show off their dance moves, and tell Ellen about everything that's going on behind the scenes!

 

Then, the doctor is in! HUGH LAURIE is the star of the hit series, "House," and he's here to give Ellen the inside scoop about the highly anticipated new season. This talented thespian is also ready to reveal his hidden talent as a musician.

 

Add CHERYL HINES from the new ABC comedy, "Suburgatory," and this is one Monday on Ellen you'll have to see to believe.

videos.title: Kellie Pickler, Joel McHale
videos.overview:
It's a very exciting day! Today Ellen's third book, "Seriously... I'm Kidding," hits bookshelves -- and she's celebrating all day long with some of her favorite people!

 

The bubbly and hilarious KELLIE PICKLER will be here! You never know what will happen when Kellie's here. She's interviewed people on the red carpet and sat on Clint Eastwood's lap. Whatever she's doing, it's always must-see TV. She'll also be performing her hit new song, "Tough."

 

Then, the star of the hit show "Community," JOEL McHALE will be here to make Ellen laugh and tell us about the exciting new season of his hysterical show. Ellen's having a party this Tuesday, and you're invited!

videos.title: Kim Kardashian & Kris Humphries, Angus T. Jones
videos.overview:
This Wednesday, Ellen is keeping up with the Kardashians! Newlyweds KIM KARDASHIAN and KRIS HUMPHRIES are here to tell Ellen all about their headline-making nuptials that took place over the summer. This is the first time the two are sitting down together on daytime television, so Ellen will be sure to get the scoop on how married life is going, and when the two will be adding a little Kardashian to keep up with!

 

Then, an amazing singing duo that Ellen found on YouTube, Emily Luther & Charlie Puth, will perform Adele's mega hit, "Someone Like You," and it's going to blow you away!

videos.title: Zooey Deschanel, Ricki Lake & Derek Hough
videos.overview:
She's one of the hottest stars of the fall season, ZOOEY DESCHANEL is here! Her new show, "The New Girl," is the most talked about new show this season, and the disarmingly adorable Zooey is here to show Ellen exactly why people are talking!

 

Then, "Dancing with the Stars" duo, RICKI LAKE and DEREK HOUGH give Ellen the scoop about what's happening on the show. And of course, they're going to tear up the dance floor! It's all happening this Thursday.

videos.title: Alyson Hannigan, Scotty McCreery, Blake Mycoskie
videos.overview:
The always charming ALYSON HANNIGAN is in the studio! Alyson just started the seventh season of her hilarious hit show, "How I Met Your Mother." She's sure to have the scoop on what we can expect from her character, Lily, and her friends this year!

Then, he was discovered less than a year ago, and now he's rocketed to the height of stardom. The reigning champion of "American Idol," SCOTTY McCREERY is here! He's performing his song, "The Trouble with Girls," from his upcoming debut CD, "Clear As Day."

And, BLAKE MYCOSKIE, Founder of TOMS Shoes, is here to talk about the amazing work his company does, and his inspiring new book, "Start Something That Matters."

videos.title: Steve Martin, Jack Black & Owen Wilson, Christina Grimmie
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's Columbus Day Show! She's celebrating with three of the biggest comedy stars in the world! STEVE MARTIN, JACK BLACK and OWEN WILSON are all sitting down with Ellen to talk about their hilarious new movie, "The Big Year."

 

Plus, she's the YouTube sensation with over 200 Million views, CHRISTINA GRIMMIE is here to perform her version of the hit song by Lil Wayne, "How to Love."

 

It's shows like this that make Columbus proud he found America. Don't miss Monday!

videos.title: Liza Minnelli, Keith Urban
videos.overview:
She's a living legend, and she's here for the first time in eight years! The incomparable LIZA MINNELLI graces the Ellen stage to talk about her illustrious life in the spotlight, and her incredible new CD, "Confessions."

 

Then, KEITH URBAN, one of the biggest names in music, is here to perform his song "You Gonna Fly," from his certified gold CD, "Get Closer."

 

And LESTER SMITH is one of the most respected philanthropists in the country. He's here to talk about his multi-million-dollar donations, his new program called "The Pink Well Challenge," and he has a big surprise for Ellen! Tuesday is a day on Ellen you won't soon forget.

videos.title: Glen Campbell, Ellen Pompeo
videos.overview:
Ellen is sitting down for a heartfelt conversation with iconic country music star GLEN CAMPBELL. In this exclusive daytime interview, they'll discuss his recent battle with Alzheimer's, and his Goodbye Tour. Also, as a special gift to Ellen, Glen will perform one of her favorite, classic Glen Campbell songs, "Wichita Lineman."

 

And, she's the Grey in "Grey's Anatomy," ELLEN POMPEO is stopping by to catch Ellen up on her epic TV show, and her adorable daughter, Stella! This is a Wednesday on Ellen you don't want to miss.

 

Plus, their YouTube video has over 2 million views and they're here live! All the way from Essex, England, the unbelievable 8-year-old SOPHIA GRACE BROWNLEE and her 5-year-old cousin ROSIE are performing Nicki Minaj's "Super Bass."

videos.title: Kaley Cuoco, Adam Scott, Lupe Fiasco
videos.overview:
It's a comedy extravaganza on Ellen! Stars from two of the biggest comedy shows on TV are here! First, KALEY CUOCO is the charming and hilarious star of the hit CBS show, "The Big Bang Theory." When Kaley and Ellen get together, they always leave 'em laughing!

 

Then, one of the stars of "Parks and Recreation," ADAM SCOTT is here for the first time! He was just named one of Entertainment Weekly's "Artists to Watch," and you can watch him right here! It's going to be one hilarious Thursday on Ellen!

 

Also, LUPE FIASCO is here to perform one of the hottest songs of the year, "The Show Goes On" from his CD, "Lasers."

videos.title: Jesse Tyler Ferguson, Michael Strahan
videos.overview:
Star of the runaway hit "Modern Family," JESSE TYLER FERGUSON is here! Whether he's bringing outtakes from his show or wowing Ellen with his talent for mime, this Ellen Show favorite never fails to impress! His show swept the Emmys this year with wins in 5 of the biggest awards of the night, and he's bringing his Emmy magic to our stage!

 

Plus, two sisters from Atlanta, ages 14 and 11, who are great singers and so adorable you have to see them to believe it. And, another outrageous hidden camera prank! This Friday, Ellen is going to have you rolling on the floor!

 

He's a powerhouse on and off the field, MICHAEL STRAHAN retired from the NFL and now he's an analyst on FOX's "NFL Sunday," and he's here to talk about it!

videos.title: Hilary Duff, J,R, Martinez & Karina Smirnoff, Logan Lerman
videos.overview:
HILARY DUFF has some big news that she's sharing exclusively with Ellen. This actress, singer and novelist recently announced she's pregnant! Today she's dropping some huge news -- she's announcing if it's a boy or a girl! If she plays her cards right, Ellen might even get her to tell us the name.

 

Then, he and his partner just performed one of the most emotional dances in the history of "Dancing with the Stars," J.R. MARTINEZ is here with dance partner KARINA SMIRNOFF to discuss their incredible journey on the show so far. This is one Ellen Show they're definitely going to be talking about tomorrow!

 

He's starred with some of the biggest names in Hollywood and he's taking the lead in a big new film! LOGAN LERMAN is starring in the highly anticipated remake of the classic "The Three Musketeers," and he's here to meet Ellen for the first time!

videos.title: Martin Sheen & Emilio Estevez, Connie Britton, Philip Galanes
videos.overview:
There is no more iconic father and son in Hollywood than MARTIN SHEEN and EMILIO ESTEVEZ. Their collective impact on film and television is immeasurable. They're here to discuss a new film they've collaborated on called, "The Way," which was directed by Estevez and stars his father. Ellen will also get an update on their son and brother, Charlie Sheen.

 

Then, an amazing 12-year-old singer named COLE ARMOUR is here to make his first television appearance, and it definitely won't be his last. This is one talent you'll have to see to believe! Don't miss Tuesday!

 

Every Thursday, Ellen comes to work raving about "American Horror Story!" It's one of her favorite shows of the season, and today, she'll get to interview one of its stars, CONNIE BRITTON. Ellen will be sure to get exclusive details on the terrifying new show that will have you watching from under the covers!

 

Then, a special appearance by New York Times writer PHILIP GALANES, to clear the air! He mentioned Ellen in a recent column about standing ovations, and Ellen gave him a standing "Oh no you didn't!"

videos.title: Taylor Swift, Abigail Breslin, Foster The People
videos.overview:
There are few people who are as captivating as TAYLOR SWIFT, and she's here today for the first time in season 9! Music sensation, fellow CoverGirl and one of Ellen's good friends, the starlet is here to catch Ellen up on her life, and of course, who she's been dating! 

Then, she stole our hearts in "Little Miss Sunshine," now ABIGAIL BRESLIN is almost all grown up! The adorable star is lending her epic talent to the new film, "Janie Jones" and she's here for a visit with Ellen!

Plus, they're the band that's taking the music scene by storm! FOSTER THE PEOPLE is here to perform their unstoppable hit, "Pumped Up Kicks" from their album, "Torches." This Wednesday, Ellen is the only place to be.

videos.title: Steve Harvey, Rachel Maddow, Robyn
videos.overview:
When STEVE HARVEY is here, there's no telling what can happen! This funny man tells it like it is, whether it's in his hilarious books or on his game show, "Family Feud." The survey says this show will definitely make you LOL.

 

Then, she's the hard-hitting and hilarious host of "The Rachel Maddow Show," RACHEL MADDOW is here! She's going to catch Ellen up on everything that's going on -- both in her life and around the world!

 

And it wouldn't be Halloween month without sending Ellen's writer, Amy, to a Haunted House. Her adventure last year is one of the most popular videos in Ellen Show history. You can't miss what happens this time!

 

Add a performance from ROBYN of her hit song "Call Your Girlfriend" from her Grammy-winning CD, "Body Talk" -- and this is one Ellen Show you'd be crazy to miss!

videos.title: Marcia Cross, Lauren Alaina
videos.overview:
For 8 years, we've watched her light up the screen on "Desperate Housewives," and now MARCIA CROSS is at the start of the epic final season of this groundbreaking show. She's seen it all; the good, the bad and the incredibly good-looking, and she's here to tell Ellen what we can expect from the show that's kept everyone guessing. 

LAUREN ALAINA had America on the edge of their seats from the first auditions of last season's "American Idol," all the way through to the big finale. This outrageously talented 16-year-old singer will tell Ellen about her incredible adventure on the show that made her a star, and of course, will perform her song "Georgia Peaches" from her upcoming debut CD, "Wildflower."

 Plus, Ellen's Swaggin' Wagon is surprising another deserving family right in their driveway. It could be yours!

videos.title: Harry Connick Jr & Kate Connick, Sean Hayes, Rob Kardashian & Cheryl Burke
videos.overview:
If you thought HARRY CONNICK JR. was charming and hilarious, wait 'til you meet his 13-year-old daughter! The adorable KATE CONNICK makes her Ellen Show debut with dear old dad. The two will chat with Ellen, and Kate will sing their new song, "A Lot Like Me." It's clear the apple didn't fall very far from the tree. 

We loved him for 8 amazing seasons on the groundbreaking sitcom, "Will and Grace," and today, SEAN HAYES returns to the Ellen Show! The brilliant funnyman is here with a brand new show he's executive producing for NBC called "Grimm." He'll give Ellen the scoop on his jump from comedy to drama. 

Then, ROB KARDASHIAN is here with his dance partner, CHERYL BURKE, to tear up the dance floor and to catch Ellen up on all of the excitement on their mega-hit show, "Dancing with the Stars!" It's a giant Monday on Ellen! 

Plus, the incredible story of XAVIER LAMB, who survived a 3-story drop from a window during an apartment fire, thanks to firefighter Lieutenant Glenn McGillivray. Xavier, his family and the Lieutenant who saved him are all here to tell us about their amazing ordeal.

videos.title: LL Cool J, Jonah Hill, Jason Derulo
videos.overview:
LL is in the house! The last time we saw LL COOL J, the smoldering star of "NCIS: Los Angeles," Ellen dropped him into the lagoon at Universal Studios Orlando! He's all dried off and ready for more. Who knows what will happen in our Breast Cancer Awareness Month dunk tank?! 

Then, funnyman JONAH HILL is here to tell Ellen the story behind his recent and dramatic weight loss. The "Superbad" star is also behind the brand new animated series, "Allen Gregory," which he both created and stars in, and is sure to be a laugh riot. 

JASON DERULO is one of the hottest stars on the music scene, and he's here to perform not one, but two of his hits, "Don't Wanna Go Home" and "It Girl" from his CD, "Future History." It's a show the ladies will love this Tuesday!

videos.title: Will Arnett, Anton Yelchin & Felicity Jones, Lady Antebellum
videos.overview:
He's the hilarious dad in the new hit comedy, "Up All Night," WILL ARNETT is here! Ellen is going to find out exactly how much of his sitcom life is like his real-life role as dad to two precious boys, and husband to funnylady, Amy Poehler! 

Then, the adorable and heartbreaking new film, "Like Crazy" is about to make stars out of the two lead actors, and they're both here! ANTON YELCHIN and FELICITY JONES sit down with Ellen to talk about this touching film and what it's like to be a star on the rise. 

Plus, they're the band that got their big break right here on Ellen, LADY ANTEBELLUM performs! This Wednesday is for lovers, on Ellen!

videos.title: Justin Timberlake, Coldplay
videos.overview:
It's an Ellen Show for the history books. One of the greatest entertainers of all time, JUSTIN TIMBERLAKE returns to our stage to catch up with his good friend, Ellen, and to show off a talent of his you've never seen before! 

Then, one of the most celebrated rock bands on the planet, COLDPLAY is performing on our stage for the very first time! The camera-shy band is opening up to Ellen in a way you've never heard before, and giving a mind-blowing concert extravaganza on an illuminated stage you'll have to see to believe. This is one day on Ellen you simply can't afford to miss.

videos.title: Michele Williams, Ariel Winter, Kevin Nealon
videos.overview:
One of the biggest stars in Hollywood, and one of the most talked about roles of her career, MICHELLE WILLIAMS is here to tell Ellen about her already critically acclaimed portrayal of the iconic Hollywood legend, Marilyn Monroe, in the new film, "My Week with Marilyn."

 

Then, an unprecedented Ellen Show event. Ellen is surprising one of her biggest fans with an experience that will literally change her life forever.

 

Plus, she plays the middle sister on the show everybody is talking about, "Modern Family," ARIEL WINTER is here! Her character, Alex is the smart and smart-alecy sister to Haley and Luke Dunphy who doesn't take any bossing around! She's here to tell Ellen about her life-changing role on the smash hit comedy.

 

And, one of the funniest people on the planet, KEVIN NEALON is here! He's going door to door trick-or-treating in one of the funniest adventures you'll see this Halloween season! This Friday, Ellen is the only place to be.

videos.title: The Halloween Show!
videos.overview:
Happy Halloween! It's no secret that Halloween is Ellen's favorite holiday, and this year her celebration's bigger than ever! Tune in to see the costume that everyone's going to be talking about tomorrow! 

She'll be joined by two of her favorite people on the planet! First, it's NEIL PATRICK HARRIS, star of "How I Met Your Mother" and the new special, "A Very Harold and Kumar 3D Christmas." He always knows just how to crack Ellen up. He's so charming and clever, it's spooky!

Ellen will also welcome one of her good friends, BETHENNY FRANKEL. This housewife mogul fashionista is guaranteed to have a ghoulishly fun time with our host -- and bring some Halloween magic! For this Halloween spectacular, Ellen has a more than few tricks that are sure to be a real treat! Don't miss it!

videos.title: Justin Bieber, Principal Sherrie Gahn
videos.overview:
He's the biggest teen heartthrob on the face of the planet -- JUSTIN BIEBER is here! On the day his brand new album "Under the Mistletoe" is released, the pop phenomenon is under our studio lights for an incredibly special appearance. He'll tell all about his life, his career, and his girlfriend, Selena Gomez -- one of the most talked about relationships in Hollywood!

 

Then, the follow-up to the most touching surprise in Ellen Show history. SHERRIE GAHN, the principal with a heart of gold, is telling Ellen about how the show has changed her life. It's all happening this Tuesday!

videos.title: Eddie Murphy, Coldplay
videos.overview:
It's Ellen's 1,400th show! And she's celebrating with one of the funniest men in history, EDDIE MURPHY! He's starring in the new film, "Tower Heist," and he's also getting ready for one of the most exciting challenges a comedian can face: hosting the Oscars! There's no doubt Ellen will have some great tips for his first time out!

 

Plus, an incredible performance by COLDPLAY of their beautiful song, "Fix You" -- on a very special Ellen stage!

videos.title: Antonio Banderas, Johnny Galecki
videos.overview:
ANTONIO BANDERAS is one of the biggest movie stars in the world. He's bringing every ounce of his machismo, style and charm to his new film, "Puss in Boots," and today, he's bringing it to Ellen! The ladies will be swooning before he takes a seat! 

Then, he's the star of the hit comedy "The Big Bang Theory," and now he's starring in the blockbuster thriller, "In Time." It's hard to imagine how JOHNNY GALECKI has time for it all. The hilarious and captivating actor is here to shed light on his incredible career that has already spanned over 20 years!

videos.title: Kate Walsh, Freida Pinto
videos.overview:
She's the star of the hit show, "Private Practice," KATE WALSH is here to give the scoop on her sexy new co-star, Benjamin Bratt! Kate and Ellen always have a ton of fun whenever she's here, and today is sure to live up to the expectation! 

Then, she's the Hollywood beauty the world fell in love with in "Slumdog Millionaire," the heart-stoppingly beautiful FREIDA PINTO is here to talk about her new film, "Immortals." 

Plus, an amazing YouTube dancing duo that you'll see only on Ellen! Don't miss Monday!

videos.title: Sophia Grace Brownlee & Rosie McClelland, Kristen Dunst
videos.overview:
The girls from Essex, England, who took the internet by storm, are back! SOPHIA GRACE BROWNLEE and her cousin ROSIE McCLELLAND made such a splash with their video performing Nicki Minaj's, "Super Bass," they caught the attention of the whole planet. They even inspired Ellen to dress as them for Halloween! Who knows what will happen when these two adorably talented viral video juggernauts return to our stage?! 

KIRSTEN DUNST has been wowing audiences since her breakout performance in "Interview with The Vampire." Now she's the star of the haunting and visually striking new film "Melancholia," and her incredible performance is already receiving critical acclaim! She's here today to tell Ellen all about it!

videos.title: Kermit the Frog, Taye Diggs, Jermaine Jackson
videos.overview:
It's time to play the music! It's time to light the lights! KERMIT THE FROG is here! For the first time in history, one of the world's most lovable characters will be on our stage.
