Brown, as well as show off her dance background in a fun game with tWitch!

videos.title: Mark Wahlberg, Brandi Carlile, Nessa Barrett, jxdn featuring Travis Barker
videos.overview: It’s getting hot in here – MARK WAHLBERG returns! He's the star of “Boogie Nights,” “The Departed,” “Ted,” and the family reality show “Wahlburgers,” and more! Now he’s returning to the small screen with “Wahl Street,” an HBO Max docuseries that takes an inside look at how he balances a rigorous film schedule with his growing network of businesses. Don’t miss his chat with Ellen!

videos.title: Melissa Villaseñor, Tones and I
videos.overview: Live from New York, it’s MELISSA VILLASEÑOR! The comedian has been on “Saturday Night Live” for five seasons, and now she’s set to host the upcoming Independent Spirit Awards. Be sure to watch Melissa’s hilarious visit!

videos.title: Savannah Guthrie, Brett Eldredge, Tamara Levitt
videos.overview:
This just in – SAVANNAH GUTHRIE is here! The accomplished journalist will chat all about what’s going on at “Today,” and so much more. Don't miss her visit with Ellen... today!

Country music star BRETT ELDREDGE takes the stage to perform his new hit song, “Good Day”!  Ellen chats with TAMARA LEVITT, Head of Mindfulness at the Calm app. She’ll talk about her experience and her daily meditation offering, “The Daily Calm.”

videos.title: Keith Urban, Dean Lewis, ‘Big Trick Energy’ Magicians
videos.overview: The amazing KEITH URBAN is back! He’s one of the biggest stars in country music, and now he’s co-hosting one of the genre’s biggest award shows – the upcoming 56th ACM Awards! He’ll talk with Ellen about emceeing the event with Mickey Guyton, and what to expect as it takes place during the pandemic.

videos.title: Guest Host Tiffany Haddish, Andra Day, Lil Rel Howery, TOMORROW X TOGETHER
videos.overview:
Guest host TIFFANY HADDISH is back, and she'll have a chat with actress/singer ANDRA DAY! The talented star is a Grammy-nominated artist, and recently made her mark on the big screen in the Hulu film, “The United States vs. Billie Holiday.” Her performance as the iconic singer has already won her a Golden Globe, and she’s up for Best Actress at the upcoming Oscars! She’ll tell Tiffany all about that and more!

Then, Tiffany talks with LIL REL HOWERY! The comedian has been in hits like “Get Out,” “Bird Box,” and “Judas and the Black Messiah.” Now he’s here to chat about “Bad Trip,” his Netflix movie with Tiffany!  Get ready to dance with K-pop group TOMORROW X TOGETHER as they perform their hit song, “We Lost the Summer”!

videos.title: Jessica Biel, Olivia Holt, Michelle Buteau, Glass Animals
Scott Foley, Jane Levy, Hunter Hayes, Dr. Andrew Weil
videos.overview: The charming and talented SCOTT FOLEY is here! He’s the star of shows including “Scandal,” “Felicity,” and “The Unit.” In his spare time, he’s an amateur furniture maker and now serves as a judge on Ellen’s new furniture design competition series on HBO Max, “Ellen’s Next Great Designer”! He’ll talk all about the exciting new project they’re working on!  The delightful JANE LEVY joins Ellen! The Golden Globe nominee has appeared in the hit shows “Shameless” and “Suburgatory,” and for the past two seasons she’s starred in the NBC musical dramedy, “Zoey’s Extraordinary Playlist” – and she’ll tell Ellen all about it!  Then, singer HUNTER HAYES will perform his new song, “If You Change Your Mind”

videos.title: Earth Day with Mickey Guyton, Dr. Julian Fennessy
videos.overview:
It’s Ellen’s big Earth Day show!

Country music star MICKEY GUYTON chats with Ellen! The trailblazing singer will talk about her latest single, “Black Like Me,” and her experience co-hosting the ACM Awards with Keith Urban!  Then, Ellen welcomes conservation scientist Dr. Julian Fennessy, Co-Founder and Executive Director of the Giraffe Conservation Foundation. He's featured in the new Discovery+ documentary “Endangered,” which Ellen narrated and executive produced! He’ll talk all about the movie and his work protecting endangered species!

videos.title: Guest Host Ashley Graham, Amy Schumer
videos.overview:
The fun and fearless ASHLEY GRAHAM guest hosts and welcomes AMY SCHUMER! With hits like “Trainwreck” and her Emmy-winning series “Inside Amy Schumer,” the comedian has entertained us for years! Today, she’ll talk about what mom life has been like, and she’ll be joined by her artist friend Tyler Hays to talk about their exciting project!

Then, Ashley interviews the inspiring nurse DaKoyoia Billie. She’ll talk about how at the beginning of the pandemic, she made the difficult decision to leave her family in Atlanta to work on the frontlines in New York City. You won’t want to miss DaKoyoia's incredible story, and Ashley’s huge surprise for her!

videos.title: Michael Strahan, Daniel Dae Kim, Kym Douglas
videos.overview: Ellen welcomes MICHAEL STRAHAN to the show! The Super Bowl champion keeps busy as a football analyst on "FOX NFL Sunday" and as co-host of “Good Morning America.” He’s here to talk about another one of his ventures – his clothing line MSX by Michael Strahan!  Then, a chat with DANIEL DAE KIM! The accomplished actor is known for his roles in “Lost,” “Hawaii Five-O,” and most recently, the groundbreaking Disney movie, “Raya and the Last Dragon.” Today, he’ll talk with Ellen about his new movie, “Stowaway” – a sci-fiction thriller about the crew of a spaceship headed to Mars that discovers an accidental stowaway shortly after takeoff.  It’s a cooking showdown with KYM DOUGLAS and Executive Producer Andy! You won’t want to miss it when the two compete to make a home-cooked dish!

videos.title: Mark Cuban, Jay Shetty, Ingrid Michaelson
videos.overview: Here’s something to invest in – MARK CUBAN is on the show! The billionaire entrepreneur, TV personality, and Dallas Mavericks owner is one of the most successful people in the world, and today he’ll talk with Ellen about the current 12th season of “Shark Tank”!  Ellen then welcomes the incredible JAY SHETTY! The award-winning storyteller is a monk-turned-purpose coach, whose wise words have inspired people all over the world. Don’t miss his visit with Ellen!  Singer/songwriter INGRID MICHAELSON will take the stage with a performance of her latest song, “To Begin Again.”

videos.title: Gayle King, Author Ellen Bennett, Miranda Lambert, Jack Ingram & Jon Randal
videos.overview: It’s sure to be a good day when GAYLE KING visits! The “CBS This Morning” co-anchor and accomplished journalist always has plenty to say, and we can’t wait to hear what’s new!

videos.title: Ellen’s 3,000th Show with Adam Levine, Maroon 5
videos.overview: Celebrate Ellen’s milestone 3,000th show! To join in on the fun, Ellen welcomes one of the most popular stars in all of music, her good friend ADAM LEVINE! He’ll chat about MAROON 5’s upcoming seventh studio album, and he’ll later be joined by the rest of Maroon 5 to perform their latest song, “Beautiful Mistakes”!  Ellen welcomes incredible 2nd grade teacher Pascual Cubero Soto. Ellen recently surprised him via Zoom after learning about his dedication to his students and how they’re raising money for The Ellen Fund in his classroom. He’ll join in-person for a visit he won’t forget!

videos.title: Guest Host Anthony Anderson, Topher Grace, Caleb McLaughlin
videos.overview:
The always entertaining ANTHONY ANDERSON is here to guest host the show for the first time! He’ll welcome accomplished actor TOPHER GRACE, who has been in memorable projects such as “That ‘70s Show,” “BlacKkKlansman” and “Valentine’s Day.” Now he’s back on the small screen in the new ABC series “Home Economics,”. and he’ll tell Anthony all about it!  The talented CALEB McLAUGHLIN is here! He’s best known for playing Lucas in the fan-favorite “Stranger Things,” and now he’s making his feature film debut alongside Idris Elba in the Netflix film “Concrete Cowboy”!

Then, Anthony has an incredible surprise for Principal Abeni Carr from the College Bridge Academy in Compton, California. She’ll tell Anthony about how she provides for her students both in and out of the school, and about Havens House Youth, the non-profit organization she runs for homeless youth.

videos.title: Justin Theroux, Bethenny Frankel, Cameron Jay
Luke Bryan, Emmanuel Acho
videos.overview: He’s crashing the party – LUKE BRYAN returns! The country music superstar has kept busy with the new season of “American Idol” and gearing up for the deluxe album release of his “Born Here Live Here Die Here,” and he’s here to tell Ellen all about it! He’ll also take the stage to perform!  Ellen will then chat with EMMANUEL ACHO, a former NFL player-turned-sports analyst. In addition to his sports career, he hosts a YouTube series called “Uncomfortable Conversations with a Black Man,” which addresses issues about race in America. He’ll talk with Ellen about his projects, including his children’s book, “Uncomfortable Conversations with a Black Boy.”

videos.title: Michael Che, Thomas Rhett
videos.overview: The always entertaining MICHAEL CHE is here! The “Saturday Night Live” star will chat with Ellen about his new HBO Max series – a sketch comedy show which he stars in and executive produces!  Country star THOMAS RHETT is here! He’ll tell Ellen about his new album, “Country Again (Side A),” and his new tequila brand, Dos Primos! There’s more – he’ll perform his hit single, “What’s Your Country Song”!

videos.title: Courteney Cox, Julia Michaels
videos.overview: She’s everyone’s friend – COURTENEY COX is here! The actress will chat with Ellen about the return of her Facebook Watch docuseries, “9 Months with Courteney Cox,” and more!  Singer/songwriter JULIA MICHAELS will perform a new song, “Little Did I Know,” from her upcoming album!  Ellen welcomes beekeeper Erika Thompson, who’s been posting TikToks of her removing bees with her bare hands. Her videos went viral with over 330 million views. She’ll talk with Ellen about the fascinating process of beehive removal, and explain why it’s her mission to educate people about saving the bees.

videos.title: Mother’s Day Show with Ayesha Curry
videos.overview:
Start Mother’s Day weekend with one of the biggest and best shows of the year!  There's no better way to celebrate than with the mom boss of three young kids, AYESHA CURRY! She’s a cookbook author, TV personality, and host of Ellen’s original series, “Fempire”! Today’s she's here to help celebrate all of the incredible parents-to-be in the audience, and to talk about her lifestyle magazine and store called “Sweet July.”

Then, the first-time parents in the virtual audience will be showered with amazing presents to help them welcome their babies!

Pink, Imagine Dragons
videos.overview: International pop star P!NK is back is here to talk with Ellen about her new Amazon documentary, “P!nk: All I Know So Far.” Rock out with the IMAGINE DRAGONS as they perform their latest single, “Follow You”!  Plus, a surprise visit from a beloved superstar!

Conversations on Trauma, Resilience, and Healing.”  P!NK returns, and this time she’s taking the stage for a special performance of her single, “All I Know So Far”! She’ll also chat about receiving the Icon Award at the upcoming Billboard Music Awards!

videos.title: Ellie Kemper
videos.overview: She’s sure to bring a smile to your face – ELLIE KEMPER is here! The star of “Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt,” “The Office,” and “Bridesmaids” will chat with Ellen direct from her home closet!  Plus, Ellen takes a look back at her chats with Mila Kunis, country music star T.J. Osborne, and a performance by Lake Street Dive!

Stacey Abrams, Dave Bautista, Lady A
videos.overview:
We’re all in as STACEY ABRAMS returns to chat with Ellen! The voting rights activist and former Georgia gubernatorial candidate will discuss her hard work in the 2020 election, her mission as an advocate for free and fair elections, and her upcoming novel, “While Justice Sleeps” – a suspense thriller set within the halls of the U.S. Supreme Court.

The multi-talented DAVE BAUTISTA is here! The WWE champion-turned-actor has been in many hit action movies, including “Spectre,” “Riddick,” and “Blade Runner 2049.” He’s best known in the Marvel Universe as Drax the Destroyer from “Guardians of the Galaxy” and the “Avengers” movies, and now he’s facing zombies in the highly anticipated “Army of the Dead”!  Country music superstars LADY A is here! They’ll perform their latest hit, “Feel Like a Lady,” from their new album!

videos.overview:
This just in… JAKE TAPPER returns! In addition to anchoring his own CNN show, “The Lead with Jake Tapper,” the accomplished journalist is also a best-selling author, and he’ll tell Ellen about his new novel, “The Devil May Dance”!

Ellen’s friend TIG NOTARO returns! She’s always entertaining, and today she’ll not only bring the laughs, she'll also talk about her new zombie heist movie, “Army of the Dead”!  Recent "American Idol" castoff HUNTER METTS is here! He’ll chat about his experience, then take the stage for a special performance!

videos.title: Jennifer Aniston, Principal Sherrie Gahn
videos.overview:
She was Ellen’s very first guest, and now she’s here to help kick off her final season - JENNIFER ANISTON is here! The Emmy-winning actress has been one of the world’s most beloved stars between her time on “Friends” and movies like “The Good Girl,” and now she’s here to talk about the upcoming second season of “The Morning Show.” You don’t want to miss her return!

Then, Ellen welcomes back Principal Sherrie Gahn, who we first met 10 years ago. She inspired many as she talked about the passion and dedication to her students at Whitney Elementary School in Las Vegas, Nevada. Over the years, Ellen has given over $200,000 worth of school supplies and funds to Sherrie and her beloved school, and now she’s here to give an update on how her life has changed since her first appearance on the show, and Ellen even has a couple big surprises in store for this amazing educator!

videos.title: Tiffany Haddish, Charli & Dixie D’Amelio, Imagine Dragons
videos.overview:
She ready - TIFFANY HADDISH joins Ellen! The award-winning actress, comedian, and frequent guest host on “The Ellen Show” will join Ellen in-studio! She’ll talk about her summer and her new revenge thriller, “The Card Counter.”

You’ve seen them on TikTok, and now they’re on the show - CHARLI and DIXIE D’AMELIO are here! They’ll talk about their Hulu reality series, “The D’Amelio Show,” and will later be joined by their parents, Heidi and Marc D’Amelio.

Then, rockers IMAGINE DRAGONS will take the stage to perform “Wrecked” from their new album, “Mercury – Act 1.”

videos.title: Kim Kardashian West, Volleyball Coach Inoke Tonga
videos.overview:
KIM KARDASHIAN WEST visits Ellen! The hard-working entrepreneur, reality TV star, and dedicated mom sits down with Ellen to talk about her kids, famous siblings, and the newest products from her successful shapewear line, Skims.

Ellen will also welcome high school volleyball coach Inoke Tonga from Denver, Colorado. He’ll talk about how he was confronted by school staff about his sexuality just before his second year as coach and asked to delete any LGBTQ+ related posts. After he refused, Inoke was fired from his job but flooded with students, former staff, and alumni support. Don’t miss his inspiring chat with Ellen.

videos.title: Lori Greiner
videos.overview:
Ellen wraps up Season 19 Premiere Week with LORI GREINER! The “Shark Tank” star has been investing in entrepreneurs for the past nine seasons of the hit show and has become a fan favorite. She’s also been dubbed as the “Queen of QVC” thanks to her show “Clever & Unique Creations.” You don’t want to miss her first visit to Ellen!

Start your weekend off right with Ellen!

videos.title: Common, Julia Haart
videos.overview: Start your week with Ellen and the multi-talented COMMON! The talented entertainer has accomplished one of the most difficult feats - winning an Emmy, Grammy, and Oscar in recognition for his work throughout the years in music and the screen. He’ll talk about his new album, “A Beautiful Revolution, Pt. 2” and open up about his relationship with actress Tiffany Haddish!  Ellen welcomes JULIA HAART, fashion designer and star of the Netflix docuseries “My Unorthodox Life”. She’ll discuss how she dealt with the transition from growing up as an Orthodox Jew to a new non-religious lifestyle in Manhattan, where she is the CEO of modeling agency Elite World Group.

videos.title: Melissa Etheridge, Loni Love, Viral Singer Deshawn Washington
videos.overview: Rock out with MELISSA ETHERIDGE, who will chat with Ellen and then later take the stage to perform “As Cool As You Try,” from her new album “One Way Out”.

videos.overview: The charming and talented SCOTT FOLEY is here! He’s the star of shows including “Scandal,” “Felicity,” and “The Unit.” Now he’s on a new musical comedy-drama called “The Big Leap” and he’ll talk to Ellen all about it!  Fresh off his “America’s Got Talent” win, magician DUSTIN TAVELLA visits the show!

videos.title: Julianne Moore, Chloe Fineman
videos.overview: The talented JULIANNE MOORE is here! The Oscar winner has impressed audiences with her work in films like “Still Alice”, “The Kids Are All Right”, and “Magnolia”. Now she’s here to talk about the film adaptation of the Tony-winning musical “Dear Evan Hansen”!

videos.title: Guest Host Arsenio Hall
videos.overview: He’s talk show royalty and now he’s here on The Ellen Show stage! ARSENIO HALL is here to guest host for the very first time - you won’t want to miss this!

videos.title: Melissa McCarthy
videos.overview: She’s one of the most hilarious stars in the world... it’s MELISSA McCARTHY! The talented actress is best known for making us laugh in movies like “Bridesmaids,” and for her Oscar-nominated performance in “Can You Ever Forgive Me?” Melissa will stop by to chat with Ellen about her upcoming Netflix movie “The Starling”!

videos.title: Guest Co-Host Mila Kunis with Leslie Jordan, Paralympic Swimmer Morgan Stickney
videos.overview: The talented MILA KUNIS is here to co-host the show with Ellen! She’ll also sit down for an entertaining chat and get in the hot seat to answer some “Burning Questions”!

videos.title: Meghan Trainor, Comedian Josh Blue
videos.overview: We’re all about her — MEGHAN TRAINOR! The Grammy winner is best known for her hits like, “All About That Bass” and “Lips Are Movin.” Now she’s heading to the small screen in the new music competition show, “Clash of the Cover Bands”! She’ll talk about the series, being a new mom, and more!

videos.title: Diddy, Nacho Figueras
videos.overview: It’s guaranteed to be a good time, because DIDDY is back on the show today! He’s one of the biggest personalities in music, film and fashion, and from his extensive rap career and music producing to his Sean John line, Diddy has truly done it all! The media mogul will talk to Ellen about what new projects he’s working on, his favorite moments being on the show, and his new flavor of Ciroc Vodka!

videos.title: Guest Host Arsenio Hall, Joel McHale, Curtis Stone
videos.overview: The one and only Arsenio Hall guest hosts the show!  He welcomes the super funny Joel McHale! The actor and comedian is best known for his work on “Community,” “The Soup,” and “Ted.” He’s here to talk to Arsenio about what it’s like playing a superhero in the CW series “Stargirl”!

videos.title: Leah Remini, Dr. Michael Beckwith
videos.overview: The always enjoyable LEAH REMINI returns! The actress is known for starring in the long-running sitcom “The King of Queens,” and her Emmy-winning work in the docu-series “Leah Remini: Scientology and the Aftermath.” Today she’ll talk to Ellen about the second season of her entertaining game show, “People Puzzler”!

Multiple Grammy winner BRANDI CARLILE will chat with Ellen about her new album “In These Silent Days,” her family’s Halloween plans, and give Ellen a present she’ll never forget.

All aboard fans of “Below Deck Mediterranean” — CAPTAIN SANDY YAWN is here! She’ll talk to Ellen straight from her superyacht and share what we can expect from this season’s much-anticipated reunion.

videos.title: Jason Sudeikis, Kane Brown
videos.overview: Get ready for some laughs, because JASON SUDEIKIS is joining Ellen! He’ll talk about the latest season of his beloved Apple TV+ series, “Ted Lasso,” for which he recently won an Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series!

videos.title: Jay Shetty, Cheryl Hines

You don’t want to miss her visit! Ellen will also welcome Zach Skow, who founded the Pawsitive Change Program, which gives incarcerated people a chance to co-own a shelter dog and learn dog-training skills. He’ll share his story and explain how his dogs gave him the strength to turn his life around.

videos.title: Day 11 of 12 Days of Giveaways with Rosario Dawson, Ed Sheeran
videos.overview:
It’s Day 11 of 12 Days of Giveaways and there’s plenty to celebrate — ROSARIO DAWSON is here! The talented actress and producer has been in hit films like “Men in Black II,” “Rent,” and “Sin City,” and now she’s here to talk about her acclaimed new Hulu series, “Dopesick,” and her documentary “This is Not a War Story.”

Then, he’s one of the world’s best-selling music artists — ED SHEERAN returns! The multiple Grammy winner will sit down for a chat with Ellen, then later take the stage to perform his hit song, “Shivers”!

videos.title: Day 12 of 12 Days of Giveaways Nicholas Braun, Brené Brown
videos.overview:
It’s Ellen's final day of 12 Days of Giveaways! She’s ready to hand out some incredible gifts to the audience so you don’t want to miss her final 12 Days show!

Ellen will welcome NICHOLAS BRAUN! The actor stars in one of Ellen’s favorite shows, “Succession,” for which he has received an Emmy nomination. He’ll talk about the current third season of the hit series, and much more!

Then, the incomparable BRENÉ BROWN returns! The research professor is also a best-selling author with five #1 New York Times bestsellers, including her popular book, “Dare to Lead.” She’s here to talk about her new book, “Atlas of the Heart: Mapping Meaningful Connection and the Language of Human Experience.”

videos.title: Guest Host tWitch with Zachary Levi, O’Shea Jackson Jr.
videos.overview:
It’s a fun Friday when tWitch guest hosts the show, and he’ll welcome the talented ZACHARY LEVI! The actor is best known for his titular roles in TV series “Chuck” and superhero movie “Shazam!,” and he’s here to chat about his new movie, “American Underdog”!

Then, tWitch will sit down with O’SHEA JACKSON JR.! The “Straight Outta Compton” star will talk about his holiday plans, a special moment with his idol Kobe Bryant, and his new AppleTV+ series, “Swagger.” And you’ll want to see tWitch surprise Quyionah Wingfield and her daughter, Serenity, the co-founders of Cool Moms Dance Too. They’ll talk about why they started the organization to help families reconnect after experiencing trauma and loss — all through the power of dance.

Start your weekend off right with tWitch!

videos.title: Ken Jeong, Alison Sweeney, Brett Dennen
videos.overview:
The always entertaining KEN JEONG returns! He’s known for his roles in “The Hangover” franchise, “Community,” and as a judge on “The Masked Singer.” Today he’s here to talk about the holiday special of his show, “I Can See Your Voice”!  Then, Ellen welcomes back ALISON SWEENEY! The “Days of Our Lives” actress has been one of the most competitive guests to ever come on the show, and this time around she and Ellen are facing off in a round of “Danger Word”! She’ll also sit down to talk to Ellen about her new movie, “Open by Christmas.”

Singer/songwriter BRETT DENNEN will take the stage for a performance of “See the World” from his album of the same name.

Ellen will also chat with 11-year-old Francisco Cardenas, an impressive guitarist who has been playing the instrument since he was just 4 years old. He’ll then perform Toto’s rock classic, “Hold the Line”!

videos.title: Scarlett Johansson and Bono, ‘The Voice’ Contestant Joshua Vacanti
videos.overview:
It’s a terrific Tuesday as Ellen welcomes SCARLETT JOHANSSON & BONO! The accomplished actress and rock icon both lend their voices to the animated film “Sing 2,” and they’re here to talk all about it!

Then, Ellen will welcome “The Voice” finalist JOSHUA VACANTI! He wowed the panelists with his incredible talent, and thanks to his own coach, John Legend, made it all the way to semi-finals. He’ll talk to Ellen about his experience and take the stage to perform a cover of “Falling” by Harry Styles!

videos.title: Aubrey Plaza
videos.overview:
The always entertaining AUBREY PLAZA is here! Many have watched her on the small screen in “Parks and Recreation” and “Legion,” but now you can read her very first children’s book, “The Legend of The Christmas Witch.” Be sure to tune in for guaranteed laughs!

Then, watch as Ellen gets artistic as pancake artist Jas Rezonable teaches Ellen how to create art using just pancake batter!

videos.title: Reese Witherspoon and Matthew McConaughey, Ed Sheeran
videos.overview: It’s a star-studded Thursday as Reese Witherspoon and Matthew McConaughey visit Ellen! The Academy Award winners are back to talk about their new animated film “Sing 2”!  And it’s time to get festive as ED SHEERAN performs his new holiday song, “Merry Christmas”!  Then, you’ll want to hear about this high-flying story from siblings Antonio, Diego, and Isa Arredondo.

videos.title: Guest Host Howie Mandel with Michael Bublé, Pentatonix
videos.overview:
Comedian HOWIE MANDEL takes over as guest host and welcomes his friend MICHAEL BUBLÉ! The multiple-Grammy winner will chat about his family, being dubbed the “King of Christmas,” and divulge about the prank Howie pulled on him!

A cappella superstars PENTATONIX will then take the stage to perform “I Just Called to Say I Love You” from their holiday album, “Evergreen.”

And you’ll want to hear the inspiring story from fourth grade teacher K.D. Meucci, who created an online reading program called Bedtime Stories, in which she goes on Facebook Live and reads books to her students once a week. She’ll talk about how she underwent surgery to remove a brain tumor this past summer, but was still dedicated to read to her students — even from the hospital.  Get your weekend started with Howie!

videos.title: Guest Host Howie Mandel, Melanie C, Comedian Preacher Lawson
videos.overview:
Howie Mandel is back as Ellen’s guest host!

Get ready to spice up your life because MELANIE C is here! The talented singer will talk about her solo album, “Melanie C,” the 25th-anniversary edition of the Spice Girls debut album, “Spice25,” and their plans to go back on tour!  Then, Howie welcomes his friend and “America’s Got Talent” contestant PREACHER LAWSON! They’ll chat about Howie’s pranks and Preacher hosting America’s Got Talent Las Vegas LIVE!

videos.title: Guest Host Leslie Jordan with Cheyenne Jackson, Max Greenfield, Amanda Shires
videos.overview: For the first time, actor and comedian Leslie Jordan will take over as guest host! He’ll welcome his friend Max Greenfield, who will chat about his show “The Neighborhood,” his new children’s book "I Don't Want to Read This Book," and play a fun holiday game with Leslie!  Then, the multi-talented Cheyenne Jackson sits down with Leslie! The actor is known for his roles in “American Horror Story,” “Glee,” and “30 Rock.” Grammy winner singer/songwriter Amanda Shires brings the holiday cheer with a performance of her song “Gone for Christmas” featuring The McCrary Sisters!

videos.title: Guest Host JoJo Siwa with Meghan Trainor
videos.overview: The multi-talented Jojo Siwa guest hosts the show and welcomes Meghan Trainor. The Grammy winner will chat about motherhood, her holiday album “A Very Trainor Christmas (Deluxe),” and later take the stage for a performance of her song, “Christmas Coupon.”  And get ready for an explosive performance from the winners of Jojo’s new series “Siwas Dance Pop Revolution”!

videos.title: Guest Host tWitch with Neil Patrick Harris
videos.overview: Guest host tWitch welcomes Neil Patrick Harris. The actor will chat about his holiday plans and the highly anticipated film, “The Matrix Resurrections.”  Then, tWitch will sit down with Leon Howard from Atlanta, Georgia. He’ll talk about how he began building wealth for himself by investing and telling his friends about stocks after he was released from prison.

videos.title: Guest Host JoJo Siwa with Iman Shumpert
videos.overview: Guest host JoJo Siwa had a rematch against "Dancing with the Stars" winner Iman Shumpert in a game of "Last Dance." But she had a little help — Iman's six-year-old daughter Junie decided to side with JoJo and play against her own dad!

videos.title: Guest Host tWitch with J.B. Smoove, EJ Williams
videos.overview: Comedian J.B. Smoove is so good at improv and can basically talk his way out of any situation, so guest host tWitch served up a few different scenarios to see how he'd react to it. Watch his hilarious off-the-cuff reactions in a game called "Smoove Talkin'"!

videos.title: Guest Host Brad Paisley with Cary Elwes, Tori Kelly
videos.overview:
Buckle up because BRAD PAISLEY is taking over as guest host! The country superstar will welcome the accomplished actor CARY ELWES! Known for his iconic roles in “The Princess Bride” and “Robin Hood: Men in Tights,” he’s here to talk about his festive new movie, “A Castle for Christmas”!

Then, Brad chats with the super talented TORI KELLY! The singer will chat about her two new Grammy nominations, revisiting her role as an elephant in “Sing 2,” and her children’s book, “The Curly Girl Blues”!

And Brad welcomes 11-year-old singer and guitarist Champ Jaxon! He’ll chat about how he got into music, the gigs and music festivals he plays with his band, and even takes the stage to jam out with Brad!

videos.title: Guest Host Ciara with Normani
videos.overview: Guest host Ciara has dubbed 2021 as her "Year of Fear," pushing herself to face the things she's most afraid of. The one thing she has yet to conquer is her fear of spiders — until now. Watch as Ciara, Normani, and tWitch take turns holding tarantulas!

videos.title: RuPaul; José Andrés; Jim and Sasha Allen
videos.overview: RuPaul ("RuPaul's Drag Race"); an interview and cooking demo with chef José Andrés; Jim and Sasha Allen ("The Voice").

videos.title: Lily Collins; The War on Drugs, ft. Lucius
videos.overview: Lily Collins ("Emily in Paris"); science guy Steve Spangler; The War on Drugs, ft. Lucius, performs.

videos.title: Jessica Chastain; Girl Named Tom
videos.overview: Jessica Chastain ("The 355"); Ellen welcomes a 7-year-old whose speech has gone viral; "The Voice" season 21 winner Girl Named Tom performs.

videos.title: Penélope Cruz, Demian Chapman
videos.overview: Penélope Cruz ("The 355"); shark expert Demian Chapman ("Endangered" campaign).

videos.title: Guest Host tWitch with Nicole Byer
videos.overview:
Get the weekend started with guest host tWitch! He’ll welcome the very funny NICOLE BYER! The comedian has made us laugh for years with appearances on “Girl Code,” “30 Rock,” “The Good Place,” and “Nailed It” – for which she received an Emmy nomination! Today she’ll talk with tWitch about her new TV series, “Grand Crew”!

And then, you won’t want to miss tWitch’s inspiring conversation with Valerie Groth, the founder of Ryan Banks Academy in Chicago. She’ll talk about how she left her job as a social worker to open the school after she lost one of her students, 12-year-old Ryan Banks, to gun violence — and how it’s her mission to give kids the best and most safe education.

videos.title: Jay Leno, Black Pumas
videos.overview:
.Legendary comedian JAY LENO is here! The former talk show host will chat with Ellen about “You Bet Your Life,” a revival of the classic quiz show of the same name.

Ellen will also chat with Eric Burton and Adrian Quesada from Grammy nominees BLACK PUMAS. They will then take the stage with a performance of their song “Know You Better.”

videos.title: John Cena, Parquet Courts
videos.overview: You can see him on the big screen and in the ring — JOHN CENA is here! The superstar will talk about his HBO Max series “Peacemaker,” and also answer questions from the Random Question Generator!  Then, PARQUET COURTS will take the stage to perform their brand new song, “Watching Strangers Smile.”  Ellen will also welcome TikToker Demi Skipper, who went viral with her videos documenting her journey from trading a bobby pin all the way to a house. Over a year-and-a-half and 28 trades later, Demi made her final trade and took ownership of a house in Tennessee. You don’t want to miss this fascinating story!

videos.title: Beth Behrs, Mentalist Oz Pearlman
videos.overview:
The wonderful BETH BEHRS returns! She’s a frequent visitor to the show and has made memorable appearances over the years. She’ll talk about her favorite moments and play a fun game of “Taste Buds” with her “The Neighborhood” co-star Tichina Arnold!

Then, you’ll want to see mentalist OZ PEARLMAN. He’s one of the top mentalists in the country and left Ellen speechless with his visit!

videos.title: Christina Ricci, Past-Life Psychic Ainslie MacLeod
videos.overview:
The talented CHRISTINA RICCI is here! The actress has been in the business since she was a kid, starring in memorable movies like “Mermaids,” “The Addams Family,” and “Casper.” Now she’s here to talk all about her acclaimed Showtime series, “Yellowjackets”!

Then, Ellen welcomes past-life psychic, spiritual teacher and award-winning author, Ainslie MacLeod, who will talk all about his work.

videos.title: Guest Host Adam Devine with Julie Bowen, Anders Holm
videos.overview:
The hilarious ADAM DEVINE takes over as guest host! The comedian and actor will welcome JULIE BOWEN, who he worked with on “Modern Family.”

Adam will also chat with his “Workaholics” co-star and good friend ANDERS HOLM, who will talk about his new Netflix series “Inventing Anna.”

videos.title: Heidi Klum, Poet Brandon Leake
videos.overview:
The talented and beautiful HEIDI KLUM returns! She’s been one of Ellen’s most frequent guests, and today she’s here to talk about her new song with Snoop Dogg!

Then, Ellen will welcome back “America’s Got Talent” winner, poet BRANDON LEAKE! He’ll chat about what he’s been up to since being crowned champion, talk about his book “unraveling,” and later take the stage to perform a moving poem.  And to get ready for the upcoming 2022 Winter Olympics, Ellen welcomed three Olympians to compete in “Ellen’s Gold Medal Challenge”! Find out if gold medalist Tara Lipinski, sled hockey athlete Rico Roman, and figure skater Mariah Bell have what it takes to take first place!

videos.title: Steve Harvey, Freestyle Rapper Harry Mack, Charlotte Day Wilson
“Cheer” Coach Monica Aldama, Aerialist Erin Blaire
Mahershala Ali, Martha Stewart, Freestyle Skier Colby Stevenson
Guest Host Adam Devine with Julianne Hough & Nina Dobrev
Andrew Garfield, Sherri Shepherd
videos.overview: The talented ANDREW GARFIELD is here! The Golden Globe-winning actor is known for playing Spider-Man and his role in “The Social Network.” Now he’s earning rave reviews and Oscar buzz for portraying Broadway composer Jonathan Larson in the movie musical “Tick, Tick... Boom!” and he’s here to tell Ellen all about it!  Ellen will also welcome SHERRI SHEPHERD! The actress and comedian will chat about her acclaimed new series “The Sex Lives of College Girls” and her podcast “Two Funny Mamas.”

videos.title: Ciara, Tabitha Brown
videos.overview: Get ready to “1, 2 Step” to the show because CIARA is here! The Grammy-nominated singer will talk about what it was like to guest host for Ellen, her family’s recent trip to the White House, and play a fun game of “Drawer Dash”!  The wonderful TABITHA BROWN visits Ellen! The actress gained popularity through her entertaining and inspiring TikTok about cooking — and now garners the title of “America’s Mom.” Today she’ll chat about her new children’s show, “Tab Time”!  Then, twin violinists Mirko and Valerio from Sicily, Italy are in the studio for a special performance! The talented 14-year-olds first gained popularity with a cover of Coldplay’s “Viva la Vida” that went viral, and Ellen even played the clip on her show back in Season 17! Now they’re in Los Angeles to talk about the sudden fame and then take the stage to perform the song that made them an internet sensation!

videos.title: Ellen's Birthday Show; Courteney Cox; Chris Martin; Coldplay
videos.overview: Courteney Cox; Chris Martin; Coldplay performs.

videos.title: Paris Hilton; Vontae Johnson; Lizzy McAlpine
videos.overview: Paris Hilton ("Paris in Love"); head coach Vontae Johnson of the Trinity Valley Community College cheerleading team ("Cheer"); Lizzy McAlpine performs.

videos.title: Kristen Bell
videos.overview:
Kick off the week with the one and only KRISTEN BELL! The actress, entrepreneur, and supermom can do it all, and she’s here to talk about her new Netflix series, “The Woman in the House Across the Street from the Girl in the Window.” Plus, she’ll face off against Ellen in a game of “Danger Word”!

Then, Ellen welcomes back kid recycler Ryan Hickman. He was first on the show in Season 14 when he was 7 years old to talk about his Ryan’s Recycling company. Now 12, he’ll give an update on his environmental efforts and his new project to protect marine life.

videos.title: Murray Bartlett
videos.overview:
Ellen welcomes MURRAY BARTLETT, the breakout star from one of her favorite new shows, “The White Lotus.” The actor is a Screen Actors Guild nominee for his impressive performance and he’s here to talk about the acclaimed series!

Then, Ellen will chat with news reporter Tori Yorgey, who recently made headlines herself with a viral video. She was doing a live report in West Virginia when she got hit by a car — but even though she was being knocked down to the ground, she got right back up and continued reporting. She’ll talk about her experience and how she’s completely fine after the accident.  And you don’t want to miss rap duo Joey and Braedan, friends who began creating music together in college, and recently one of their TikTok videos went viral with over 16 million views. They’ll talk to Ellen about it and perform their newest song, “Double Jump.”

videos.title: David Spade, Chris Martin, Flamingo Estate Owner Richard Christiansen
Guest Host Mario Lopez with Sarah Hyland, UFC Champion Julianna Peña
Chelsea Handler, Scott Eastwood
videos.overview:
Ellen welcomes the always candid, outspoken, and hilarious CHELSEA HANDLER! Nothing is off limits when the comedian and author stops by, and this time around she’ll be chatting about her new boyfriend, Jo Koy, and her “Vaccinated and Horny” tour.

Then, Ellen chats with SCOTT EASTWOOD! The actor is known for his roles in “The Longest Ride,” “Suicide Squad,” and “The Fate of the Furious,” and now he’s here to talk about his romantic comedy, “I Want You Back”!

videos.title: Josh Gad, Benson Boone, Mentalist Colin Cloud
videos.overview: The talented star of stage and screen, Josh Gad returns! The actor has been in beloved films like “Frozen” and “Beauty and the Beast,” and now he’s on the new Peacock show “Wolf Like Me” and he’s here to talk all about it! Benson Boone perform his debut song, “Ghost Town.”  Then world-renowned mentalist Colin Cloud.

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez
videos.overview: She’s an international icon and world-renowned superstar… it's Jennifer Lopez! She’s been on the show over 25 times, and they’ll take a look back at some of their most memorable moments, and Jennifer will talk about her new movie, “Marry Me!” It’s always a fun time with J.Lo, and there’s no doubt this visit will leave you “Feelin’ So Good”!

videos.title: Kevin Hart
videos.overview: Kevin Hart always has a lot of interesting opinions, so Ellen spun a wheel of topics so he could give his thoughts on whatever it landed on in a game called "Thoughts From the Hart." Watch his hilarious takes on being snubbed for the title of People Magazine's Sexiest Man Alive, being careful around mirrors while on FaceTime, and ghost hunting.

videos.title: Owen Wilson, Teddy Swims
videos.overview:
The talented OWEN WILSON is here! He’s been entertaining audiences for years with films like “Wedding Crashers,” and “The Royal Tenenbaums,” and now he’s here to talk about his new romantic comedy, “Marry Me,” opposite Jennifer Lopez!

Rising soul/R&B artist TEDDY SWIMS will be here to perform his newest song “911” from his EP “Tough Love.”

Plus, Ellen gets ready for Super Bowl LVI in Los Angeles!

videos.title: Kat Dennings, Hannah Waddingham, Kym Douglas
videos.overview:
Celebrate Valentine’s Day with Ellen! She’ll welcome KAT DENNINGS to the show! The actress spent six seasons on the beloved sitcom “2 Broke Girls'” and is also known for her roles in “Thor,” and “WandaVision.” Now she’s back to talk about the second season of her Hulu series “Dollface.”

From the acclaimed series “Ted Lasso,” HANNAH WADDINGHAM returns! The actress will talk about her Emmy Award win, what’s in store for the future of the show, and play a game of “Who’d You Rather?.”

videos.title: Maluma, Pamela Adlon
videos.overview:
Global superstar MALUMA is on the show! He’s one of the hottest Latin performers with chart-topping songs and hit collaborations with Madonna, The Weeknd, and more. He’s here to talk about his turn as an actor in the new rom-com “Marry Me” alongside Jennifer Lopez!

For the first time on the show, comedian PAMELA ADLON is here! The Emmy-winning actress is known for her roles in “Californication,” “Louie,” and “Better Things,” which is in its fifth and final season.

Then, Ellen welcomes Robert Thomas, who owned a successful nightclub for five years, but had to change plans once the pandemic hit. Even though he had no expertise in the grocery industry, Robert decided to convert his nightclub into a grocery store to serve his community and became the first Black-owned grocery store in Houston, Texas. He’ll talk to Ellen about his experience and how it has impacted his community.

videos.title: Laverne Cox, Paralympian Ezra Frech
videos.overview:
LAVERNE COX is here! She’s a groundbreaking actress, the first transgender woman of color to star in a leading role on a mainstream TV show, “Orange Is the New Black,” and an Emmy-winning producer! Laverne will talk with Ellen about her new Netflix series, “Inventing Anna,” and play a fun dance game with tWitch!

Then, Ellen welcomed back Ezra Frech, who was first on the show in Season 12 when he was just 9 years old. Back then, he told Ellen that it was his dream to be a Paralympian, and now at 16, he’s back on the show just months after competing at the 2020 Summer Paralympics! He'll talk about his experience in Tokyo and what he's doing now to provide adaptive sport opportunities for people with physical disabilities or visual impairments.

videos.title: Mark Wahlberg, Principal Akbar Cook
videos.overview: It’s getting hot in here – MARK WAHLBERG returns! He's the star of “Boogie Nights,” “The Departed,” “Ted,” and the family reality show “Wahlburgers,” and more! Now he’s here to talk about his new movies “Uncharted” and “Father Stu,” and take a look back at all his appearances on Ellen over the years.  Ellen will also welcome back Newark, New Jersey principal Akbar Cook, who previously received $100,000 from Ellen in recognition of his incredible work for his school and community. He’ll talk about how he decided to build The Ellen DeGeneres Urban Farm using the generous donation, and how it provides fresh food for the community and residual income for the student workers. You don’t want to miss this inspiring educator!

videos.title: Guest Host tWitch with Nicole Ari Parker
videos.overview: Guest host tWitch welcomes actress NICOLE ARI PARKER! You know her from movies like “Boogie Nights” and “Remember the Titans,” and now she’s one of the breakout characters in the new “Sex and the City” revival “And Just Like That…”! She’ll talk about her marriage, parenthood, and what it’s like joining the cast of the beloved TV series.  Then, tWitch will chat with Miguel and Kaitlin, a couple who give back to the community through youth basketball. They’ll talk about their basketball camp, their nonprofit organization Hoopers Helpers, and how they’re preparing to become first-time parents!

videos.title: Usher, Macey Hensley
videos.overview: Get ready to say “Yeah!” because the one and only USHER is here! The Grammy-winning singer and actor has been one of Ellen’s favorite guests over the past 19 seasons, and today he’s here to look back at some memorable moments, and talk about fatherhood!  Then, it’s not Presidents’ Day without resident kid presidential expert MACEY HENSLEY! She first showed Ellen her impressive knowledge when she was just five years old, and now that she’s 12, she’s here to reminisce about her amazing experiences and talk about her new hobby!

videos.title: Eric Stonestreet, Kid Reporter Jaden Jefferson
videos.overview:
He’s always a great time when he visits Ellen — it’s ERIC STONESTREET! The Emmy-winning actor from “Modern Family” has been scared multiple times on the show, gone through a haunted house with Average Andy and much more. Today he’ll talk about his favorite appearances, and also chat about his new show, “Domino Masters.”

Ellen will then welcome the Positive Impact Movement, an acrobatic group who were finalists on Season 16 of “America’s Got Talent.” They’ll talk about their goal to spread positivity through movement, and show off their impressive skills!  This just in — kid reporter Jaden Jefferson returns! The 13-year-old previously interviewed Brad Pitt and Oprah during his visits to the show, and now he’s back to talk about what he’s been up to since, and his YouTube channel “Jaden Reports.”

videos.title: Tyler Perry, Glennon Doyle, Phillip-Michael Scales
videos.overview: One of the most original, prolific and groundbreaking filmmakers of our time, not to mention one of the funniest, TYLER PERRY is here! He’ll talk about bringing his iconic character back in the new film “Tyler Perry’s A Madea Homecoming!”  Then, GLENNON DOYLE stops by! The acclaimed author has written three best-selling memoirs, including her latest, “Untamed” — which has sold over two million copies. She’ll talk with Ellen about her latest works, including “Get Untamed: The Journal,” and her podcast, “We Can Do Hard Things.”  Soul and Blues artist PHILLIP-MICHAEL SCALES will make his television debut and perform his song “Find A Way.”

videos.title: Marlee Matlin, LA Rams Player Andrew Whitworth, Sylvan Esso
videos.overview: Ellen welcomed Los Angeles Rams player and newly crowned Super Bowl champ Andrew Whitworth to the show. He talked about currently being the oldest player in the NFL, and if he has plans to retire. The Offensive Tackle also commented on how his daughter was caught reading in the stands during the big game, and how he felt winning this year’s Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year Award for his community service efforts off the field.

videos.title: Guest Host Mario Lopez with Greg Kinnear
videos.overview: Guest host MARIO LOPEZ welcomes GREG KINNEAR! The actor has been in such beloved films as “As Good As It Gets,” and “Little Miss Sunshine.” Now he’s starring in a new TV series with Courteney Cox called “Shining Vale,” and he’ll tell Mario all about it!  Then, Mario welcomes the effervescent Cheryl Porter, a vocal coach and professional singer who has gone viral on social media with her innovative vocal lessons. She’ll talk about her background and even give Mario some singing tips!

videos.title: Colin Farrell, Colman Domingo, Mat Franco
Milo Ventimiglia
videos.overview: The talented MILO VENTIMIGLIA returns! The star of hit shows like “Gilmore Girls” and “Heroes,” he’ll talk to Ellen about the sixth and final season of his beloved series “This Is Us,” and much more!  Ellen will also sit down with Coss Marte, the founder of ConBody, a fitness boot camp that hires formerly incarcerated individuals. He’ll share his story of his time in prison, and how that led to him starting a gym to train thousands of people and hire many employees who have come out of the prison system.

videos.title: Kevin Nealon, Jacob Elordi
videos.overview: What a Wednesday with KEVIN NEALON! The comedian will talk about going back on the road for his stand-up comedy tour, and his new book, "I Exaggerate: My Brushes with Fame."  Then, “Euphoria” actor JACOB ELORDI sits down with Ellen! He’ll talk about his scandalous scenes on the hit HBO series and much more!

videos.title: Guest Host Mickey Guyton with Jimmie Allen, Priscilla Block
videos.overview:
Talented country music star MICKEY GUYTON takes over as guest host! She’ll welcome her friend and fellow country singer JIMMIE ALLEN, who will talk about his experience on “Dancing with the Stars” and going back on the road for his “Down Home” tour. Plus, he’ll play a fun round of “5 Second Rule” with Mickey!  Then, rising country artist PRISCILLA BLOCK will take the stage to perform her song, “Just About Over You.”

Mickey will also sit down with inspiring teacher George Caesar from Miami, Florida. He realized the students’ need for healthy food, so he created “Smoothies 4 Students,” a non-profit that provides smoothies and nutritional packages for low-income students. He’ll talk about his work and the goals for his organization.

videos.title: Guest Host Ciara with Russell Wilson, La La Anthony
videos.overview: Guest host Ciara surprised Brittanie Richardson, a single mom of 7 kids. She explained how she grew up in the foster care system and is now using her own experience to help children through her work with the Los Angeles Unified School District. Not only did Ciara shock Brittanie by bringing all her kids to the show, but she also received gifts from Russell Wilson and $10,000 from TisBest!

videos.title: Machine Gun Kelly, Mamoudou Athie
videos.overview:
Singer/rapper MACHINE GUN KELLY joins Ellen! He’ll chat about everything from his recent engagement to getting matching tattoos with Travis Barker. He’ll also play a fun round of “Burning Questions” with Ellen!  Ellen will also welcome actor MAMOUDOU ATHIE from one of her favorite new shows, “Archive 81”!

Then, 12-year-old Gage Butler visits. He recently went viral on TikTok with an impressive cover of “End of the Road” by Boyz II Men, and after chatting he’ll take the stage to show off his incredible talent!

videos.title: Zach Braff, Kid Rapper Sam White
videos.overview: Zach Braff and Ellen faced off in a game of "5 Second Rule"! Find out the things Zach liked about playing a doctor on TV, and what Ellen would say at a nude beach.

videos.title: Guest Host tWitch with Oliver Hudson, Lana Condor
videos.overview: Oliver Hudson played a game with guest host tWitch that revealed a few surprising things about "The Cleaning Lady" star. Find out his favorite thing to do to embarrass his kids, and the most embarrassing thing mom Goldie Hawn did to him when he was younger.
